title: From One Multiplication to a Whole Network: Operators in AI
section: 5. 为什么大家都说自己的算子更好？ / Why everyone claims their operator is better
text:
5. 为什么大家都说自己的算子更好？ / Why everyone claims their operator is better
“我们提出了一个新的算子，效果更好。”这句话在论文摘要里出现频率极高，但它可能指三件完全不同的事。分不清这三件事，就没法判断一项工作到底先进在哪里，也没法复现它的结论。
“We propose a new operator that performs better.” That sentence appears in an enormous number of abstracts, yet it can mean three completely different things. Without separating them you cannot tell what a piece of work actually improves, nor reproduce its claims.

5.1 一句话，三种含义 / One sentence, three meanings
把差别摊开：
Laid out plainly:

第一类：换了信息处理机制。同样的输入输出接口，数学上做了不同的事：换聚合函数、换打分方式、引入关系类型、加乘法交互。改变的是模型能表达什么。
The mechanism. Same interface, different mathematics: a different aggregation, a different scoring rule, relation types, multiplicative interactions. What changes is what the model can express.
第二类：换了底层实现。数学完全一样，只是数据在芯片上搬得更少、算子启动次数更少、显存占用更低。改变的是同样的结果要花多少时间和内存。
The implementation. Identical mathematics; fewer bytes moved, fewer kernel launches, less memory. What changes is how much time and memory the same answer costs.
第三类：换了整体设计。算子没变，变的是它们怎么拼：残差、归一化的位置、路由、训练目标、推理策略。改变的是整个系统的行为。
The design. The operators are unchanged; their wiring is: residuals, normalisation placement, routing, objectives, inference strategy. What changes is the behaviour of the whole system.

混淆的典型症状是把第三类说成第一类（“我们发明了新算子”，其实是把 LayerNorm 挪到了注意力之前），或者把第二类说成第一类（“新算子更快”，其实数学一模一样，只是不物化中间矩阵）。
The typical symptom is calling a third-kind change a first-kind one (“we invented a new operator” — actually LayerNorm was moved before attention), or a second-kind change a first-kind one (“the new operator is faster” — the mathematics is identical, only the intermediate matrix is no longer materialised).


5.2 第一类：换信息处理机制 / First kind: change the mechanism
这类工作改的是 3.7 节那个公式里的某个部件：
This kind of work changes a component of the formula in section 3.7:
\[h_i'=\phi\Big(h_i,\ \bigoplus_{j\in\mathcal{N}(i)}\psi(h_i,h_j)\Big)\]

换 \(\bigoplus\)：均值 → 求和 → 注意力加权。GIN 的结论是求和比均值和最大值更有表达力，因为只有求和能区分”两个邻居都是 1”和”一个邻居是 2”。
Change \(\bigoplus\): mean → sum → attention-weighted. The GIN result is that sum is more expressive than mean or max, because only sum distinguishes “two neighbours equal to 1” from “one neighbour equal to 2”.
换 \(\psi\)：用 \(W[h_i\|h_j]\)、用 \(h_i\odot h_j\)、用带关系标签的 \(W_r\)。
Change \(\psi\): use \(W[h_i\|h_j]\), use \(h_i\odot h_j\), use a relation-specific \(W_r\).
换打分方式：点积、加性、多层感知机。注意力家族的大部分变体都在这一格。
Change the scoring rule: dot product, additive, an MLP. Most of the attention family lives in this cell.

判据也随之明确：在相同参数量、相同数据、相同训练预算下，表达能力是否真的变强，并且这种变强是否与任务匹配？ 表达力更强不等于泛化更好——一个能拟合任何函数的算子，也可能只是更快地记住了训练集。这一点在第 6 章还会回来。
The criterion follows: with the same parameter count, data and training budget, is the model genuinely more expressive, and does that extra expressiveness match the task? More expressiveness is not better generalisation — an operator that can fit anything may simply memorise the training set faster. Section 6 returns to this.


5.3 第二类：换底层实现 / Second kind: change the implementation
这一类最容易讲清楚，也最容易被误解成数学创新。先把四个量分开：
This kind is the clearest, and the most often mistaken for mathematical novelty. Start by separating four quantities:

FLOPs（计算量）：这个算子需要多少次浮点运算。矩阵乘 \(m\times n\) 与 \(n\times k\) 是 \(2mnk\)。
FLOPs (work): how many floating-point operations the operator needs. An \(m\times n\) by \(n\times k\) matmul is \(2mnk\).
显存（capacity）：中间结果要占多少字节，决定 batch 能不能放下。
Memory (capacity): how many bytes the intermediates occupy; it decides whether the batch fits.
带宽（bandwidth）：每秒能从显存搬到计算单元多少字节，单位 GB/s。
Bandwidth: bytes per second that can move from memory to the compute units, in GB/s.
吞吐（throughput）：单位时间真正完成的工作量，取决于上面三个以及并行度。
Throughput: work actually finished per unit time, depending on the above plus parallelism.

把它们连起来的是算术强度（arithmetic intensity）：每搬运一个字节，能做多少次浮点运算。
The quantity that links them is arithmetic intensity: how many floating-point operations you get per byte moved.
\[I=\frac{\text{FLOPs}}{\text{bytes moved}}\]
\(I\) 越大，计算越”划算”；\(I\) 越小，程序越像在搬数据而不是在算。两行真实数字可以说明差别有多大：一个 \(1024^3\) 的 fp16 矩阵乘，FLOPs 是 \(2\times1024^3=2.15\times10^{9}\)，搬运 \(3\times1024^2\times2=6.29\) MB，\(I\approx341\)；而一个逐元素加法，每个元素 1 次浮点运算、读写各 2 字节，\(I=0.25\)。相差 1360 倍。
Larger \(I\) is better value; smaller \(I\) means the program is moving data rather than computing. Two real numbers show the spread: a \(1024^3\) fp16 matmul does \(2\times1024^3=2.15\times10^{9}\) FLOPs while moving \(3\times1024^2\times2=6.29\) MB, so \(I\approx341\); an elementwise add does one FLOP per element and moves 2 bytes in plus 2 out, so \(I=0.25\). That is a factor of 1360.


Code
peak <- 300    # TFLOPS, order of magnitude for an fp16 tensor-core accelerator
bw   <- 2000   # GB/s, i.e. 2 TB/s
ai   <- 10^seq(-1.2, 4.2, length.out = 300)
roof <- data.frame(ai = ai, tflops = pmin(peak, ai * bw / 1000))

pts <- data.frame(
  label = c("elementwise add\n(I = 0.25)", "matmul 1024^3\n(I = 341)",
            "matmul 8192^3\n(I = 2731)"),
  ai = c(0.25, 1024 / 3, 8192 / 3)
)
pts$tflops <- pmin(peak, pts$ai * bw / 1000)

ggplot(roof, aes(ai, tflops)) +
  geom_line(colour = op_pal[["blue"]], linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(data = pts, aes(ai, tflops), colour = op_pal[["coral"]], size = 2.6) +
  geom_text(data = pts, aes(ai, tflops, label = label),
            size = 2.6, colour = op_pal[["ink"]], vjust = c(1.6, -0.6, -0.6),
            hjust = c(-0.05, 1.1, 1.1), lineheight = 0.9) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 150, linetype = "22", colour = op_pal[["grey"]], linewidth = 0.4) +
  annotate("text", x = 165, y = 8, label = "ridge  I = 150", size = 2.6,
           colour = op_pal[["grey"]], hjust = 0) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 1),
                expand = expansion(mult = c(0.04, 0.06))) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 1),
                expand = expansion(mult = c(0.06, 0.16))) +
  labs(x = "arithmetic intensity  I  (FLOP / byte)",
       y = "achievable performance  (TFLOPS)") +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 8))








Figure 14: Roofline 模型。斜线段受带宽限制（\(\text{性能}=\text{带宽}\times I\)），水平段受峰值算力限制。设峰值 300 TFLOPS、带宽 2000 GB/s，转折点在 \(I=150\)。逐元素加法落在斜线上（受带宽限制），两个矩阵乘落在水平段（受算力限制）。 | The roofline model. The sloped part is bandwidth-limited (\(\text{perf}=\text{bandwidth}\times I\)); the flat part is compute-limited. With a 300 TFLOPS peak and 2000 GB/s of bandwidth the ridge sits at \(I=150\). An elementwise add lands on the slope (bandwidth-bound); both matmuls land on the plateau (compute-bound).





这张图解释了为什么”优化算子”多数时候是”减少搬运”：如果算子落在斜线上，算力再翻倍也没用，带宽才是天花板。
This figure explains why “optimising an operator” usually means “moving fewer bytes”: if the operator sits on the slope, doubling peak compute changes nothing — bandwidth is the ceiling.
算子融合（operator fusion）是最基本的手段。一段 LayerNorm → GELU 的顺序计算，朴素实现会启动两个 kernel，每个都把整块张量写回显存再读出来；融合之后只有一次读和一次写。
Operator fusion is the most basic lever. A LayerNorm → GELU sequence naively launches two kernels, each writing a full tensor back to memory and reading it again; once fused there is one read and one write.


Code
N <- 1024; d <- 512; bpp <- 2
act <- N * d * bpp / 1e6      # MB
wgt <- d * d * bpp / 1e6      # MB

fz <- data.frame(
  path = factor(rep(c("4 kernels", "1 fused kernel"), c(4, 1)),
                levels = c("1 fused kernel", "4 kernels")),
  grp  = factor(c("matmul", "bias add", "layernorm", "gelu", "fused"),
                levels = c("matmul", "bias add", "layernorm", "gelu", "fused")),
  mb   = c(act + wgt + act, 2 * act, 2 * act, 2 * act, act + wgt + act)
)
tot <- fz %>% group_by(path) %>% summarise(mb = sum(mb), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(fz, aes(mb, path, fill = grp)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.42) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(mb > 1, sprintf("%.2f", mb), "")),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 2.6, colour = "white") +
  geom_text(data = tot, aes(mb, path, label = sprintf("total %.2f MB", mb)),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = -0.12, size = 3.1, colour = op_pal[["ink"]]) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("matmul" = op_pal[["blue"]], "bias add" = op_pal[["teal"]],
                               "layernorm" = op_pal[["orange"]], "gelu" = op_pal[["coral"]],
                               "fused" = op_pal[["blue"]]),
                    name = NULL,
                    breaks = c("matmul", "bias add", "layernorm", "gelu")) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 11.2), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
  labs(x = "MB moved to/from HBM", y = NULL,
       title = sprintf("fusion cuts traffic by %.1fx", tot$mb[2] / tot$mb[1])) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9), legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.text = element_text(size = 7.4), legend.key.size = unit(0.34, "cm"),
        legend.box.margin = margin(t = 2))








Figure 15: 算子融合前后的显存往返。设 fp16、\(N=1024\)、\(d=512\)：激活张量 1.05 MB，权重 0.52 MB。四个独立 kernel 一共搬 8.91 MB，融合成一个 kernel 后只需 2.62 MB，约为原来的 1/3.4。这是按张量形状算出的下界，不是实测时间。 | Memory traffic before and after fusion. With fp16, \(N=1024\), \(d=512\): a 1.05 MB activation and a 0.52 MB weight. Four separate kernels move 8.91 MB; a single fused kernel needs 2.62 MB, about 1/3.4. This is a lower bound computed from tensor shapes, not a measured runtime.





FlashAttention 是同一逻辑做到极致的例子。3.6 节拆过注意力的四个框，朴素实现会把 \(n\times n\) 的分数矩阵整个写进显存：\(n=1024\)、\(d=64\)、fp16 时，这个矩阵是 2.10 MB，而 \(Q,K,V\) 各只有 0.13 MB。分数矩阵要被写一次、读一次，softmax 之后再写一次、读一次——\(n^2\) 这一项的往返完全盖过了真正的计算。
FlashAttention is the same logic taken to the limit. Section 3.6 decomposed attention into four boxes; the naive implementation writes the full \(n\times n\) score matrix to memory. At \(n=1024\), \(d=64\), fp16, that matrix is 2.10 MB while \(Q,K,V\) are 0.13 MB each. The score matrix is written once and read once, then the same again after softmax — the \(n^2\) round trips completely dominate the actual arithmetic.


Code
N <- 1024; d <- 64; bpp <- 2
sz_nd <- N * d * bpp / 1e6       # MB per N x d tensor
sz_nn <- N * N * bpp / 1e6       # MB per N x N matrix

flash <- data.frame(
  item = c("Q,K,V read", "S write", "S read", "P write", "P read", "O write"),
  mb   = c(3 * sz_nd, sz_nn, sz_nn, sz_nn, sz_nn, sz_nd),
  path = "naive"
)
f2 <- data.frame(item = c("Q,K,V read", "O write"),
                 mb = c(3 * sz_nd, sz_nd), path = "tiled")
fl <- rbind(flash, f2)
fl$item <- factor(fl$item, levels = c("Q,K,V read", "S write", "S read",
                                      "P write", "P read", "O write"))
fl$path <- factor(fl$path, levels = c("naive", "tiled"))

tot2 <- data.frame(path = factor(c("naive", "tiled"), levels = c("naive", "tiled")),
                   mb = c(sum(flash$mb), sum(f2$mb)))

ggplot(fl, aes(mb, path, fill = item)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(mb > 0.4, sprintf("%.2f", mb), "")),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 2.5, colour = "white") +
  geom_text(data = tot2, aes(mb, path, label = sprintf("%.2f MB", mb)),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = -0.15, size = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Q,K,V read" = op_pal[["blue"]], "S write" = op_pal[["teal"]],
                               "S read" = "#6FB3A6", "P write" = op_pal[["orange"]],
                               "P read" = "#F7C46C", "O write" = op_pal[["coral"]]),
                    name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.13))) +
  labs(x = "MB moved to/from HBM", y = NULL,
       title = sprintf("naive %.2f MB vs tiled %.2f MB  (%.1fx)",
                       sum(flash$mb), sum(f2$mb), sum(flash$mb) / sum(f2$mb))) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9), legend.text = element_text(size = 7.4),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.34, "cm"), legend.position = "bottom")








Figure 16: 注意力在 \(N=1024\)、\(d=64\)、fp16 下的 HBM 往返（MB）。朴素实现把 \(N\times N\) 的分数矩阵与概率矩阵物化，四次往返共 8.91 MB；分块实现让 \(N\times N\) 块留在片上 SRAM，只搬 \(Q,K,V\) 与输出，共 0.52 MB，相差约 17 倍。 | HBM traffic for attention at \(N=1024\), \(d=64\), fp16, in MB. The naive path materialises the \(N\times N\) score and probability matrices: four round trips, 8.91 MB. The tiled path keeps \(N\times N\) tiles in on-chip SRAM and only moves \(Q,K,V\) plus the output: 0.52 MB, roughly 17x less.





关键在于：FlashAttention 没有改变注意力的数学。它把 \(Q,K,V\) 切块放进片上内存，用在线 softmax 分批累积，反向传播时重算而不是存下中间矩阵。输出与标准实现数值等价（差别只在浮点误差量级），所以它属于第二类，不属于第一类。原作者报告的单算子加速在 2–4 倍量级，具体数字随序列长度、头维度、硬件变化；真正值得记住的是那句判断：它省的是字节，不是 FLOPs——FLOPs 甚至因为重算而略有增加。
The crucial point: FlashAttention does not change the mathematics of attention. It tiles \(Q,K,V\) into on-chip memory, accumulates with an online softmax, and recomputes intermediates in the backward pass instead of storing them. The output is numerically equivalent to the standard path (differences at the level of floating-point error), so it belongs to the second kind, not the first. The authors report 2–4x single-operator speedups, varying with sequence length, head dimension and hardware; what is worth remembering is the judgement: it saves bytes, not FLOPs — FLOPs even rise slightly because of recomputation.
第二类的判据因此很干脆：输出是否等价？如果是，就只能用时间、显存、能耗来比较，不能用”效果更好”来宣称。
The criterion for the second kind is therefore blunt: is the output equivalent? If so, it may only be compared on time, memory and energy — never advertised as “better results”.


5.4 第三类：换整体设计 / Third kind: change the design
第三类连算子都不换，换的是拼装方式：
The third kind does not even change the operators; it changes how they are wired:

残差连接：\(y=x+f(x)\)。\(f\) 里的算子一个没变，但梯度多了一条恒等通路，深层网络才训得动。
Residual connections: \(y=x+f(x)\). Not one operator inside \(f\) changes, yet gradients get an identity path and deep networks become trainable.
归一化的位置：pre-LN 与 post-LN 用的是同一个 LayerNorm，训练稳定性差别很大。
Placement of normalisation: pre-LN and post-LN use the same LayerNorm, with very different training stability.
混合专家（MoE）：把一个大前馈层换成若干专家加一个路由。路由是新的，专家内部的算子还是原来的。
Mixture of experts: one large feed-forward layer becomes several experts plus a router. The router is new; the operators inside each expert are the same.
KV 缓存：推理时把已经算过的键值存下来，不改变任何数学，只改变重复计算。
The KV cache: store keys and values already computed, changing no mathematics, only recomputation.

这些改动的价值可能远大于任何一个算子，但它们不该被描述成”新算子”。反过来也成立：一个数学上很漂亮的新算子，如果放进现有架构里和别的东西冲突（比如破坏归一化的尺度假设），端到端可能一无所得。
The value of such changes can far exceed that of any single operator, but they should not be described as “new operators”. The converse also holds: a mathematically elegant new operator that conflicts with its surroundings (say, it breaks a normalisation’s scale assumption) may deliver nothing end to end.


5.5 三类对照 / The three kinds side by side










第一类 机制 / mechanism
第二类 实现 / implementation
第三类 设计 / design




改变了什么 / changes
数学映射本身 / the mapping itself
数据怎么搬 / how data moves
算子怎么拼 / how ops are wired


输出是否等价 / output equivalent
不等价 / no
等价 / yes
不等价 / no


该用什么指标 / metric
表达能力、同预算下的精度、泛化 / expressiveness, accuracy at equal budget, generalisation
延迟、吞吐、显存峰值、能耗 / latency, throughput, peak memory, energy
端到端指标、训练稳定性、数据效率 / end-to-end metrics, stability, data efficiency


典型例子 / examples
GIN 的求和聚合、GAT、RGAT / sum aggregation in GIN, GAT, RGAT
算子融合、FlashAttention、稀疏化 / fusion, FlashAttention, sparsity
残差、pre-LN、MoE、KV 缓存 / residuals, pre-LN, MoE, KV cache


常见误读 / common misreading
“更强所以更好” / “more expressive, therefore better”
“更快所以是数学创新” / “faster, therefore novel mathematics”
“整体更好所以是新算子” / “better overall, therefore a new operator”

With this table the question list at the end of section 8 has a basis. First, a more fundamental question: if you really want to build a new operator, where do you start?

title: From One Multiplication to a Whole Network: Operators in AI
section: 6. 能不能自己发明一种算子？ / Can you invent an operator yourself?
text:
6. 能不能自己发明一种算子？ / Can you invent an operator yourself?
可以，而且门槛比想象的低——难的不是写出公式，而是证明它值得存在。这一节从一个最朴素的线性式出发，一步步加东西，看每一步多出了什么、代价是什么。
Yes, and the barrier is lower than it looks. What is hard is not writing the formula but showing it deserves to exist. Start from the plainest linear expression and add one thing at a time, watching what each step buys and what it costs.

6.1 一步步把一个线性式改造掉 / Mutating a linear expression, one step at a time
第 0 步：\(y=wx\)。一个标量权重，能表达的只有过原点的直线。
Step 0: \(y=wx\). One scalar weight; the only functions it can express are lines through the origin.
第 1 步：\(y=wx+b\)。加一个偏置，直线可以平移。参数量 1 → 2，能力没有质变。
Step 1: \(y=wx+b\). Add a bias and the line can shift. Parameters go 1 → 2; nothing qualitative changes.
第 2 步：\(y=\sigma(wx+b)\)。外面套一个非线性。这一步是质变的开始：单层感知机仍然不能表示 XOR，但一旦把若干个这样的单元并排、再叠一层，就能表示任意连续函数（万能逼近）。注意”能表示”不等于”少量参数就能表示”——这是后面所有争论的根源。
Step 2: \(y=\sigma(wx+b)\). Wrap it in a nonlinearity. This is where things change qualitatively: a single perceptron still cannot represent XOR, but a few of these units side by side, stacked one more layer, can represent any continuous function (universal approximation). Note that “can represent” is not “can represent with few parameters” — that gap is the root of every later argument.
第 3 步：\(y=w_1x_1+w_2x_2+w_{12}x_1x_2\)。加一个交互项。前两步里两个输入只能各自贡献、然后相加；有了 \(x_1x_2\)，一个输入的效果取决于另一个输入的取值。用统计的话说，这从”主效应模型”变成了”带交互的模型”。
Step 3: \(y=w_1x_1+w_2x_2+w_{12}x_1x_2\). Add an interaction term. In the first two steps the two inputs contribute separately and are then summed; with \(x_1x_2\) the effect of one input depends on the value of the other. In statistical language this moves from a main-effects model to one with interactions.
第 4 步：\(y_i=\sum_j a_{ij}(x)\,v_j\)，其中 \(a_{ij}\) 是输入的函数，而且 \(\sum_j a_{ij}=1\)。这就是注意力的骨架。把它和第 0 步对比会发现：数学形式几乎一样，唯一的区别是权重不再是参数，而是输入的函数。注意力之所以强，就强在这一处；它之所以贵，也贵在这一处——每来一个输入都要重新算一遍权重。
Step 4: \(y_i=\sum_j a_{ij}(x)\,v_j\), where \(a_{ij}\) is a function of the input and \(\sum_j a_{ij}=1\). That is the skeleton of attention. Compare it with step 0 and the mathematical form is almost identical: the only difference is that the weights are no longer parameters but functions of the input. That single change is why attention is powerful, and also why it is expensive — the weights must be recomputed for every new input.
第 5 步：\(y_i=\sum_{r}\sum_{j\in\mathcal{N}_r(i)} a_{ij}^{(r)}(x)\,W_r\,v_j\)。加上邻接结构和关系类型，就是第 4 章的 RGAT。到这里，“算子”这个词已经覆盖了从 2 个参数到上亿参数的整条谱系。
Step 5: \(y_i=\sum_{r}\sum_{j\in\mathcal{N}_r(i)} a_{ij}^{(r)}(x)\,W_r\,v_j\). Add adjacency and relation types and you have the RGAT of section 4. By now “operator” spans the whole range from 2 parameters to hundreds of millions.
这条路径值得记住的地方是：每一步都只改了一个地方。真正被引用的新算子，几乎都能被这样拆成”在某一步换了某个部件”，而不是凭空出现。
What is worth remembering is that each step changed exactly one thing. Almost every new operator that gets cited can be decomposed this way — some component of some step was swapped — rather than appearing out of nowhere.


6.2 六个可以拧的旋钮 / Six knobs you can turn
把 3.7 节那个消息传递公式拆开，可调的地方其实不多：
Decompose the message-passing formula from section 3.7 and there are only a few places to intervene:


Code
card <- data.frame(
  x = rep(c(1, 2, 3), times = 2),
  y = rep(c(2, 1), each = 3),
  head = c("1  聚合 aggregation", "2  打分 scoring", "3  参数共享 sharing",
           "4  关系 relation", "5  稀疏 sparsity", "6  归一化 normalisation"),
  body = c("mean / sum / max / softmax\n影响：度数信息保不保留",
           "dot / additive / MLP\n影响：相似性怎么定义",
           "全局 / 每层 / 每关系\n影响：参数量与迁移性",
           "无 / 有类型 / 带符号\n影响：异质边怎么处理",
           "全连接 / kNN / 局部窗口\n影响：成本与感受野",
           "无 / softmax / L2\n影响：消息尺度的稳定性")
)

ggplot(card) +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = x - 0.46, xmax = x + 0.46, ymin = y - 0.40, ymax = y + 0.40),
            fill = op_pal[["pale"]], colour = op_pal[["blue"]], linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_text(aes(x, y + 0.26, label = head), size = 3.2, fontface = "bold",
            colour = op_pal[["blue"]]) +
  geom_text(aes(x, y - 0.02, label = body), size = 2.6, lineheight = 1.05,
            colour = op_pal[["ink"]]) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0.45, 3.55), ylim = c(0.5, 2.5)) +
  plain








Figure 17: 设计一个新算子时可以拧的六个旋钮。每个旋钮下面给出可选做法与它主要影响的东西。真正的新算子通常只动其中一两个，其余保持不变——这也是做消融实验时该控制的变量。 | Six knobs available when designing an operator, each with its options and what it mainly affects. A genuine new operator usually turns only one or two of them and leaves the rest fixed — which is exactly what an ablation must control for.





一个诚实的提醒：这六个旋钮并不是独立的。改聚合函数会改变梯度尺度，改稀疏性会改变有效感受野，改归一化会改变最优学习率。所以”只换了一个算子”的实验，往往需要重新调超参数才算公平比较——很多”新算子更好”的结论，差的就是这一步。
An honest caveat: the six knobs are not independent. Changing the aggregation changes gradient scale, changing sparsity changes the effective receptive field, changing normalisation changes the optimal learning rate. So an experiment that “swaps one operator” usually needs its hyperparameters retuned before the comparison is fair — and that missing step explains many “the new operator is better” claims.


6.3 一个能跑的小实验：聚合函数不是中立的 / A runnable experiment: aggregation is not neutral
取 400 个假想节点，每个节点有 5 个邻居，邻居的值来自标准正态分布。定义三个任务：预测邻居的和、均值、最大值。然后分别用三种聚合去拟合，看均方误差。
Take 400 synthetic nodes with 5 neighbours each, neighbour values drawn from a standard normal. Define three tasks — predict the sum, the mean and the max of the neighbours — then fit each with each of the three aggregations and compare mean squared error.


Code
set.seed(20261029)
G <- 400; K <- 5
H <- matrix(rnorm(G * K), G, K)

truth <- list(sum = rowSums(H), mean = rowMeans(H), max = apply(H, 1, max))
fitted <- list(sum = rowSums(H), mean = rowMeans(H), max = apply(H, 1, max))

grid <- expand.grid(agg = names(fitted), task = names(truth), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
grid$mse <- mapply(function(a, t) mean((fitted[[a]] - truth[[t]])^2), grid$agg, grid$task)
grid$agg  <- factor(grid$agg,  levels = c("sum", "mean", "max"))
grid$task <- factor(grid$task, levels = c("sum", "mean", "max"))

ggplot(grid, aes(agg, mse, fill = task)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.78), width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", mse)),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.78), vjust = -0.45, size = 2.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = unname(op_pal[c("blue", "teal", "orange")]),
                    name = "task") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.14))) +
  labs(x = "aggregation", y = "MSE vs. the true target") +
  theme(legend.position = "right")








Figure 18: 聚合函数与任务假设必须匹配。固定读出（直接用聚合值作预测）时，对角线上误差为 0，非对角线落在 1.6–5.1 之间。注意这只说明「聚合编码了假设」，不说明某种聚合普遍更差——若下游有可学习的读出层，知道度数时求和可以精确还原均值。 | Aggregation must match the task assumption. With a fixed readout (the aggregate is the prediction), the diagonal has zero error and off-diagonal entries lie between 1.6 and 5.1. This shows that aggregation encodes an assumption; it does not show that any aggregation is universally worse — with a learnable readout and known degree, a sum reconstructs the mean exactly.





读法很直接：每一行里只有一根柱子的高度是 0。没有普适最优的聚合，只有和任务假设匹配的聚合。这解释了两件看起来矛盾的事：GIN 证明求和最有表达力（因为它能区分不同的多重集，而均值会丢掉度数），但这个实验里均值在自己的任务上误差为 0。两者都对——表达力是关于”能表示什么”，误差是关于”在这个任务上表示得好不好”。
Read it directly: in each row exactly one bar has height zero. There is no universally best aggregation, only one that matches the task assumption. This reconciles two apparently contradictory facts: GIN proves that sum is the most expressive aggregation (it distinguishes multisets, whereas the mean erases the degree), yet in this experiment the mean has zero error on its own task. Both are right — expressiveness is about what can be represented; error is about how well it is represented on this task.


6.4 什么才算有意义的创新 / What counts as a meaningful contribution
把上面的讨论收成一份清单。一个新的算子要成立，至少得在下面几项里站住一项，并且在其余项上不塌：
Condense the discussion into a checklist. For a new operator to stand, it must win on at least one of these and not collapse on the others:

新的数学运算或参数化：确实定义了一个之前没有的映射，而不仅是重命名。
A genuinely new operation or parameterisation: a mapping that did not exist before, not a renaming.
不同的归纳偏置：假设改变了，而且这个新假设与目标任务的结构相符。
A different inductive bias: the assumption changed, and the new assumption matches the structure of the target task.
更合理的信息传播：多跳、异质、带符号、带方向的信息如何汇合，有了明确的机制而不是靠加深层数硬凑。
More sensible information propagation: a mechanism for multi-hop, heterogeneous, signed or directed information instead of brute-force depth.
更高的计算效率：单位效果的成本下降，且这种下降来自结构而不是实现技巧。
Higher efficiency: lower cost per unit of performance, and the gain comes from structure rather than implementation tricks.
更好的预测性能：在同参数、同数据、同预算下比较，并且报告方差与训练成本。
Better predictive performance: compared at equal parameters, data and budget, with variance and training cost reported.
更可靠的泛化：跨数据集、跨规模（序列更长、图更大、物种不同）仍然成立。
More reliable generalisation: it survives across datasets and across scale — longer sequences, larger graphs, different species.

验证的顺序也有讲究，顺序错了会得出假阳性：先做理论分析（表达力、等变性、复杂度），再做受控消融（一次只改一处，超参数各自调好），最后才是benchmark（多个任务、多个随机种子、报告均值与标准差）。只做最后一步，几乎总能找到某个数据集上更好看的数字。
The order of validation matters; getting it wrong produces false positives. Start with theory (expressiveness, equivariance, complexity), then a controlled ablation (one change at a time, each with its own tuned hyperparameters), and only then a benchmark (several tasks, several seeds, mean and standard deviation). Skip to the last step alone and you will almost always find some dataset where the numbers look better.
还有一条常被忽略的：负结果也要报。一个算子如果在某些条件下更差，说清楚这些条件比藏起来更有价值——它恰好告诉后来者这个算子的边界在哪里。
One more thing is routinely omitted: report the negative results. Stating the conditions under which an operator is worse is more valuable than hiding them — it tells the next person exactly where the boundary lies.

title: From One Multiplication to a Whole Network: Operators in AI
section: 7. AI 虚拟细胞需要什么样的算子？ / What operators does a virtual cell need?
text:
7. AI 虚拟细胞需要什么样的算子？ / What operators does a virtual cell need?
前面六章的例子大多来自图像和语言。生物学的问题不太一样：数据更稀疏、噪声更大、可做的干预更贵，而且因果关系藏在结构里。这一节把算子放回生物学的语境里看。
Most examples so far came from images and language. Biology differs: the data are sparser and noisier, interventions are expensive, and causality lives in the structure. This section puts operators back into a biological setting.

7.1 生物学问题长什么样 / What the biological problem looks like
以 Perturb-seq 为例：用 CRISPR 敲掉一个基因，然后用单细胞 RNA 测序读出成千上万个细胞的全转录组。得到的是”扰动 → 表达谱变化”的配对数据。想做的事通常是预测没做过的扰动，而不是记住做过的那些。
Take Perturb-seq: knock out a gene with CRISPR, then read the transcriptome of thousands of single cells. The result is paired data of “perturbation → expression change”. The usual goal is to predict perturbations that were never performed, not to memorise the ones that were.
这件事难在三点，每一点都直接指向算子的选择：
Three things make it hard, and each points straight at a choice of operator:

稀疏且高维：一个细胞里多数基因的计数是 0，信噪比很低。归一化和聚合方式会显著影响结果。
Sparse and high-dimensional: most genes in a cell have zero counts and the signal-to-noise ratio is low. Normalisation and aggregation matter a lot.
结构先验是已知的：基因不是独立变量，调控关系、通路成员、蛋白互作都是已知知识。用不用、怎么用，是归纳偏置的问题。
Structural priors exist: genes are not independent; regulatory relations, pathway membership and protein interactions are known. Whether and how to use them is a question of inductive bias.
干预有方向、有符号：激活和抑制是两件事，敲除和过表达也是两件事。把它们压成同一种边，会丢掉关键信息。
Interventions have direction and sign: activation and inhibition differ, and so do knockout and overexpression. Collapsing them into one kind of edge discards the key information.



7.2 一个 5 个基因的调控网络 / A five-gene regulatory network
下面的网络取自教科书里最经典的 p53 通路骨架，只保留 5 个基因和 6 条边。边的符号不是装饰：TP53 转录激活 MDM2，MDM2 反过来抑制 TP53（负反馈），TP53 激活 CDKN1A 与 BAX，MYC 抑制 CDKN1A 与 BAX。
The network below is the textbook p53 backbone, trimmed to five genes and six edges. The signs are not decoration: TP53 transcriptionally activates MDM2, MDM2 inhibits TP53 in return (negative feedback), TP53 activates CDKN1A and BAX, and MYC inhibits CDKN1A and BAX.


Code
g_genes <- data.frame(
  id = c("TP53", "MDM2", "CDKN1A", "BAX", "MYC"),
  x  = c(0, 1.55, 0.62, 2.32, -1.55),
  y  = c(0.95, 1.85, -1.10, -1.28, 0.45)
)
g_edges <- data.frame(
  from = c("TP53", "MDM2", "TP53", "TP53", "MYC", "MYC"),
  to   = c("MDM2", "TP53", "CDKN1A", "BAX", "CDKN1A", "BAX"),
  sgn  = c(1, -1, 1, 1, -1, -1),
  crv  = c(-0.45, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
)
g_edges$x    <- g_genes$x[match(g_edges$from, g_genes$id)]
g_edges$y    <- g_genes$y[match(g_edges$from, g_genes$id)]
g_edges$xend <- g_genes$x[match(g_edges$to,   g_genes$id)]
g_edges$yend <- g_genes$y[match(g_edges$to,   g_genes$id)]
dx <- g_edges$xend - g_edges$x; dy <- g_edges$yend - g_edges$y
dd <- sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2)
g_edges$x    <- g_edges$x    + 0.34 * dx / dd
g_edges$y    <- g_edges$y    + 0.34 * dy / dd
g_edges$xend <- g_edges$xend - 0.34 * dx / dd
g_edges$yend <- g_edges$yend - 0.34 * dy / dd

p_grn <- ggplot() +
  # activation: TP53 -> MDM2, bowed one way
  geom_curve(data = g_edges[g_edges$crv != 0 & g_edges$sgn > 0, ],
             aes(x, y, xend = xend, yend = yend),
             curvature = -0.42, colour = op_pal[["blue"]], linewidth = 0.6,
             arrow = arrow_op) +
  geom_segment(data = g_edges[g_edges$crv == 0 & g_edges$sgn > 0, ],
               aes(x, y, xend = xend, yend = yend),
               colour = op_pal[["blue"]], linewidth = 0.6, arrow = arrow_op) +
  # inhibition: MDM2 -> TP53 bowed the other way, plus MYC -> CDKN1A / BAX
  geom_curve(data = g_edges[g_edges$from == "MDM2", ],
             aes(x = xend, y = yend, xend = x, yend = y),
             curvature = 0.42, colour = op_pal[["coral"]], linewidth = 0.6,
             arrow = arrow_op, linetype = "22") +
  geom_segment(data = g_edges[g_edges$crv == 0 & g_edges$sgn < 0, ],
               aes(x, y, xend = xend, yend = yend),
               colour = op_pal[["coral"]], linewidth = 0.6,
               arrow = arrow_op, linetype = "22") +
  geom_point(data = g_genes, aes(x, y), size = 17, shape = 21,
             fill = op_pal[["pale"]], colour = op_pal[["ink"]], stroke = 0.45) +
  geom_point(data = g_genes[g_genes$id == "TP53", ], aes(x, y), size = 19.5,
             shape = 21, fill = NA, colour = op_pal[["grey"]], stroke = 0.7) +
  geom_text(data = g_genes, aes(x, y, label = id), size = 2.6) +
  annotate("text", x = -0.45, y = 0.95, label = "KO", size = 2.9, hjust = 1,
           colour = op_pal[["grey"]]) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-2.35, 2.95), ylim = c(-1.85, 2.25)) +
  labs(title = "p53 regulatory backbone") + plain

p_grn








Figure 19: 一个 5 基因的调控网络。实线蓝箭头表示激活（TP53→MDM2、TP53→CDKN1A、TP53→BAX），虚线珊瑚线表示抑制（MDM2⊣TP53、MYC⊣CDKN1A、MYC⊣BAX）。TP53 与 MDM2 构成负反馈环，这是整张网络里最需要「关系感知」的一处：任何把它们当成对称边的模型都会算错稳态。灰色圈标出下文被扰动的基因。 | A five-gene regulatory network. Solid blue arrows are activations (TP53→MDM2, TP53→CDKN1A, TP53→BAX) and dashed coral lines are inhibitions (MDM2⊣TP53, MYC⊣CDKN1A, MYC⊣BAX). TP53 and MDM2 form a negative-feedback loop — the place where relation-awareness matters most: any model that treats them as symmetric edges gets the steady state wrong. The grey ring marks the gene perturbed below.





这里每个符号都会在计算里用到。把 \(-0.7\) 取成绝对值，“MYC 抑制 CDKN1A”就变成了”MYC 激活 CDKN1A”，过表达 MYC 的预测方向会整个翻过来——7.3 节会把这个例子算出来。
Every sign here enters the computation. Take the absolute value of \(-0.7\) and “MYC inhibits CDKN1A” becomes “MYC activates CDKN1A”, which flips the predicted direction of MYC overexpression entirely — section 7.3 works that example through.


7.3 扰动如何传播：符号在哪一步显形 / How a perturbation propagates, and where the sign shows up
用一个最小的线性动力学模型表示细胞状态。表达向量 \(h_t\) 每一步受两个因素影响：自身的衰减，以及上游基因的调控。
Use a minimal linear dynamical model for cell state. At each step the expression vector \(h_t\) is driven by two things: its own decay and regulation from upstream genes.
\[h_{t+1}=(1-\alpha)\,h_t+\alpha\,\big(W h_t + b\big)\]
\(W\) 的第 \(i\) 行第 \(j\) 列是”\(j\) 调控 \(i\)“的强度，带符号；\(b\) 是基础转录水平，\(\alpha\) 控制更新速度。稳态满足 \(h^\ast=(I-W)^{-1}b\)。敲除等价于每一步把那个分量钳在 0，过表达等价于钳在一个更高的值——两者都是”对某个坐标施加外部约束”，不需要改 \(W\) 本身。这个模型比 \(\tanh\) 版本更朴素，但它把符号的作用暴露得最清楚。
The \((i,j)\) entry of \(W\) is the signed strength with which \(j\) regulates \(i\); \(b\) is basal transcription and \(\alpha\) sets the update rate. The steady state satisfies \(h^\ast=(I-W)^{-1}b\). A knockout clamps that component to 0 at every step, and overexpression clamps it higher — both are external constraints on one coordinate, with \(W\) untouched. This model is plainer than the \(\tanh\) version, which is exactly why it exposes what the sign does.
下面的实验把 MYC 钳到 2.0（过表达），分别在两种模型里跑：一种是带符号的 \(W\)，另一种把两条抑制边的符号去掉。
The experiment below clamps MYC at 2.0 (overexpression) and runs it in two models: one with the signed \(W\), and one where the two inhibitory edges have lost their sign.


Code
genes <- c("TP53", "MDM2", "CDKN1A", "BAX", "MYC")
W <- matrix(0, 5, 5, dimnames = list(genes, genes))
W["MDM2",   "TP53"] <-  1.0
W["TP53",   "MDM2"] <- -0.8
W["CDKN1A", "TP53"] <-  1.2
W["BAX",    "TP53"] <-  0.9
W["CDKN1A", "MYC"]  <- -0.7
W["BAX",    "MYC"]  <- -0.3
b <- c(TP53 = 1.2, MDM2 = 1.0, CDKN1A = 1.25, BAX = 0.9, MYC = 1.0)
alpha <- 0.4

run <- function(Wm, clamp = NULL, steps = 400) {
  h <- b
  for (i in seq_len(steps)) {
    h <- (1 - alpha) * h + alpha * (as.vector(Wm %*% h) + b)
    h[h < 0] <- 0
    if (!is.null(clamp)) h[names(clamp)] <- clamp
  }
  h
}

W_blind <- W                                    # lose the sign of inhibition only
W_blind[c("CDKN1A", "BAX"), c("MYC")] <- abs(W[c("CDKN1A", "BAX"), c("MYC")])

st <- rbind(
  data.frame(model = "signed W",  gene = genes,
             base = run(W)[genes], pert = run(W, c(MYC = 2.0))[genes]),
  data.frame(model = "sign-blind", gene = genes,
             base = run(W_blind)[genes], pert = run(W_blind, c(MYC = 2.0))[genes])
)
st$gene <- factor(st$gene, levels = rev(genes))
st$model <- factor(st$model, levels = c("signed W", "sign-blind"))
st$dir <- ifelse(st$pert > st$base, "up", "down")

ggplot(st, aes(y = gene)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = base, xend = pert, yend = gene, colour = dir),
               arrow = grid::arrow(length = grid::unit(0.075, "inches"), type = "closed"),
               linewidth = 0.65) +
  geom_point(aes(x = base), colour = op_pal[["grey"]], size = 2.2) +
  geom_point(aes(x = pert), colour = op_pal[["blue"]], size = 2.6) +
  geom_text(aes(x = pmax(base, pert), label = sprintf("%.2f", pert)),
            vjust = -0.85, size = 2.5, colour = op_pal[["blue"]], hjust = 0.3) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(up = op_pal[["orange"]], down = op_pal[["coral"]]),
                      guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 3.35), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.02))) +
  facet_wrap(~ model) +
  labs(x = "steady-state expression", y = NULL) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9))








Figure 20: MYC 过表达的稳态预测。每个面板是一个模型：实心点是基线，箭头指向过表达后的稳态。带符号的模型预测 CDKN1A 与 BAX 下降；把两条抑制边的符号去掉之后，同样的网络预测它们上升。TP53 与 MDM2 在两个面板里都不动，因为从 MYC 出发没有到达它们的路径。 | Predicted steady state under MYC overexpression. Each panel is one model: the solid dot is baseline and the arrow points to the overexpressed steady state. With signs, CDKN1A and BAX fall; after dropping the sign on the two inhibitory edges the same network predicts they rise. TP53 and MDM2 do not move in either panel, because no path from MYC reaches them.





读数：带符号的模型给出 CDKN1A \(0.82\to0.12\)、BAX \(0.80\to0.50\)，两个都下降；符号丢失的模型给出 \(2.22\to2.92\) 与 \(1.40\to1.70\)，两个都上升。同一批参数、同一张图，方向完全相反，差别只在于”抑制”这个概念有没有在参数里占据一个位置。
Reading it: the signed model gives CDKN1A \(0.82\to0.12\) and BAX \(0.80\to0.50\), both falling; the sign-blind model gives \(2.22\to2.92\) and \(1.40\to1.70\), both rising. Same numbers, same graph, opposite directions — the only difference is whether “inhibition” had a place in the parameters.
这里有个反直觉的细节值得单独说：如果把扰动换成敲除 TP53，两种模型给出的变化量完全一样（CDKN1A 都是 \(-0.27\)，BAX 都是 \(-0.20\)）。原因是线性模型里未改动的 MYC 项在相减时抵消了，符号错误被完全藏起来。换句话说，符号错误只在扰动”符号被弄错的那个基因”时才会显形。 这正好解释了为什么只用少数几个扰动做 benchmark 很容易漏掉结构性错误：你测的那些扰动，可能恰好落在错误不显形的位置上。
One counter-intuitive detail deserves its own paragraph: switch the perturbation to a TP53 knockout and both models give identical changes (CDKN1A \(-0.27\), BAX \(-0.20\) in both). In a linear model the untouched MYC term cancels in the difference, so the sign error is completely hidden. In other words, a sign error only becomes visible when you perturb the very gene whose sign you got wrong. That is exactly why a benchmark built on a handful of perturbations easily misses structural errors: the perturbations you happened to test may sit where the error does not show.
这也是关系感知算子存在的理由。它不是一个更花哨的打分函数，而是唯一能让”抑制”这个概念在计算里有位置的写法；而它的价值要靠在正确的扰动实验上验证，否则连带符号的模型都能在你选的 benchmark 上打平。
That is the reason relation-aware operators exist. They are not a fancier scoring function but the only way for “inhibition” to occupy a place in the computation — and their value must be demonstrated on the right perturbation experiments, or a sign-blind model will tie with them on your benchmark.


7.4 非配对多组学：对齐是一个模块，不是一个算子 / Unpaired multi-omics: alignment is a module
真实数据里常常没有配对样本：一批细胞测了 RNA，另一批测了 ATAC，来自不同病人、不同批次。要把它们放在同一个空间里比较，需要对齐。
Real data often lack paired samples: one batch of cells has RNA, another has ATAC, from different patients and batches. Comparing them in one space requires alignment.
常见做法是学一个共享的嵌入：两个模态各自的编码器把细胞映射到同一空间，再用对比损失把”应该是同一个细胞状态”的样本拉近、其余推远。也有工作用最优传输（optimal transport）显式求一个跨模态的匹配方案。
The usual approach learns a shared embedding: an encoder per modality maps cells into one space, and a contrastive loss pulls together samples that should represent the same state while pushing the rest apart. Other work solves for an explicit cross-modality matching with optimal transport.
按第 5 章的分类，这类工作多半属于模块级：对比损失是一个训练目标，不是前向传播里的算子；最优传输求解是训练循环里的一步，也不进推理图。它们的价值可能非常大，但把它们称作”新算子”会掩盖真正起作用的机制——真正进入推理的，还是编码器里的线性层、注意力和归一化。
By the taxonomy of section 5, most of this work is module level: a contrastive loss is a training objective, not an operator in the forward pass; an optimal-transport solver is a step in the training loop and never enters the inference graph. The value can be enormous, but calling it a “new operator” hides the mechanism actually at work — what enters inference is still the linear layers, attention and normalisation inside the encoders.


7.5 先验该有多硬 / How hard should the prior be
同一个生物学网络，可以用三种强度塞进模型：
The same biological network can be injected at three strengths:

硬先验：把调控边写死成邻接矩阵，模型只能在这些边上传递消息。省数据、可解释，但发现不了新机制——没被写进网络的调控关系永远不会被预测出来。
Hard prior: bake the edges into the adjacency matrix; messages may only travel along them. Data-efficient and interpretable, but unable to discover new mechanisms — a regulation absent from the network can never be predicted.
软先验：把已知边作为初始权重或额外的注意力偏置，允许模型偏离。既能利用知识，又保留余地。
Soft prior: use known edges as initial weights or as an additive bias on attention, letting the model deviate. It exploits knowledge while leaving room.
学出来的结构：从数据里推断图（例如用基因共表达或注意力权重反推），先验只体现在”稀疏”“低秩”这类约束上。数据需求大，但可能发现未记录的调控。
Learned structure: infer the graph from data (say, from co-expression or attention weights), with the prior living only in constraints such as sparsity or low rank. Data-hungry, but able to surface undocumented regulation.

三种选择没有对错，只有与问题的匹配度。预测已知通路上某个基因的敲除效应，硬先验通常最划算；寻找新的调控因子，硬先验则是自我设限。现成的虚拟细胞模型各自站在不同的位置：GEARS 用基因本体图做归纳偏置来预测扰动，scGPT 与 Geneformer 则在大量单细胞语料上预训练、再用少量扰动数据微调。它们的差别不在”谁的算子更先进”，而在于把多少生物学结构写进了计算。
None of the three is right or wrong; only the match to the question matters. For predicting a knockout inside a known pathway, a hard prior is usually the best value; for finding new regulators it is self-imposed blindness. Existing virtual-cell models sit at different points: GEARS uses gene-ontology graphs as an inductive bias for perturbation prediction, while scGPT and Geneformer pretrain on large single-cell corpora and fine-tune on smaller perturbation sets. Their difference is not “whose operator is more advanced” but how much biological structure is written into the computation.

section: 8. 总结：算子、架构与能力 / Operators, architectures and capability
text:
8. 总结：算子、架构与能力 / Operators, architectures and capability
八章下来，“算子”这个词被拆成了好几层。最后用一张图把它们叠回去，顺序是从下往上：越往下越抽象、越接近定义；越往上越具体、越接近产品。
Eight sections have split the word “operator” into several layers. One figure stacks them back together, bottom to top: the lower you go, the more abstract and definitional; the higher, the more concrete and product-like.


Code
hier <- data.frame(
  y = 7:1,
  name = c("7  系统  system", "6  架构  architecture", "5  模块  module",
           "4  层  layer", "3  框架算子  framework op", "2  GPU kernel",
           "1  数学映射  mathematical map"),
  ex = c("预测服务、虚拟细胞平台 / a service, a virtual-cell platform",
         "GPT、ViT、RGAT / GPT, ViT, RGAT",
         "Transformer block、多头注意力 / a transformer block, MHA",
         "nn.Linear、nn.MultiheadAttention",
         "torch.matmul、F.softmax、autograd",
         "cuBLAS、Triton、FlashAttention",
         "y = Wx + b、softmax、conv"),
  mean = c("数据闭环与部署 / data loop, deployment",
           "层怎么拼、邻接假设 / wiring, adjacency assumption",
           "多个层的固定组合 / a fixed bundle of layers",
           "参数 + 前向 + 反向 / params, forward, backward",
           "数学 + 自动微分 / maths + autodiff",
           "线程块、共享内存、访存 / blocks, SRAM, traffic",
           "定义本身 / the definition"),
  grp = c("sys", "arch", "arch", "arch", "fw", "ker", "math")
)
hier$fill <- c(sys = "#FBE3D9", arch = "#FDF0D8", fw = "#DCE8F5",
               ker = "#D8EDE7", math = "#EAF0F5")[hier$grp]
hier$bar  <- c(sys = op_pal[["coral"]], arch = op_pal[["orange"]], fw = op_pal[["blue"]],
               ker = op_pal[["teal"]], math = op_pal[["grey"]])[hier$grp]

ggplot(hier) +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = 0, xmax = 10, ymin = y - 0.4, ymax = y + 0.4), fill = hier$fill) +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = 0, xmax = 0.16, ymin = y - 0.4, ymax = y + 0.4),
            fill = hier$bar, colour = NA) +
  geom_text(aes(0.42, y, label = name), hjust = 0, size = 3.1, fontface = "bold",
            colour = op_pal[["ink"]]) +
  geom_text(aes(3.55, y, label = ex), hjust = 0, size = 2.5,
            colour = op_pal[["blue"]]) +
  geom_text(aes(7.05, y, label = mean), hjust = 0, size = 2.5,
            colour = op_pal[["ink"]]) +
  annotate("text", x = 3.55, y = 7.72, label = "example", size = 2.4,
           colour = op_pal[["grey"]], hjust = 0) +
  annotate("text", x = 7.05, y = 7.72, label = "changing this layer =", size = 2.4,
           colour = op_pal[["grey"]], hjust = 0) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 10.6), ylim = c(0.45, 7.95)) +
  plain








Figure 21: 算子的七层结构。第 1–2 层回答「做什么」，第 3 层回答「怎么在芯片上做」，第 4–6 层回答「怎么搭」，第 7 层是最终交付的系统。每往上一层，可替换的部件变多、单次改动的影响变大，但都不改变下层已经确定的数学。 | Seven layers. Layers 1–2 answer 「what is done」, layer 3 answers 「how it is done on silicon」, layers 4–6 answer 「how it is assembled」, and layer 7 is the delivered system. Going up, more parts become swappable and a single change has wider impact — but none of it changes the mathematics already fixed below.





这张图最实用的地方，是把它当成”定位器”用。听到一句关于算子的话，先问它落在第几层：
The most practical use of this figure is as a locator. When you hear a claim about an operator, first ask which layer it lives on:

“我们提出了新的注意力机制” → 第 1–2 层（换数学）。
“We propose a new attention mechanism” → layers 1–2 (new mathematics).
“我们把注意力的显存降了 10 倍” → 第 3 层（换 kernel，数学不变）。
“We cut attention’s memory 10x” → layer 3 (new kernel, same mathematics).
“我们把 LayerNorm 移到注意力之前” → 第 4–6 层（换拼装）。
“We moved LayerNorm before attention” → layers 4–6 (new wiring).
“我们的模型在细胞扰动预测上更强” → 第 7 层（系统级结果），需要回头找原因。
“Our model predicts perturbations better” → layer 7 (a system-level result) that needs its cause traced back down.

三层关系可以压成一句话：算子决定了能表达什么函数、以及表达它的成本；架构决定了这些函数怎么组合起来匹配数据的结构；能力是这两者与数据、规模共同作用的结果，从来不是某一个算子单独提供的。
The relationship compresses into one sentence: operators fix which functions can be expressed and at what cost; architectures fix how those functions are composed to match the structure of the data; capability is the joint outcome of both plus data and scale, never something a single operator supplies on its own.

8.1 听到”更好的算子”时该问什么 / Questions to ask about a “better operator”
把全篇的判据收成八问。前四问用来定位，后四问用来验证：
Collect the criteria into eight questions. The first four locate the claim; the last four test it:

它改的是哪一层？能不能给出改动前后两个公式？如果给不出，多半是第 3 层或第 6 层。
Which layer does it change? Can it show the formula before and after? If not, it is probably layer 3 or layer 6.
输出与谁等价？若与标准实现数值等价，就不能用”效果更好”作为卖点，只能比时间、显存、能耗。
What is its output equivalent to? If numerically equal to a standard implementation, “better results” is not a selling point; only time, memory and energy are.
参数量、FLOPs、显存、算术强度各是多少？落在 roofline 的斜线一侧还是水平段？
What are the parameter count, FLOPs, memory and arithmetic intensity? Which side of the roofline?
它假设了什么结构？这个假设在你的数据上成立吗？反过来，在什么数据上必然失效？
What structure does it assume? Does that hold for your data — and on what data must it fail?
消融是否只改了这一处？新旧两版的超参数是否各自调过？随机种子有几个，方差多大？
Does the ablation change only this one thing? Were both versions tuned separately? How many seeds, and what is the variance?
是否同参数、同数据、同训练预算？把一个算子塞进三倍大的模型里比较，得到的不是算子的功劳。
Equal parameters, data and training budget? Putting an operator inside a 3x larger model is not evidence for the operator.
规模变了还成立吗？序列更长、图更大、物种不同、批次不同，结论是否保持？
Does it survive scale — longer sequences, larger graphs, different species, different batches?
负结果在哪里？作者有没有说清楚它在什么条件下更差？一条都没有的论文，通常不是因为它处处更好。
Where are the negative results? Does the paper say when it is worse? A paper with none usually is not better everywhere.

这八问不需要任何代码就能问出口，但它们能把大多数宣传语还原成可检验的陈述。回到文章开头的 \(2\times3=6\)：从那一行到今天的虚拟细胞，中间跨过的是同一件事——把”怎么把输入变成输出”写清楚，并且诚实地说明这个写法在哪里成立。
These eight questions need no code to ask, yet they turn most marketing into testable statements. Back to \(2\times3=6\) from the opening: from that line to today’s virtual cells, the thread is the same — write down clearly how inputs become outputs, and say honestly where that writing holds.

本文由 DeepSeek-Flash 生成，尚未经过人工校对，可能存在事实、数字或表述上的错误，请以原始文献、仪器手册和官方文档为准。
This article was generated by DeepSeek-Flash and has not been manually proofread. It may contain errors in facts, numbers, or wording; please defer to the original literature, instrument manuals, and official documentation.
文中的所有图表都由本文的 R 代码在渲染时生成，其中的数值是为说明概念而模拟的，不代表任何真实仪器、样本或数据集。软件包名称与文件格式的描述基于公开文档，但版本演进很快，实际使用时请以对应版本的文档为准。
All figures and tables in this article are generated at render time by the R code in this post, and the values in them are simulated to illustrate concepts; they do not represent any real instrument, sample, or dataset. Descriptions of software package names and file formats are based on public documentation, but versions evolve quickly, so please refer to the documentation for the version you actually use.
蛋白质组学最容易被误解的一点是：很多人以为”测一个蛋白”就是仪器直接报告一个浓度。实际上，基于质谱的蛋白质组学测的是肽段的质荷比和信号强度，蛋白是从这些肽段反推出来的。所以一个 .raw 文件里并没有”蛋白”这个字段，只有成千上万张质谱图，以及每张图属于哪一次扫描、在什么时间、用什么参数采集。
The most common misunderstanding about proteomics is that many people assume “measuring a protein” means the instrument directly reports a concentration. In reality, mass-spectrometry-based proteomics measures the mass-to-charge ratios and signal intensities of peptides, and proteins are inferred back from those peptides. A .raw file therefore contains no “protein” field at all—only tens of thousands of mass spectra, together with which scan each spectrum belongs to, at what time, and with which acquisition parameters.
这篇文章按数据实际流动的顺序展开：
This article follows the order in which the data actually flow:
目标是写成一份可以按图索骥的技术报告。
The goal is to write a technical report that can serve as a step-by-step guide.

href: posts/2026-10-26 Proteomics mass spectrometry data/index.html#蛋白质组学测的是什么为什么难-what-proteomics-measures-and-why-it-is-hard
title: Proteomics by mass spectrometry: what is inside a raw file
section: 1. 蛋白质组学测的是什么，为什么难 / What proteomics measures, and why it is hard
text:
1. 蛋白质组学测的是什么，为什么难 / What proteomics measures, and why it is hard
基因组是一份稳定的序列，转录组是”此刻在转录什么”，而蛋白质组是此刻真正在执行功能的分子。三者之间并不是简单的一一映射：
A genome is a stable sequence, the transcriptome is “what is being transcribed right now”, and the proteome is the molecules that are actually carrying out functions at this moment. The mapping among the three is not a simple one-to-one correspondence:

一个基因可以产生多种蛋白质形式（proteoform）：可变剪接、蛋白酶切、信号肽去除；
A single gene can give rise to multiple protein forms (proteoforms): alternative splicing, proteolytic cleavage, and signal-peptide removal;
蛋白丰度与 mRNA 丰度只有中等相关（常见报道在 0.4–0.6 之间），因为翻译效率和降解速率不同；
Protein abundance correlates only moderately with mRNA abundance (reported values commonly fall between 0.4 and 0.6), because translation efficiency and degradation rates differ;
蛋白会被修饰（磷酸化、乙酰化、泛素化、糖基化、氧化），修饰状态往往才是功能开关；
Proteins are modified (phosphorylation, acetylation, ubiquitination, glycosylation, oxidation), and the modification state is often the actual functional switch;
蛋白丰度的动态范围极大：血浆中白蛋白与低丰度细胞因子之间可以相差 10 个数量级。
Protein abundance spans an enormous dynamic range: in plasma, albumin and low-abundance cytokines can differ by 10 orders of magnitude.



Code
set.seed(42)
ab <- data.frame(rank = 1:600)
ab$log_ab <- 10 - 10 * (ab$rank - 1) / 599 + rnorm(nrow(ab), 0, 0.04)

mark <- data.frame(
  protein = c("albumin", "transferrin", "IgG", "CRP", "IL-6", "troponin I"),
  rank = c(1, 6, 15, 150, 430, 580)
)
mark$log_ab <- 10 - 10 * (mark$rank - 1) / 599

set.seed(1)
ggplot(ab, aes(rank, log_ab)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 60, xmax = 320, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = blog_pal[["sky"]], alpha = 0.14) +
  annotate("text", x = 190, y = 1.0, label = "routine LC-MS/MS coverage",
           size = 3, colour = "grey25") +
  geom_line(colour = blog_pal[["blue"]], linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(data = mark, colour = blog_pal[["vermillion"]], size = 2.4) +
  geom_label_repel(
    data = mark, aes(label = protein), size = 3,
    fill = "white", alpha = 0.88, label.size = 0.2,
    min.segment.length = 0, box.padding = 0.45, point.padding = 0.35,
    max.overlaps = Inf
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "protein rank in plasma", y = expression(log[10]~"relative abundance"),
    title = "The dynamic range problem",
    subtitle = "roughly 10 orders of magnitude between albumin and cytokines"
  )








Figure 1: 血浆蛋白的丰度横跨约 10 个数量级。质谱一次进样能覆盖的主要是中间那一段，最两端通常需要去除高丰度蛋白或富集低丰度蛋白。 | Plasma protein abundance spans about 10 orders of magnitude. A single mass spectrometry injection mainly covers the middle segment; the two extremes usually require depletion of high-abundance proteins or enrichment of low-abundance proteins.





把这件事翻译成数据语言，就是三个不同层次的问题：
Translated into the language of data, this becomes three questions at different levels:








层次
问题
数据产物




鉴定（identification）
样本里有哪些肽段和蛋白
PSM 表、peptide 表、protein 表


定量（quantification）
每个蛋白在不同样本里有多少
强度矩阵、比值、差异检验结果


状态（state）
修饰位点、互作、定位、结构
位点表、互作网络、交联对、HDX 曲线



English








Level
Question
Data product




Identification
Which peptides and proteins are present in the sample
PSM table, peptide table, protein table


Quantification
How much of each protein is present in each sample
Intensity matrix, ratios, differential test results


State
Modification sites, interactions, localization, structure
Site table, interaction network, cross-linked pairs, HDX curves



后面所有的文件格式和分析步骤，都是为这三层服务。
Every file format and analysis step that follows serves these three layers.

objectID: posts/2026-10-26 Proteomics mass spectrometry data/index.html#一台-lc-msms-里发生了什么-what-happens-inside-an-lc-msms
href: posts/2026-10-26 Proteomics mass spectrometry data/index.html#一台-lc-msms-里发生了什么-what-happens-inside-an-lc-msms
title: Proteomics by mass spectrometry: what is inside a raw file
section: 2. 一台 LC-MS/MS 里发生了什么 / What happens inside an LC-MS/MS
text:
2. 一台 LC-MS/MS 里发生了什么 / What happens inside an LC-MS/MS
自下而上（bottom-up）蛋白质组学的标准流程是：提取蛋白 → 酶切成肽段 → 液相色谱分离 → 电喷雾离子化 → 质谱测量 → 数据库搜索。之所以先酶切，是因为完整蛋白太大、太难气化和碎裂；胰蛋白酶（trypsin）在 Lys/Arg 之后切割，产生长度和带电性质都比较适合质谱的肽段（常见 7–25 个氨基酸）。
The standard workflow of bottom-up proteomics is: extract proteins → digest into peptides → separate by liquid chromatography → ionize by electrospray → measure by mass spectrometry → database search. Digestion comes first because intact proteins are too large and too difficult to vaporize and fragment; trypsin cleaves after Lys/Arg, producing peptides whose length and charge properties are reasonably well suited to mass spectrometry (commonly 7–25 amino acids).


Code
steps <- data.frame(
  x = c(1, 2.75, 4.5, 6.25, 8),
  head = c("LC separation", "ESI", "MS1", "isolation", "MS2"),
  sub = c(
    "peptides elute over a\n60-120 min gradient",
    "multiply charged\nions in the gas phase",
    "precursor m/z,\nRT, ion mobility",
    "one precursor (DDA)\nor a window (DIA)",
    "fragment ions\nb / y series"
  )
)
links <- data.frame(x = steps$x[-nrow(steps)] + 0.72, xend = steps$x[-1] - 0.72)

ggplot() +
  geom_rect(
    data = steps,
    aes(xmin = x - 0.68, xmax = x + 0.68, ymin = 0.42, ymax = 0.90, fill = head),
    colour = "white", linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_text(data = steps, aes(x, 0.665, label = head),
            colour = "white", fontface = "bold", size = 3.2) +
  geom_text(data = steps, aes(x, 0.20, label = sub),
            size = 2.7, colour = "grey30", lineheight = 0.95) +
  geom_segment(
    data = links, aes(x = x, xend = xend, y = 0.665, yend = 0.665),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(2.4, "mm")), colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal[1:5], guide = "none") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0.15, 8.85), ylim = c(0, 1.05), clip = "off") +
  theme_blog() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_blank(), axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(), panel.border = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  )








Figure 2: 自下而上蛋白质组学的主链路。每一步的产物都是一个可检查的中间文件，这也是排错时最有效的定位顺序。 | The main pipeline of bottom-up proteomics. The product of every step is an inspectable intermediate file, which is also the most effective order for localizing problems during troubleshooting.





几个决定数据形态的物理事实：
A few physical facts determine the shape of the data:

电喷雾（ESI）让肽段带上多个质子，所以同一个肽段会以 2+、3+、4+ 等多个电荷态出现，质荷比不同，但”质量”相同。
Electrospray ionization (ESI) gives peptides multiple protons, so the same peptide appears in several charge states such as 2+, 3+, and 4+; the mass-to-charge ratios differ, but the “mass” is the same.
质量分析器决定分辨率、质量精度和扫描速度。Orbitrap 分辨率高、质量精度好；TOF 扫描快；离子阱便宜；四极杆常作为前级过滤或做 PRM。这些硬件差别直接决定了 mzML 里每条 scan 的元数据。
The mass analyzer determines resolution, mass accuracy, and scan speed. The Orbitrap offers high resolution and good mass accuracy; TOF scans fast; ion traps are inexpensive; quadrupoles often act as a front-end filter or are used for PRM. These hardware differences directly determine the metadata of every scan in an mzML file.
离子淌度（ion mobility）在 m/z 和强度之外再加一维：碰撞截面积（CCS）或 1/K0。timsTOF 的 .d 文件因此是 4D 的。
Ion mobility adds another dimension beyond m/z and intensity: collision cross section (CCS) or 1/K0. The timsTOF .d file is therefore 4D.
碎裂方式决定谱图长什么样：HCD/CID 主要产生 b/y 离子，ETD 对磷酸化和大肽段更友好。
The fragmentation method determines what the spectrum looks like: HCD/CID mainly produce b/y ions, while ETD is more favorable for phosphorylation and large peptides.



Code
set.seed(3)
n <- 3000
mz <- runif(n, 400, 1200)
k0 <- 1.05 - 0.00042 * (mz - 400) + rnorm(n, 0, 0.045)
ccs_df <- data.frame(mz = mz, k0 = k0)

ggplot(ccs_df, aes(mz, k0)) +
  geom_point(colour = blog_pal[["blue"]], size = 0.35, alpha = 0.22) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, colour = blog_pal[["vermillion"]],
              linewidth = 0.8, se = FALSE) +
  labs(
    x = "m/z", y = expression("1/"*K[0]~"(ion mobility)"),
    title = "4D separation",
    subtitle = "peptides form a narrow band in the m/z - ion mobility plane"
  )








Figure 3: 加上离子淌度后，数据从 3D 变成 4D。同一 m/z 上的共洗脱肽段可以在淌度维度被分开，这也是 timsTOF 和 FAIMS 提高鉴定数的核心原因。 | With ion mobility, the data go from 3D to 4D. Co-eluting peptides at the same m/z can be separated in the mobility dimension, which is the core reason timsTOF and FAIMS increase identification numbers.

objectID: posts/2026-10-26 Proteomics mass spectrometry data/index.html#一次运行在文件里长什么样-what-a-single-run-looks-like-inside-the-file
href: posts/2026-10-26 Proteomics mass spectrometry data/index.html#一次运行在文件里长什么样-what-a-single-run-looks-like-inside-the-file
title: Proteomics by mass spectrometry: what is inside a raw file
section: 3. 一次运行在文件里长什么样 / What a single run looks like inside the file
text:
3. 一次运行在文件里长什么样 / What a single run looks like inside the file
一次 90 分钟的 DDA 运行，典型会产生 3,000–10,000 张 MS1 谱和 30,000–150,000 张 MS2 谱，文件大小从几百 MB 到几 GB。这个规模决定了三件事：不能一次全读进内存、必须能随机访问某一条扫描、必须有索引。
A typical 90-minute DDA run produces 3,000–10,000 MS1 spectra and 30,000–150,000 MS2 spectra, with file sizes ranging from a few hundred MB to several GB. This scale dictates three things: the file cannot be read into memory all at once, random access to any given scan must be possible, and an index is required.
最直观的视图是总离子流（TIC）：把每一张 MS1 谱的所有强度加起来，对保留时间作图。
The most intuitive view is the total ion current (TIC): sum all intensities in each MS1 spectrum and plot the result against retention time.


Code
rt <- seq(0, 90, length.out = 4000)
mu  <- c(9, 14, 18.5, 23, 28, 33, 37.5, 42, 47, 52, 57.5, 63, 68, 73, 79, 84.5)
amp <- c(0.35, 0.55, 0.80, 0.50, 0.95, 0.42, 1.00, 0.60, 0.75, 0.50, 0.90, 0.65, 0.55, 0.70, 0.40, 0.30)
wd  <- c(0.90, 1.10, 0.70, 1.30, 0.90, 1.00, 0.80, 1.20, 0.70, 1.10, 0.90, 1.00, 1.20, 0.80, 1.00, 1.10)

tic <- rowSums(sapply(seq_along(mu), function(i) amp[i] * exp(-((rt - mu[i])^2) / (2 * wd[i]^2))))
tic_df <- data.frame(rt = rt, intensity = tic + 0.04)

p_tic <- ggplot(tic_df, aes(rt, intensity)) +
  geom_area(fill = blog_pal[["sky"]], alpha = 0.28) +
  geom_line(colour = blog_pal[["blue"]], linewidth = 0.45) +
  labs(
    x = NULL, y = "total ion current",
    title = "One LC-MS/MS run",
    subtitle = "TIC over a 90 min gradient"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank())

cyc <- seq(0.8, 89, by = 1.55)
scan_df <- bind_rows(
  data.frame(t = cyc, level = "MS1", h = 1),
  data.frame(t = as.vector(outer(cyc, seq(0.15, 1.25, length.out = 6), "+")),
             level = "MS2", h = 0.28)
)

p_scan <- ggplot(scan_df, aes(x = t, xend = t, y = 0, yend = h, colour = level)) +
  geom_segment(linewidth = 0.45) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(MS1 = "grey35", MS2 = blog_pal[["vermillion"]])) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = "retention time (min)", y = NULL, colour = NULL) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top", panel.border = element_blank()
  )

p_tic / p_scan + plot_layout(heights = c(3.4, 1))








Figure 4: 上：总离子流色谱图，峰是随梯度洗脱出来的肽段群体。下：同一条时间轴上的扫描类型，灰色是 MS1 调查扫描，红色是随后触发的 MS2 碎裂扫描。 | Top: total ion current chromatogram; the peaks are populations of peptides eluting along the gradient. Bottom: scan types on the same time axis—grey marks MS1 survey scans, red marks the MS2 fragmentation scans they trigger.





单张谱图则是另一个视图：横轴 m/z，纵轴强度。MS1 上看到的是同位素包络（isotope envelope），MS2 上看到的是碎片离子。
A single spectrum is another view: m/z on the x-axis, intensity on the y-axis. MS1 shows the isotope envelope; MS2 shows fragment ions.


Code
iso <- data.frame(
  mz = 500.26 + (0:6) * (1.00728 / 2),
  intensity = c(0.32, 1.00, 0.74, 0.41, 0.19, 0.08, 0.03)
)
p_ms1 <- ggplot(iso, aes(mz, intensity)) +
  geom_segment(aes(xend = mz, y = 0, yend = intensity),
               colour = blog_pal[["blue"]], linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(colour = blog_pal[["blue"]], size = 1.6) +
  annotate("text", x = 501.05, y = 0.92, label = "0.501 Th", size = 3, colour = "grey30") +
  annotate("segment", x = 500.26, xend = 501.26, y = 0.86, yend = 0.86,
           arrow = arrow(ends = "both", length = unit(1.8, "mm")), colour = "grey45") +
  labs(x = "m/z", y = "relative intensity", title = "MS1: isotope envelope",
       subtitle = "charge 2+, spacing 1.007 / z") +
  ylim(0, 1.1)

frag <- data.frame(
  mz = c(147.11, 218.15, 331.23, 402.27, 515.35, 612.41, 726.45, 813.48,
         175.12, 288.20, 359.25, 472.33, 569.39, 683.43, 770.47, 899.51),
  intensity = c(0.22, 0.45, 0.31, 0.68, 0.39, 1.00, 0.28, 0.74,
                0.36, 0.58, 0.25, 0.88, 0.33, 0.62, 0.42, 0.95),
  series = c(rep("b", 8), rep("y", 8))
)
lab <- frag %>% filter(intensity > 0.6)

p_ms2 <- ggplot(frag, aes(mz, intensity, colour = series)) +
  geom_segment(aes(xend = mz, y = 0, yend = intensity), linewidth = 0.55) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = lab, aes(label = sprintf("%.1f", mz)), size = 2.6,
    min.segment.length = 0, box.padding = 0.3, seed = 2,
    max.overlaps = Inf, show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(b = blog_pal[["blue"]], y = blog_pal[["vermillion"]])) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
  labs(x = "m/z", y = "relative intensity", colour = "ion series",
       title = "MS2: fragment ions", subtitle = "the b / y ladder encodes the sequence") +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

p_ms1 | p_ms2








Figure 5: 左：一个 2+ 肽段在 MS1 上的同位素包络，相邻峰间隔约 0.5 Th，由此可以读出电荷态。右：同一条肽段在 MS2 上的碎片离子，b 与 y 系列拼起来就是序列。 | Left: the isotope envelope of a 2+ peptide in MS1; adjacent peaks are about 0.5 Th apart, from which the charge state can be read. Right: fragment ions of the same peptide in MS2; assembling the b and y series gives the sequence.

objectID: posts/2026-10-26 Proteomics mass spectrometry data/index.html#ddadiaprm三种采集策略-dda-dia-prm-three-acquisition-strategies
href: posts/2026-10-26 Proteomics mass spectrometry data/index.html#ddadiaprm三种采集策略-dda-dia-prm-three-acquisition-strategies
title: Proteomics by mass spectrometry: what is inside a raw file
section: 4. DDA、DIA、PRM：三种采集策略 / DDA, DIA, PRM: three acquisition strategies
text:
4. DDA、DIA、PRM：三种采集策略 / DDA, DIA, PRM: three acquisition strategies
数据长什么样，首先取决于仪器怎么选前体。
What the data look like depends first on how the instrument selects precursors.
DDA（data-dependent acquisition）：先做一张 MS1 调查扫描，挑信号最强的前 N 个前体，逐个隔离、碎裂、采集 MS2。优点是谱图干净、好搜库；缺点是随机性——强弱共洗脱时弱信号会被挤掉，低丰度肽段在不同重复之间可能时有时无，这就是定量缺失值的主要来源之一。
DDA (data-dependent acquisition): acquire an MS1 survey scan first, pick the top N most intense precursors, then isolate, fragment, and acquire MS2 for each in turn. The advantage is clean spectra that are easy to search; the drawback is stochasticity—when strong and weak signals co-elute, weak signals get crowded out, and low-abundance peptides may appear in some replicates but not others. This is one of the main sources of missing values in quantification.
DIA（data-independent acquisition）：不等选择，按 m/z 切成若干窗口，每个窗口内的所有前体一起碎裂、一起采集。覆盖更稳定、重复性更好；代价是 MS2 谱是混合谱，必须靠谱图库或伪谱库去卷积。
DIA (data-independent acquisition): no precursor selection; the m/z range is divided into windows, and all precursors within a window are fragmented and acquired together. Coverage is more stable and reproducibility better; the cost is that MS2 spectra are mixed spectra, which must be deconvolved using a spectral library or a pseudo-library.
PRM（parallel reaction monitoring）：事先指定目标肽段，把它们的前体列进包含列表，长时间累积信号。这是靶向定量，灵敏度最高，但只能测你列出来的东西。
PRM (parallel reaction monitoring): target peptides are specified in advance, their precursors are placed on an inclusion list, and signal is accumulated over a long period. This is targeted quantification with the highest sensitivity, but it can only measure what you list.


Code
set.seed(7)
cycles <- 20
ms2 <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(cycles), function(i) {
  k <- sample(2:5, 1)
  data.frame(
    rt = (i - 1) * 2.6 + runif(k, 0.3, 2.2),
    mz = runif(k, 430, 1150)
  )
}))

p_dda <- ggplot() +
  geom_segment(
    data = data.frame(rt = (seq_len(cycles) - 1) * 2.6 + 0.14),
    aes(x = rt, xend = rt, y = 400, yend = 1200),
    colour = "grey78", linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  geom_rect(
    data = ms2,
    aes(xmin = rt - 0.18, xmax = rt + 0.18, ymin = mz - 6, ymax = mz + 6),
    fill = blog_pal[["vermillion"]], alpha = 0.85
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 52), ylim = c(400, 1200)) +
  labs(x = "retention time (min)", y = "m/z", title = "DDA",
       subtitle = "top-N precursors per cycle") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

w <- 20
starts <- seq(400, 1200 - w, by = w * 2 / 3)
dia <- data.frame(ymin = starts, ymax = starts + w, idx = seq_along(starts))

p_dia <- ggplot(dia) +
  geom_rect(
    aes(xmin = 0, xmax = 52, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = factor(idx %% 3)),
    colour = "white", linewidth = 0.45, alpha = 0.42

  scale_fill_manual(values = pal[c(1, 5, 3)], guide = "none") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 52), ylim = c(400, 1200)) +
  labs(x = "retention time (min)", y = NULL, title = "DIA",
       subtitle = "overlapping windows tile everything, all the time") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

title: Proteomics by mass spectrometry: what is inside a raw file
section: 5. 原始数据格式的架构 / The architecture of raw data formats
text:
5. 原始数据格式的架构 / The architecture of raw data formats
这是本文的核心部分。理解格式的关键，是把文件分成四层：
This is the core part of the article. The key to understanding the formats is to divide a file into four layers:

厂商原始层：仪器直接写出的文件，包含完整扫描信息，但二进制结构不公开。
Vendor raw layer: the file the instrument writes directly, containing complete scan information, but with a binary structure that is not public.
开放谱图层：把原始层无损转换成语义明确的谱图格式，主要是 mzML。
Open spectra layer: a lossless conversion of the raw layer into a spectra format with explicit semantics, mainly mzML.
鉴定结果层：搜库软件输出的 PSM / peptide / protein 记录（mzIdentML、pepXML、mzTab）。
Identification result layer: the PSM / peptide / protein records output by search software (mzIdentML, pepXML, mzTab).
定量与处理层：矩阵、报告表、项目文件（parquet、TSV、Skyline .sky、FragPipe 输出等）。
Quantification and processing layer: matrices, report tables, and project files (parquet, TSV, Skyline .sky, FragPipe output, etc.).



Code
fmt <- data.frame(
  layer = factor(
    c(rep("vendor raw", 4), rep("open spectra", 4), rep("identification", 3), rep("quantification", 4)),
    levels = c("vendor raw", "open spectra", "identification", "quantification")
  ),
  name = c(
    "Thermo .raw", "Bruker .d", "SCIEX .wiff2", "Waters .raw",
    "mzML", "mzMLb", "MGF", "imzML",
    "mzIdentML", "pepXML", "mzTab",
    "DIA-NN parquet", "MaxQuant txt", "Skyline .sky", "FragPipe tsv"
  )
) %>%
  group_by(layer) %>%
  mutate(pos = row_number(), n = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    x = (pos - 0.5) / n,
    y = as.numeric(layer),
    half = 0.43 / n
  )

ggplot(fmt) +
  geom_rect(
    aes(xmin = x - half, xmax = x + half, ymin = y - 0.17, ymax = y + 0.17, fill = layer),
    colour = "white", linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_text(aes(x, y, label = name), size = 2.8, colour = "white", fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("vendor raw" = blog_pal[["grey"]], "open spectra" = blog_pal[["blue"]],
               "identification" = blog_pal[["green"]], "quantification" = blog_pal[["purple"]]),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = 1:4,
    labels = c("vendor raw\n(binary, closed)", "open spectra\n(XML / HDF5)",
               "identification\n(PSM results)", "quantification\n(matrices / reports)"),
    limits = c(0.55, 4.45)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-0.02, 1.02), clip = "off") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_blog() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(), legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8, lineheight = 0.95)
  )








Figure 7: 四层格式的分工。分析代码通常只和上面三层打交道，但排错时必须回到最底层的原始文件。 | The division of labor among the four format layers. Analysis code usually only deals with the top three layers, but troubleshooting must go back to the raw files at the very bottom.






5.1 厂商封闭格式 / Closed vendor formats









平台
扩展名
实际结构
说明

English









Platform
Extension
Actual structure
Notes




Thermo Fisher (Orbitrap, Astral, TSQ)
.raw
Single file; internally a scan header plus binary arrays
Most common; reading it requires the official RawFileReader or a prior conversion


Bruker (timsTOF, maXis)
.d
Directory containing analysis.tdf, analysis.tdf_bin, *.baf
4D data (including ion mobility); almost always requires the vendor SDK or alphatims first


SCIEX (TripleTOF, ZenoTOF)
.wiff + .wiff.scan, or .wiff2
Metadata and scan data are stored separately (merged in newer versions)
Always keep the two files together before conversion


Agilent (Q-TOF, 6545)
.d
Directory, AcqData/*.bin
MassHunter structure


Waters (Synapt, Xevo)
.raw (directory)
Directory, MassLynx internal structure
Same name as Thermo .raw but completely different



封闭格式的共同问题：
Common problems with closed formats:

不可逆：一旦厂商停止维护解析库，旧数据就可能读不出来；
Irreversible: once the vendor stops maintaining the parsing library, old data may become unreadable;
平台绑定：想批量处理只能装对应 SDK，Windows/Linux 支持不一致；
Platform-bound: batch processing requires installing the corresponding SDK, and Windows/Linux support is inconsistent;
仓库不友好：大二进制 + 目录结构，做版本管理几乎不可能。
Repository-unfriendly: large binaries plus directory structures make version control almost impossible.

所以几乎所有正式的蛋白质组学流程都会做一步”转换一次，之后只读开放格式”。常用转换器是 ProteoWizard 的 msconvert 和 Thermo 官方的 ThermoRawFileParser。
So almost every serious proteomics pipeline performs one step: “convert once, then read only open formats from then on”. The common converters are ProteoWizard’s msconvert and Thermo’s official ThermoRawFileParser.


5.2 mzML：开放谱图格式的事实标准 / mzML: the de facto standard for open spectra
mzML 由 HUPO-PSI 维护，本质是一个 XML 索引 + base64 编码的压缩二进制数组。一个最小的结构如下：
mzML is maintained by HUPO-PSI and is essentially an XML index plus base64-encoded, compressed binary arrays. A minimal structure looks like this:
<indexedmzML>
  <mzML version="1.1.0">
    <cvList>            <!-- 受控词表：PSI-MS、UO、MS -->
    <fileDescription>   <!-- 文件内容、来源 -->
    <softwareList>      <!-- 写入该文件的软件与版本 -->
    <instrumentConfigurationList>
    <dataProcessingList>
    <run id="run1" startTimeStamp="...">
      <spectrumList count="84213">
        <spectrum id="controllerType=0 controllerNumber=1 scan=2"
                  index="1" defaultArrayLength="412">
          <cvParam cvRef="MS" accession="MS:1000511" name="ms level" value="1"/>
          <scanList count="1">
            <scan>
              <cvParam accession="MS:1000016" name="scan start time" value="0.0212" unitName="minute"/>
            </scan>
          </scanList>
          <binaryDataArrayList count="2">
            <binaryDataArray>
              <cvParam accession="MS:1000514" name="m/z array" unitName="m/z"/>
              <binary>eJztwTEBAAAAwqD1T20...</binary>   <!-- zlib + base64 -->
            </binaryDataArray>
            <binaryDataArray>
              <cvParam accession="MS:1000515" name="intensity array" unitName="number of detector counts"/>
              <binary>eJztwTEBAAAAwqD1T20...</binary>
            </binaryDataArray>
          </binaryDataArrayList>
        </spectrum>
      </spectrumList>
      <chromatogramList count="3"> ... </chromatogramList>
    </run>
  </mzML>
  <indexList>  <!-- offset 索引，支持随机访问 -->
    <index name="spectrum">
      <offset idRef="...scan=2">12345</offset>
    </index>
  </indexList>
</indexedmzML>
几个容易忽略但很重要的细节：
A few details that are easy to overlook but important:

所有字段都由受控词表（CV）定义，例如 MS:1000511 是 ms level，MS:1000514 是 m/z array。这让不同仪器的数据可以语义对齐，也让解析器不必猜字段名。
All fields are defined by controlled vocabularies (CV): for example, MS:1000511 is ms level and MS:1000514 is m/z array. This lets data from different instruments be semantically aligned and frees parsers from guessing field names.
二进制数组是 zlib 压缩后的 base64，通常 32 位 float（m/z 也可以是 64 位 double）。m/z 用 double、intensity 用 float 是最常见的组合。
Binary arrays are zlib-compressed base64, usually 32-bit float (m/z can also be 64-bit double). Using double for m/z and float for intensity is the most common combination.
indexedmzML 才有索引，未索引的 mzML 只能顺序读，处理大队列时会慢一个量级。
Only indexedmzML has an index; an unindexed mzML can only be read sequentially, which is an order of magnitude slower when processing large cohorts.
谱图顺序是文件顺序，不是 m/z 顺序。很多算法需要先按 m/z 排序，这一步很吃内存。
Spectrum order is file order, not m/z order. Many algorithms need to sort by m/z first, and this step is memory-hungry.

围绕 mzML 还有几个变体：
There are also several variants around mzML:









格式
载体
适用场景
局限

通用交换格式，几乎所有工具都支持
文件大、解析慢

工具支持少


MGF
纯文本
只存 MS2 峰，做谱图库、机器学习
丢失 MS1 与大部分元数据


imzML + .ibd
XML + 二进制
质谱成像（MALDI）
只适用于成像数据


mzPeak
列式（parquet 风格）
新提出的高性能开放格式
生态仍在建设中

5.3 鉴定与定量层的格式 / Formats in the identification and quantification layers
搜库之后，数据不再是”谱图”，而是”谱图与肽段的对应关系”：
After database search, the data are no longer “spectra” but “correspondences between spectra and peptides”:

典型来源

MS-GF+、Comet、Mascot、MS Amanda

MaxQuant

DIA-NN


.osw

OpenSWATH


.sky / .blib

Format
Content
Typical source

PSMs, peptides, proteins, scores, FDR, modifications
MS-GF+, Comet, Mascot, MS Amanda

Candidate peptides and scores for each spectrum
TPP, Comet

5.4 同样的数据，不同的体积 / Same data, different sizes
同一次运行转成不同格式，体积差别很大。下面的数字是示意性的量级，不是实测值，但比例关系是真实的：文本格式（MGF）只保留 MS2 所以最小；mzML 不做压缩会膨胀数倍；HDF5 类格式介于两者之间。
Converting the same run into different formats yields very different file sizes. The numbers below are illustrative magnitudes, not measured values, but the ratios are realistic: the text format (MGF) keeps only MS2 and is therefore the smallest; uncompressed mzML inflates several-fold; HDF5-based formats fall in between.


Code
sizes <- data.frame(
  format = factor(
    c("MGF (MS2 only)", "Thermo .raw", "mzML (zlib)", "mzXML", "mzML (uncompressed)"),
    levels = rev(c("MGF (MS2 only)", "Thermo .raw", "mzML (zlib)", "mzXML", "mzML (uncompressed)"))
  ),
  gb = c(0.6, 1.3, 2.4, 3.2, 7.8)
)

ggplot(sizes, aes(gb, format, fill = format)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.62, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(gb, " GB")), hjust = -0.15, size = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "MGF (MS2 only)" = blog_pal[["grey"]], "Thermo .raw" = blog_pal[["purple"]],
    "mzML (zlib)" = blog_pal[["blue"]], "mzXML" = blog_pal[["sky"]],
    "mzML (uncompressed)" = blog_pal[["vermillion"]]
  )) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 9.2), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = "file size (GB, illustrative)", y = NULL,
       title = "Format overhead", subtitle = "same run, five containers")








Figure 8: 同一次 90 分钟 DDA 运行在不同格式下的示意体积。注意 MGF 体积小是因为它丢掉了 MS1 和大部分元数据，不是因为它更高效。 | Illustrative file sizes for the same 90-minute DDA run in different formats. Note that MGF is small because it discards MS1 and most of the metadata, not because it is more efficient.

title: Proteomics by mass spectrometry: what is inside a raw file
section: 6. 原始文件里到底存了哪些字段 / Which fields are actually stored in a raw file
text:
6. 原始文件里到底存了哪些字段 / Which fields are actually stored in a raw file
不管容器是什么，每条扫描通常都带有下列信息。这份清单可以直接用来检查”转换是否丢信息”：
Whatever the container, every scan usually carries the following information. This list can be used directly to check whether a conversion has lost information:








类别
字段
为什么重要




定位
scan number / native ID、index
把 MS2 和触发它的 MS1 关联起来


层级
MS level（1 / 2 / 3）
决定后续处理方式


时间
retention time
色谱对齐、提取离子流


强度
m/z array、intensity array
谱图本体


前体
precursor m/z、charge、单同位素质量
搜库的核心输入


隔离
isolation window 上下界、偏移
DIA 窗口解析必需


碎裂
activation type（HCD/CID/ETD）、碰撞能量
影响谱图可比性


质量
分辨率、质量精度、centroid / profile
决定是否需要 centroiding


淌度
1/K0、CCS、FAIMS CV
4D 数据的第四维


仪器
型号、source、detector、polarity
批次效应排查


汇总
TIC、base peak intensity、injection time、AGC
质控与归一化


色谱
chromatogram list（TIC、BPC、SRM）
快速质控，不必解析全部谱图



English








Category
Field
Why it matters




Localization
scan number / native ID, index
links an MS2 to the MS1 that triggered it


Hierarchy
MS level (1 / 2 / 3)
determines how it is processed downstream


Time
retention time
chromatographic alignment, extracted ion current


Intensity
m/z array, intensity array
the spectrum itself


Precursor
precursor m/z, charge, monoisotopic mass
the core input for database search


Isolation
isolation window lower/upper bounds, offset
required for parsing DIA windows


Fragmentation
activation type (HCD/CID/ETD), collision energy
affects spectrum comparability


Mass
resolution, mass accuracy, centroid / profile
determines whether centroiding is needed


Mobility
1/K0, CCS, FAIMS CV
the fourth dimension of 4D data


Instrument
model, source, detector, polarity
troubleshooting batch effects


Summary
TIC, base peak intensity, injection time, AGC
quality control and normalization


Chromatogram
chromatogram list (TIC, BPC, SRM)
fast quality control without parsing every spectrum



一个常见的坑：profile 与 centroid。高分辨仪器原始数据常是 profile（连续采样的峰形），而搜库需要 centroid（峰顶一个 m/z 值）。msconvert 的 --filter "peakPicking true 1-" 就是在做这件事。如果 centroid 参数不合适，同位素峰会被合并或漏掉，直接影响电荷判断。
A common pitfall: profile versus centroid. Raw data from high-resolution instruments are often profile (a continuously sampled peak shape), whereas database search requires centroid (a single m/z value at the peak apex). msconvert’s --filter "peakPicking true 1-" does exactly this. If the centroiding parameters are unsuitable, isotope peaks may be merged or missed, directly affecting charge determination.

section: 7. 用 Python 读取 / Reading data with Python
text:
7. 用 Python 读取 / Reading data with Python
Python 生态里最常用的是 pyteomics（纯 Python、惰性迭代、内存友好）和 pymzml；需要完整工具链时用 pyOpenMS；做谱图相似度与机器学习时用 matchms。
In the Python ecosystem, the most commonly used packages are pyteomics (pure Python, lazy iteration, memory-friendly) and pymzml; use pyOpenMS when a complete toolchain is needed, and matchms for spectral similarity and machine learning.

7.1 mzML：流式读取 MS2 / mzML: streaming MS2 reads
from pyteomics import mzml

with mzml.MzML("run.mzML") as reader:
    print(reader.header[:3])          # 软件、仪器等元数据
    for spec in reader:
        if spec["ms level"] != 2:
            continue
        scan = spec["scanList"]["scan"][0]
        rt = scan["scan start time"]   # 默认单位见 unitInfo
        prec = spec["precursorList"]["precursor"][0]
        ion = prec["selectedIonList"]["selectedIon"][0]

        mz = spec["m/z array"]
        intensity = spec["intensity array"]
        print(spec["id"], rt, ion.get("selected ion m/z"),
              ion.get("charge state"), mz[:3], intensity[:3])
        break
要点：
Key points:

mzml.MzML 是迭代器，不会把整个文件读进内存；
mzml.MzML is an iterator and will not read the whole file into memory;
数组是 numpy.ndarray，可以直接做向量运算；
Arrays are numpy.ndarray, so vectorized operations work directly;
电荷、前体 m/z 等键名不保证存在，用 .get()；
Keys such as charge and precursor m/z are not guaranteed to exist; use .get();
如果只关心元数据，reader.get_by_id() 配合索引比顺序遍历快得多。
If you only care about metadata, reader.get_by_id() with an index is much faster than sequential iteration.



7.2 其他格式 / Other formats
# pymzml：接口更"对象化"
import pymzml
run = pymzml.run.Reader("run.mzML")
for spec in run:
    if spec.ms_level == 2:
        mz, i = spec.peaks("raw")
        break

# matchms：读成标准化 Spectrum 对象，方便算余弦相似度
from matchms.importing import load_from_mzml
spectra = list(load_from_mzml("run.mzML"))
print(spectra[0].metadata)

# pyOpenMS：完整算法库（峰提取、校正、搜库接口）
import pyopenms as oms
exp = oms.MSExperiment()
oms.MzMLFile().load("run.mzML", exp)
print(exp.getNrSpectra(), exp.getNrChromatograms())

# mzIdentML：读鉴定结果
from pyteomics import mzid
with mzid.MzIdentML("search.mzid") as reader:
    for psm in reader:
        print(psm["spectrumID"], psm["chargeState"], psm["PeptideSequence"])


7.3 厂商格式与衍生格式 / Vendor formats and derived formats
# Thermo .raw：官方推荐先转开放格式，一次性成本换来长期可复现
# ThermoRawFileParser -i run.raw -o out/ -f 2      (-f 2 = mzML)

# Bruker timsTOF 的 4D 数据
from alphatims.bruker import TimsTOF
data = TimsTOF("run.d", use_bruker_sdk=False)
print(data.shape)          # 语义维度：frame / scan / tof ...

# DIA-NN 的 parquet 报告：列式存储，读取和筛选都快
import pyarrow.parquet as pq
df = pq.read_table("report.parquet").to_pandas()
df = df[df["Q.Value"] <= 0.01]
