.h5ad 的内部结构值得单独记住，因为几乎所有 Python 单细胞工具都以它为中心：
The internal structure of .h5ad is worth remembering on its own, because almost every Python single-cell tool is centred on it:
AnnData
├── X          cells × genes 的表达矩阵（通常是稀疏 CSR）
├── obs        每个细胞的元数据：barcode、QC、cluster、sample
├── var        每个基因的元数据：gene id、HVG、mean、dispersion
├── obsm       降维结果：X_pca、X_umap、X_scvi
├── obsp       细胞间图：connectivities、distances
├── layers     同一批细胞的其它矩阵：counts、normalized、scaled
├── raw        原始表达（标准化前）
└── uns        非结构化信息：颜色、参数、邻居数
对应的读取代码：
The corresponding reading code:
import scanpy as sc

# 10x MTX 目录
adata = sc.read_10x_mtx("outs/filtered_feature_bc_matrix", var_names="gene_symbols")

# h5ad
adata = sc.read_h5ad("adata.h5ad")

# loom
adata = sc.read_loom("adata.loom")
library(Seurat)

# 10x MTX 目录
counts <- Read10X("outs/filtered_feature_bc_matrix")
obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts)

# Cell Ranger 的 h5
obj <- Read10X_h5("outs/filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5")

# 保存好的 Seurat 对象
obj <- readRDS("seurat.rds")

实践建议：分析中间结果尽量用 .h5ad 或 .rds 保存完整对象，而不是只保存矩阵。只存矩阵会丢掉聚类、降维、参数和元数据，下一次分析无法复现。


Practical advice: save intermediate analysis results as complete objects in .h5ad or .rds rather than as matrices only. Saving only the matrix loses the clustering, dimensionality reduction, parameters, and metadata, and the next analysis cannot be reproduced.



7.6 Cell Ranger 输出目录 / The Cell Ranger Output Directory
一个典型的 outs/ 目录包含：
A typical outs/ directory contains:
outs/
├── filtered_feature_bc_matrix/     # 过滤后的细胞 × 基因矩阵（分析起点）
├── raw_feature_bc_matrix/          # 全部条码（含空液滴，用于 EmptyDrops）
├── molecule_info.h5                # 分子级信息（UMI、reads、基因）
├── possorted_genome_bam.bam        # 比对结果（含 CB/UB 标签）
├── possorted_genome_bam.bam.bai
├── metrics_summary.csv             # 关键 QC 指标
├── web_summary.html                # 自动报告（knee plot、饱和度、比对率）
└── cloupe.cloupe                   # Loupe Browser 可视化文件

title: Single-cell sequencing: from a cell to a cell state
section: 8. 从 FASTQ 到 count matrix / From FASTQ to a Count Matrix
text:
8. 从 FASTQ 到 count matrix / From FASTQ to a Count Matrix
以 10x 官方流程（Cell Ranger / STARsolo）为例，中间要做五件事：条码校正、比对、基因分配、UMI 去重、细胞 calling。
Taking the official 10x workflow (Cell Ranger / STARsolo) as an example, five things happen in between: barcode correction, alignment, gene assignment, UMI deduplication, and cell calling.

8.1 条码校正 / Barcode Correction
测序错误会让读到的 16 bp 条码与白名单不完全一致。标准做法是：如果某个条码与白名单中的某个条码只差 1 个碱基（Hamming distance = 1），就把它校正为白名单条码；差 2 个及以上则归入“未识别”。这一步必须在 UMI 去重之前完成，否则同一个细胞的 reads 会被拆成多个“假细胞”。
Sequencing errors make the 16 bp barcode that is read not fully match the whitelist. The standard approach is: if a barcode differs from a whitelist barcode by only 1 base (Hamming distance = 1), correct it to the whitelist barcode; a difference of 2 or more is classed as unrecognized. This step must be completed before UMI deduplication, otherwise the reads of one cell are split into several fake cells.


Code
set.seed(12)
make_bc <- function() paste(sample(c("A", "C", "G", "T"), 16, replace = TRUE), collapse = "")
whitelist <- replicate(6, make_bc())
observed <- whitelist[1]
substr(observed, 8, 8) <- ifelse(substr(observed, 8, 8) == "A", "C", "A")

hamming <- function(a, b) sum(strsplit(a, "")[[1]] != strsplit(b, "")[[1]])
bc <- data.frame(
  candidate = whitelist,
  distance = vapply(whitelist, function(b) hamming(observed, b), numeric(1))
)
bc <- bc[order(bc$distance), ]
bc$candidate <- factor(bc$candidate, levels = rev(bc$candidate))

ggplot(bc, aes(distance, candidate, fill = distance == min(distance))) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = distance), hjust = -0.35, size = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(`FALSE` = blog_pal[["grey"]], `TRUE` = blog_pal[["blue"]]),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, max(bc$distance) + 1)) +
  labs(x = "Hamming distance to the observed barcode", y = "whitelist barcode")








Figure 7: 条码校正：观测到的条码与白名单逐个比较 Hamming 距离，只允许 1 个碱基的差异。 | Barcode correction: each observed barcode is compared with the whitelist by Hamming distance, and only a 1-base difference is allowed.





工程上还有两个细节：
There are two more engineering details:

条码白名单随试剂盒版本变化，用错版本会导致大量条码无法识别；Cell Ranger 会根据试剂盒自动选择。
The barcode whitelist changes with the kit version; using the wrong version leaves a large number of barcodes unrecognized; Cell Ranger selects it automatically according to the kit.
条码不是绝对唯一：约 737k 个条码里，两个真实细胞共用同一个条码的概率很低，但百万级细胞的项目需要评估碰撞。
Barcodes are not absolutely unique: among about 737k barcodes, the probability that two real cells share the same barcode is very low, but projects with millions of cells need to evaluate collisions.



8.2 比对与基因分配 / Alignment and Gene Assignment
Read 2 比对到参考基因组/转录组，得到它来自哪个基因的哪个位置。几个影响结果的参数：
Read 2 is aligned to the reference genome or transcriptome to determine which gene and which position it came from. Several parameters affect the result:

参考版本：GRCh38 的不同 patch、GENCODE 版本会改变基因集合和计数。
Reference version: different GRCh38 patches and GENCODE versions change the gene set and the counts.
外显子 vs 全基因：STARsolo 的 Gene 只数外显子，GeneFull 把内含子也算进去。后者对单核 RNA-seq（snRNA-seq）很重要，因为细胞核里大量是未剪接转录本。
Exons versus whole gene: STARsolo’s Gene counts only exons, whereas GeneFull also counts introns. The latter matters for single-nucleus RNA-seq (snRNA-seq), because the nucleus contains a large amount of unspliced transcripts.
链方向：10x 3’ 文库是反向链（reverse stranded），参数错了会得到几乎为 0 的计数。
Strand direction: 10x 3’ libraries are reverse stranded; the wrong parameter yields counts that are almost 0.
多比对 reads：重复序列、假基因、rRNA 会造成 multi-mapping。STARsolo 用 EM 算法在候选基因之间分配，而不是简单丢弃。
Multi-mapping reads: repeats, pseudogenes, and rRNA cause multi-mapping. STARsolo distributes them among candidate genes with an EM algorithm rather than simply discarding them.
rRNA/线粒体：通常单独统计，不进入下游 HVG。
rRNA and mitochondria: usually counted separately and kept out of the downstream HVG selection.



8.3 UMI 去重 / UMI Deduplication
同一个细胞里，同一个 UMI + 同一个基因的多条 read，视为同一个原始 mRNA 分子的 PCR 拷贝，只计一次。
Within the same cell, multiple reads sharing the same UMI and the same gene are treated as PCR copies of one original mRNA molecule and counted only once.


Code
umi <- data.frame(
  read = factor(paste0("read ", 1:7), levels = rev(paste0("read ", 1:7))),
  umi = c("ACGT", "ACGT", "ACGT", "TTGC", "TTGC", "GGAA", "CCAT"),
  gene = c("CD3D", "CD3D", "CD3D", "CD3D", "CD3D", "LYZ", "LYZ")
)
umi$status <- ifelse(duplicated(umi[, c("umi", "gene")]), "PCR duplicate", "unique molecule")

ggplot(umi, aes(umi, read, fill = status)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = ifelse(status == "PCR duplicate", "dup", "unique")),
    size = 2.6
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "unique molecule" = blog_pal[["blue"]],
    "PCR duplicate"   = blog_pal[["grey"]]
  )) +
  labs(x = "UMI", y = NULL, fill = NULL, title = "UMI collapse")








Figure 8: UMI 的作用：同一个分子被 PCR 扩增成多条 read，但 UMI 相同，最终只计为 1 个分子。 | What UMIs do: one molecule is amplified by PCR into several reads, but they share the same UMI and are ultimately counted as 1 molecule.





严格去重（exact matching）会把测序错误的 UMI 当成新分子；更常用的策略是方向性邻接去重（directional adjacency）：只有当一个 UMI 的 reads 数远少于邻居、且只差 1 个碱基时，才把它合并。UMI-tools、Cell Ranger 都实现了类似逻辑。
Strict deduplication (exact matching) would treat a sequencing-error UMI as a new molecule; the more common strategy is directional adjacency: a UMI is merged only when its read count is far lower than those of its neighbours and it differs by exactly 1 base. UMI-tools and Cell Ranger implement similar logic.
测序越深，同一个细胞里被重复测到的分子越多，新增的 reads 能带来的新分子越来越少。这条饱和曲线决定了“要不要继续加测序量”。
The deeper the sequencing, the more often molecules in the same cell are sequenced again, and the fewer new molecules each additional read can contribute. This saturation curve determines whether to keep adding sequencing depth.


Code
depth <- seq(0, 60000, length.out = 150)
sat <- bind_rows(
  data.frame(depth = depth, molecules = 3000 * (1 - exp(-depth / 3000)), cell = "high complexity"),
  data.frame(depth = depth, molecules = 900 * (1 - exp(-depth / 900)), cell = "low complexity")
)

ggplot(sat, aes(depth, molecules, colour = cell)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(blog_pal[["blue"]], blog_pal[["vermillion"]])) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = label_comma()) +
  labs(
    x = "reads assigned to one cell", y = "unique molecules recovered",
    colour = NULL
  )








Figure 9: UMI 饱和曲线：测序深度增加时，能检测到的新分子迅速减少。低复杂度细胞更早饱和。 | UMI saturation curve: as sequencing depth increases, the number of new molecules that can be detected falls rapidly. Low-complexity cells saturate earlier.







8.4 空液滴识别 / Identifying Empty Droplets
液滴测序里绝大多数条码来自不含细胞的空液滴，它们只有少量背景 RNA。区分“真细胞”和“空液滴”靠的是条码秩图（knee plot）：按 UMI 数给条码排序，真细胞会形成一段平台，空液滴迅速掉到背景水平。
In droplet sequencing the overwhelming majority of barcodes come from empty droplets that contain no cell, carrying only a small amount of background RNA. Telling real cells from empty droplets relies on the barcode rank plot (knee plot): barcodes are ranked by UMI count, real cells form a plateau, and empty droplets fall rapidly to the background level.


Code
cell_umi <- rlnorm(5000, log(3200), 0.55)
empty_umi <- rlnorm(15000, log(10), 0.9)
umi_all <- sort(c(cell_umi, empty_umi), decreasing = TRUE)
knee <- data.frame(
  rank = seq_along(umi_all),
  umi = umi_all,
  type = rep(c("Cells", "Empty droplets"), c(5000, 15000))
)

ggplot(knee, aes(rank, umi, colour = type)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 5000, linetype = "dashed", colour = blog_pal[["grey"]]) +
  annotate("text", x = 5600, y = 6000, label = "called cells", hjust = 0, size = 3.2) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = label_comma()) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = label_comma()) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(blog_pal[["blue"]], blog_pal[["grey"]])) +
  labs(x = "barcode rank", y = "UMI count", colour = NULL)








Figure 10: 条码秩图。平台与背景之间的拐点就是细胞 calling 的阈值。 | Barcode rank plot. The inflection between the plateau and the background is the threshold for cell calling.





Cell Ranger 的固定阈值（例如 UMI ≥ 500）在低深度或高背景样本里经常失效。更稳健的方法是 EmptyDrops：对每个条码检验其基因表达谱是否显著偏离背景，而不是只看总 UMI 数。
Cell Ranger’s fixed threshold (for example UMI ≥ 500) often fails in low-depth or high-background samples. A more robust method is EmptyDrops: rather than looking only at the total UMI count, it tests for each barcode whether its gene expression profile deviates significantly from the background.


8.5 输出与稀疏性 / Output and Sparsity
最终产物是三个文件：matrix.mtx（稀疏矩阵）、barcodes.tsv（细胞）、features.tsv（基因）。一个细胞通常只检测到 1,000–5,000 个基因，而人类基因组有两万多个蛋白编码基因，所以矩阵的稀疏度通常在 85%–95%。
The final product is three files: matrix.mtx (the sparse matrix), barcodes.tsv (cells), and features.tsv (genes). A cell typically has only 1,000–5,000 genes detected, whereas the human genome has more than twenty thousand protein-coding genes, so the matrix is usually 85%–95% sparse.

从这一步开始，所有分析都建立在稀疏矩阵上。任何把矩阵转成 dense data.frame 的操作，在十万级细胞时都会直接爆内存。


From this point on, all analysis rests on the sparse matrix. Any operation that converts the matrix into a dense data.frame will run out of memory outright at the hundred-thousand-cell scale.

title: Single-cell sequencing: from a cell to a cell state
section: 9. 质控：先把不是细胞的、坏掉的细胞去掉 / Quality Control: First Remove What Is Not a Cell and What Is Broken
text:
9. 质控：先把不是细胞的、坏掉的细胞去掉 / Quality Control: First Remove What Is Not a Cell and What Is Broken
拿到矩阵后第一件事不是聚类，而是 QC。常用指标：
The first thing to do with the matrix is not clustering but QC. Common metrics:

每个细胞的 UMI 总数：太低是空液滴或破损细胞，太高可能是双细胞。
Total UMIs per cell: too low means an empty droplet or a broken cell; too high may mean a doublet.
检测到的基因数：和 UMI 数高度相关，但能暴露低复杂度文库。
Number of genes detected: strongly correlated with the UMI count, but it exposes low-complexity libraries.
线粒体基因比例：细胞膜破损时胞质 RNA 流失，线粒体转录本占比升高。不同组织阈值差异很大（2%–20%）。
Mitochondrial gene fraction: when the cell membrane is damaged, cytoplasmic RNA leaks out and the fraction of mitochondrial transcripts rises. Thresholds differ greatly between tissues (2%–20%).
核糖体基因比例：过高可能提示 rRNA 污染或特定状态。
Ribosomal gene fraction: an elevated value may indicate rRNA contamination or a particular state.
双细胞（doublet）：两个细胞进了同一个液滴，会表现成“混合表达”的假细胞。
Doublets: two cells entering the same droplet appear as a fake cell with mixed expression.



Code
set.seed(21)
n <- 1200
counts_total <- rlnorm(n, log(4200), 0.5)
qc <- data.frame(
  counts = counts_total,
  genes = round(counts_total^0.62 / 4 + rnorm(n, 0, 120)),
  mito = pmax(0, rnorm(n, 14 - 0.001 * counts_total, 4))
)
qc$pass <- qc$counts > 1000 & qc$genes > 300 & qc$mito < 20

p1 <- ggplot(qc, aes(counts, genes, colour = mito)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.4, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = label_comma()) +
  scale_colour_gradient(low = blog_pal[["blue"]], high = blog_pal[["vermillion"]]) +
  labs(x = "UMI per cell", y = "genes detected", colour = "% mito")

p2 <- ggplot(qc, aes(pass, counts, fill = pass)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.7, colour = NA) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = label_comma()) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(blog_pal[["vermillion"]], blog_pal[["blue"]])) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "UMI per cell", fill = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

p1 + p2








Figure 11: 左：UMI 数与基因数的关系，颜色为线粒体比例；右：过滤前后每个细胞的 UMI 分布。 | Left: UMI count versus gene count, coloured by the mitochondrial fraction; right: the distribution of UMIs per cell before and after filtering.





阈值不建议直接抄“UMI > 1000、基因 > 500”。更稳妥的做法是按样本看分布，用 MAD（median absolute deviation）或分位数设阈值，并把过滤前后的细胞数、基因数记录下来。过度过滤会系统性丢掉低 RNA 含量的真实细胞（例如静息 T 细胞、红细胞、某些神经元）。
Copying thresholds such as UMI > 1000 and genes > 500 directly is not advisable. A more robust approach is to look at the distribution per sample, set thresholds with the MAD (median absolute deviation) or with quantiles, and record the cell and gene counts before and after filtering. Over-filtering systematically discards real cells with low RNA content (for example resting T cells, red blood cells, and some neurons).
双细胞率随上样细胞数上升。10x 的经验公式大致是每 1,000 个细胞约 0.8%，所以 10,000 个细胞里可能有 800 个左右的 doublet，需要用 Scrublet、DoubletFinder 或 scDblFinder 检测。
The doublet rate rises with the number of cells loaded. The empirical 10x formula is roughly 0.8% per 1,000 cells, so 10,000 cells may contain around 800 doublets, which need to be detected with Scrublet, DoubletFinder, or scDblFinder.


Code
cells <- seq(500, 20000, by = 500)
doublet <- data.frame(cells = cells, rate = 0.008 * cells / 1000)

ggplot(doublet, aes(cells, rate * 100)) +
  geom_line(colour = blog_pal[["blue"]], linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(
    data = data.frame(cells = c(1000, 5000, 10000, 20000)),
    aes(cells, 0.008 * cells / 1000 * 100),
    colour = blog_pal[["vermillion"]], size = 2.5
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = label_comma()) +
  labs(x = "cells loaded", y = "expected doublets (%)")








Figure 12: 双细胞率与上样细胞数的近似关系（10x 经验值）。 | Approximate relationship between the doublet rate and the number of cells loaded (empirical 10x values).





还有一类污染不容易在 QC 图里看到：ambient RNA。空液滴里的游离 RNA 会附着到真细胞上，让所有细胞都“表达”某些高丰度基因（例如血红蛋白、白蛋白、免疫球蛋白）。SoupX、CellBender 可以估计背景并扣除。判断方法是看空液滴矩阵里哪些基因最高，以及这些基因是否在所有细胞类型里均匀出现。
There is another kind of contamination that is not easy to see in QC plots: ambient RNA. Free RNA in empty droplets attaches to real cells, making all cells appear to express certain high-abundance genes (for example haemoglobin, albumin, and immunoglobulins). SoupX and CellBender can estimate and subtract the background. One way to judge is to look at which genes are highest in the empty-droplet matrix and whether those genes appear uniformly across all cell types.

objectID: posts/2026-10-22 Single-cell sequencing/index.html#标准化特征选择降维聚类-normalization-feature-selection-dimensionality-reduction-and-clustering
href: posts/2026-10-22 Single-cell sequencing/index.html#标准化特征选择降维聚类-normalization-feature-selection-dimensionality-reduction-and-clustering
title: Single-cell sequencing: from a cell to a cell state
section: 10. 标准化、特征选择、降维、聚类 / Normalization, Feature Selection, Dimensionality Reduction, and Clustering
text:
10. 标准化、特征选择、降维、聚类 / Normalization, Feature Selection, Dimensionality Reduction, and Clustering
原始 UMI 计数受三个因素影响：细胞本身的 RNA 总量、捕获效率、测序深度。所以要先标准化，再做降维。
Raw UMI counts are affected by three factors: the cell’s own total RNA content, the capture efficiency, and the sequencing depth. So normalize first, then reduce dimensions.

10.1 标准化 / Normalization
最常见的做法是 library-size normalization + log1p：每个细胞除以总计数，乘一个常数（常用 10,000），再取 log1p。它的作用是把“均值–方差”关系拉平，让高表达基因不再天然占据全部方差。
The most common approach is library-size normalization + log1p: divide each cell by its total count, multiply by a constant (commonly 10,000), and then take log1p. Its effect is to flatten the mean–variance relationship so that highly expressed genes no longer naturally occupy all of the variance.


Code
mu <- 10^seq(0, 4, length.out = 150)
mv <- bind_rows(
  data.frame(mean = mu, variance = mu + (0.5 * mu)^2, method = "Raw counts"),
  data.frame(mean = mu, variance = 0.2 + 1.2 / (mu + 1), method = "Log-normalized")
)

ggplot(mv, aes(mean, variance)) +
  geom_line(colour = blog_pal[["blue"]], linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ method, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_log10(labels = label_comma()) +
  labs(x = "mean expression", y = "variance")








Figure 13: 原始计数的方差随均值平方增长；log 标准化后方差近似与均值无关。 | The variance of raw counts grows with the square of the mean; after log normalization the variance is approximately independent of the mean.





其他常用方案：
Other common approaches:

scran pooling：先对细胞分组、用 pooled size factor 估计，适合细胞间 RNA 总量差异很大的数据。
scran pooling: group the cells first and estimate with a pooled size factor; suited to data in which total RNA content differs greatly between cells.
SCTransform / Pearson residuals：直接用负二项模型对计数建模，输出残差，避免 log 变换的偏差。
SCTransform / Pearson residuals: model the counts directly with a negative binomial model and output residuals, avoiding the bias of the log transform.
scVI / totalVI：用变分自编码器学习低维表示，同时校正批次；适合十万级以上细胞。
scVI / totalVI: learn a low-dimensional representation with a variational autoencoder while correcting for batch; suited to a hundred thousand cells and beyond.



10.2 特征选择 / Feature Selection
标准化之后选出高变基因（HVG），只保留信息量最大的 2,000–3,000 个基因。常用方法有 vst、mean.var.plot、dispersion，以及基于 Poisson 偏差的 scry。HVG 的选择会显著影响聚类结果，建议做敏感性分析（例如 1,000 / 2,000 / 4,000 个基因各跑一次）。
After normalization, highly variable genes (HVGs) are selected, keeping only the 2,000–3,000 most informative genes. Common methods include vst, mean.var.plot, dispersion, and the Poisson-deviance-based scry. The choice of HVGs markedly affects the clustering result, so a sensitivity analysis is recommended (for example running once each with 1,000 / 2,000 / 4,000 genes).


10.3 PCA、kNN 图与聚类 / PCA, the kNN Graph, and Clustering
PCA 的前几十个主成分构成细胞的低维表示，在这个空间里建 kNN 图，用 Leiden/Louvain 做社区发现，就得到了聚类；UMAP 或 tSNE 只是把这个图再压到二维用来可视化。
The first few dozen principal components of PCA form the low-dimensional representation of the cells; a kNN graph is built in this space, and community detection with Leiden/Louvain yields the clusters; UMAP or tSNE merely compresses that graph into two dimensions for visualization.


Code
set.seed(8)
pts <- data.frame(
  x = c(rnorm(45, 0, 0.7), rnorm(45, 3.2, 0.7)),
  y = c(rnorm(45, 0, 0.7), rnorm(45, 2.4, 0.7)),
  group = factor(rep(c("Cluster A", "Cluster B"), each = 45))
)
d <- as.matrix(dist(pts[, c("x", "y")]))
k <- 4
edges <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(pts)), function(i) {
  nn <- order(d[i, ])[2:(k + 1)]
  data.frame(x = pts$x[i], y = pts$y[i], xend = pts$x[nn], yend = pts$y[nn])
}))

ggplot(pts, aes(x, y)) +
  geom_segment(
    data = edges, aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend),
    colour = blog_pal[["grey"]], linewidth = 0.2, alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = group), size = 1.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(blog_pal[["blue"]], blog_pal[["vermillion"]])) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(x = "PC1", y = "PC2", colour = NULL)








Figure 14: 聚类的本质是图分割：每个细胞连到最近的 k 个邻居，社区发现算法在图上找连接更密的区域。 | Clustering is essentially graph partitioning: each cell is connected to its k nearest neighbours, and a community-detection algorithm finds regions of denser connectivity in the graph.







Code
set.seed(33)
genes <- 300
per <- 100

make_block <- function(i) {
  m <- matrix(rnorm(genes * per, 5, 1), nrow = genes)
  rows <- ((i - 1) * 40 + 1):(i * 40)
  m[rows, ] <- m[rows, ] + 3.5
  m
}

expr <- do.call(cbind, lapply(1:3, make_block))
expr[expr < 0] <- 0
pca <- prcomp(t(expr), center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)
km <- kmeans(pca$x[, 1:10], centers = 3, nstart = 20)
emb <- data.frame(PC1 = pca$x[, 1], PC2 = pca$x[, 2], cluster = factor(km$cluster))
var_pc <- round(100 * summary(pca)$importance[2, 1:2], 1)
centers <- emb %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(PC1 = mean(PC1), PC2 = mean(PC2), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(emb, aes(PC1, PC2, colour = cluster)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8, alpha = 0.75) +
  stat_ellipse(linewidth = 0.5) +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
    data = centers,
    aes(label = paste("Cluster", cluster)),
    fill = "white", alpha = 0.88, label.size = 0.25, size = 3, seed = 1,
    point.padding = unit(0.8, "lines"), box.padding = 0.8,
    min.segment.length = 0, show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = pal[1:3]) +
  labs(
    x = paste0("PC1 (", var_pc[1], "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", var_pc[2], "%)"),
    colour = "cluster"
  )








Figure 15: 对模拟的三群细胞做 PCA 与 k-means：聚类结构在 PC1–PC2 上已经很清楚。 | PCA and k-means on three simulated groups of cells: the cluster structure is already clear on PC1–PC2.





关于聚类有三个常见误解：
There are three common misconceptions about clustering:

分辨率不是越高越好：Leiden 的 resolution 越大，簇越多；要结合 marker 和稳定性选择，而不是调到“看起来分得开”。
Higher resolution is not better: the larger Leiden’s resolution, the more clusters; choose it together with markers and stability rather than tuning it until the groups look separated.
UMAP 的距离不是生物学距离：它只保留局部邻接关系，簇间距离和面积都不代表相似度或细胞数。
UMAP distances are not biological distances: it preserves only local adjacency, and neither the distances between clusters nor their areas represent similarity or cell number.
聚类不是细胞类型：一个 cluster 可以包含多个类型，一个类型也可以被拆成多个 cluster；注释需要 marker 或参考映射。
A cluster is not a cell type: one cluster can contain several types, and one type can be split into several clusters; annotation requires markers or reference mapping.

objectID: posts/2026-10-22 Single-cell sequencing/index.html#注释细胞类型-annotating-cell-types
href: posts/2026-10-22 Single-cell sequencing/index.html#注释细胞类型-annotating-cell-types
title: Single-cell sequencing: from a cell to a cell state
section: 11. 注释细胞类型 / Annotating Cell Types
text:
11. 注释细胞类型 / Annotating Cell Types
聚类只给出 cluster 0、1、2，接下来才是生物学：这些 cluster 是什么细胞、处于什么状态。
Clustering only gives cluster 0, 1, 2; the biology comes next: what cells these clusters are and what state they are in.
最常用的方法是标记基因：看每个 cluster 里哪些基因特异高表达。把“表达比例”和“平均表达量”画成点图，是单细胞文章里最常见的图之一。
The most common approach is marker genes: look at which genes are specifically highly expressed in each cluster. Plotting expression fraction against mean expression as a dot plot is one of the most familiar figures in single-cell papers.


Code
markers <- data.frame(
  gene = c("CD3D", "CD79A", "LYZ", "NKG7"),
  cluster = c("T", "B", "Myeloid", "NK")
)
grid <- expand.grid(gene = markers$gene, cluster = c("T", "B", "Myeloid", "NK"))
grid$own <- markers$cluster[match(grid$gene, markers$gene)] == grid$cluster
set.seed(4)
grid$pct <- ifelse(grid$own, runif(nrow(grid), 70, 95), runif(nrow(grid), 5, 40))
grid$avg <- ifelse(grid$own, runif(nrow(grid), 1.5, 3), runif(nrow(grid), 0, 1))

ggplot(grid, aes(cluster, gene)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = pct, colour = avg)) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1, 8)) +
  scale_colour_gradient(low = blog_pal[["grey"]], high = blog_pal[["blue"]]) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, size = "% expressed", colour = "mean\nexpression")








Figure 16: 标记基因点图：点的大小是表达该基因的细胞比例，颜色是平均表达量。 | Marker-gene dot plot: dot size is the fraction of cells expressing the gene, and colour is the mean expression.





注释的三条路径：
Three routes to annotation:

人工 marker：可解释性最好，但依赖经验，且对稀有类型不敏感。
Manual markers: the most interpretable, but depends on experience and is insensitive to rare types.
参考映射：把细胞投影到已注释的参考图谱（Azimuth、scType、CellTypist、scANVI），适合免疫、脑等有成熟图谱的组织。
Reference mapping: project the cells onto an annotated reference atlas (Azimuth, scType, CellTypist, scANVI), suited to tissues with mature atlases such as immune and brain.
自动聚类 + 差异基因：先找每个 cluster 的 top genes，再和文献/数据库比对。
Automatic clustering + differential genes: find the top genes of each cluster and then compare them with the literature or databases.

注释之后建议做两件事：亚聚类（在某个类型内部再分状态）和独立验证（蛋白流式、原位杂交、空间转录组）。只靠同一批 marker 循环论证，是单细胞文章最常见的硬伤。
Two things are recommended after annotation: subclustering (splitting states within a type) and independent validation (protein flow cytometry, in situ hybridization, spatial transcriptomics). Arguing in a circle with the same set of markers is the most common weakness of single-cell papers.

objectID: posts/2026-10-22 Single-cell sequencing/index.html#细胞状态与动态过程-cell-states-and-dynamic-processes
href: posts/2026-10-22 Single-cell sequencing/index.html#细胞状态与动态过程-cell-states-and-dynamic-processes
title: Single-cell sequencing: from a cell to a cell state
section: 12. 细胞状态与动态过程 / Cell States and Dynamic Processes
text:
12. 细胞状态与动态过程 / Cell States and Dynamic Processes
除了离散的标记基因，状态还可以用打分来描述：细胞周期（S/G2M）、耗竭（exhaustion）、干扰素响应、缺氧、衰老……这些分数通常是一组基因的平均表达，在 UMAP 上用连续色阶展示。打分方法有 AddModuleScore、UCell、AUCell、GSVA，区别在于是否考虑背景表达和细胞间可比性。
Besides discrete marker genes, state can also be described by scoring: cell cycle (S/G2M), exhaustion, interferon response, hypoxia, senescence, and so on. These scores are usually the mean expression of a gene set, shown on UMAP as a continuous colour scale. Scoring methods include AddModuleScore, UCell, AUCell, and GSVA, which differ in whether background expression and comparability between cells are taken into account.
如果细胞来自一个分化过程，聚类得到的离散标签就不够用了。拟时序（pseudotime）把细胞按表达相似性排到一条轨迹上，RNA velocity则用未剪接/已剪接 reads 的比例预测每个细胞“下一步往哪走”。
If the cells come from a differentiation process, the discrete labels from clustering are no longer sufficient. Pseudotime orders cells along a trajectory by expression similarity, while RNA velocity uses the ratio of unspliced to spliced reads to predict where each cell will go next.


Code
set.seed(6)
n_cells <- 80
n_g <- 40
t <- seq(0, 1, length.out = n_cells)
peaks <- seq(0.08, 0.92, length.out = n_g)
wave <- outer(peaks, t, function(p, tt) exp(-((tt - p)^2) / (2 * 0.055^2)))

pt <- expand.grid(gene = 1:n_g, cell = 1:n_cells)
pt$expr <- as.vector(wave)

ggplot(pt, aes(cell, gene, fill = expr)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = c("#FFFFFF", "#56B4E9", "#0072B2", "#CC79A7")) +
  labs(x = "pseudotime →", y = "genes", fill = NULL) +
  theme(axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank())








Figure 17: 拟时序热图：每一行是一个基因，按峰值位置排序，可以看到基因模块沿轨迹依次开启。 | Pseudotime heatmap: each row is a gene, ordered by the position of its peak, showing gene modules switching on in sequence along the trajectory.







Code
tt <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 35)
x <- cos(tt * pi * 1.15)
y <- sin(tt * pi * 0.85)
vel <- data.frame(
  x = x, y = y, t = tt,
  vx = c(diff(x), 0), vy = c(diff(y), 0)
)

ggplot(vel, aes(x, y)) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(xend = x + vx * 4, yend = y + vy * 4, colour = t),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.12, "cm"), type = "closed"), linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = t), size = 1.6) +
  scale_colour_gradient(low = blog_pal[["sky"]], high = blog_pal[["vermillion"]]) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(x = "PC1", y = "PC2", colour = "pseudotime")








Figure 18: RNA velocity 的直观形式：每个细胞的箭头指向它预测的下一个状态。 | An intuitive picture of RNA velocity: each cell’s arrow points to the next state it predicts.





需要强调的是：注释不是终点，而是下一轮分析的起点。你得到的不是一个“答案”，而是一组带标签的细胞和一堆可以验证的假设。
It should be stressed that annotation is not the end point but the starting point of the next round of analysis. What you get is not an answer but a set of labelled cells and a pile of hypotheses that can be tested.

objectID: posts/2026-10-22 Single-cell sequencing/index.html#多组学整合与空间-multi-omics-integration-and-space
href: posts/2026-10-22 Single-cell sequencing/index.html#多组学整合与空间-multi-omics-integration-and-space
title: Single-cell sequencing: from a cell to a cell state
section: 13. 多组学、整合与空间 / Multi-omics, Integration, and Space
text:
13. 多组学、整合与空间 / Multi-omics, Integration, and Space
单细胞项目很少只做一个模态。常见的组合：
Single-cell projects rarely involve only one modality. Common combinations:

RNA + ATAC（10x Multiome）：同一批细胞核同时测表达和染色质可及性，用 WNN（weighted nearest neighbor）联合聚类，可以把“哪个 enhancer 驱动了哪个基因”放到同一个细胞里看。
RNA + ATAC (10x Multiome): expression and chromatin accessibility are measured in the same batch of nuclei; joint clustering with WNN (weighted nearest neighbour) lets which enhancer drives which gene be examined in the same cell.
RNA + 蛋白（CITE-seq）：抗体标签（ADT）提供表面蛋白，常用来区分 T 细胞亚群、NK 亚群，或做样本 hashing。
RNA + protein (CITE-seq): antibody tags (ADTs) provide surface proteins and are often used to distinguish T-cell and NK subsets, or to hash samples.
RNA + 空间（Visium / Xenium）：把单细胞图谱映射到组织切片，回答“这群细胞在哪个区域”。
RNA + space (Visium / Xenium): map the single-cell atlas onto a tissue section to answer in which region this group of cells sits.
多样本整合：Harmony、BBKNN、scVI、Seurat CCA/RPCA。整合的目标是去掉批次，不是把所有样本强行混在一起；如果生物学差异本身很大，过度整合会抹掉真实信号。
Multi-sample integration: Harmony, BBKNN, scVI, Seurat CCA/RPCA. The goal of integration is to remove batch, not to force all samples together; if the biological differences themselves are large, over-integration erases real signal.



Code
set.seed(15)
demo <- data.frame(
  x = c(rnorm(80, -2, 0.8), rnorm(80, 2, 0.8)),
  y = c(rnorm(80, 0, 0.8), rnorm(80, 0, 0.8)),
  type = factor(rep(c("T", "B"), each = 80)),
  batch = factor(rep(c("batch 1", "batch 2"), 80))
)
demo$x[demo$batch == "batch 2"] <- demo$x[demo$batch == "batch 2"] + 1.6

p1 <- ggplot(demo, aes(x, y, colour = batch)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(blog_pal[["blue"]], blog_pal[["orange"]])) +
  labs(title = "before", x = "PC1", y = "PC2", colour = NULL)

p2 <- ggplot(demo, aes(x - ifelse(batch == "batch 2", 1.6, 0), y, colour = type)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(blog_pal[["blue"]], blog_pal[["vermillion"]])) +
  labs(title = "after", x = "PC1", y = "PC2", colour = NULL)

p1 + p2








Figure 19: 整合的直观目标：左图按样本分开，右图按细胞类型混合；好的整合应当去掉批次但保留类型。 | The intuitive goal of integration: the left panel separates by sample and the right panel mixes by cell type; good integration should remove batch while preserving type.

objectID: posts/2026-10-22 Single-cell sequencing/index.html#从-count-matrix-到下一轮结果-from-the-count-matrix-to-the-next-round-of-results
href: posts/2026-10-22 Single-cell sequencing/index.html#从-count-matrix-到下一轮结果-from-the-count-matrix-to-the-next-round-of-results
title: Single-cell sequencing: from a cell to a cell state
section: 14. 从 count matrix 到下一轮结果 / From the Count Matrix to the Next Round of Results
text:
14. 从 count matrix 到下一轮结果 / From the Count Matrix to the Next Round of Results
单细胞项目的“下一轮”通常发生在五个方向：
The next round of a single-cell project usually happens in five directions:

差异表达：某个基因在病人和对照的同一细胞类型里是否变化？推荐 pseudobulk + DESeq2/edgeR，而不是把每个细胞当独立样本做 Wilcoxon（后者会给出极小的 p 值）。
Differential expression: does a gene change in the same cell type between patients and controls? pseudobulk + DESeq2/edgeR is recommended, rather than treating each cell as an independent sample in a Wilcoxon test (the latter yields extremely small p values).
细胞比例：某个细胞类型是否扩增或缺失？用 propeller、sccomp、scCODA 等考虑组成数据的模型，并按样本重复检验。
Cell proportions: is a cell type expanded or depleted? Use models that account for compositional data, such as propeller, sccomp, and scCODA, and test across sample replicates.
细胞间通讯：配体–受体共表达分析（CellChat、CellPhoneDB、NicheNet）推测哪群细胞在“对话”。
Cell–cell communication: ligand–receptor co-expression analysis (CellChat, CellPhoneDB, NicheNet) to infer which groups of cells are talking to each other.
多组学整合：把 RNA 与 ATAC、蛋白、空间位置对齐（Harmony、scVI、TotalVI、WNN）。
Multi-omics integration: align RNA with ATAC, protein, and spatial position (Harmony, scVI, TotalVI, WNN).
把状态映射回组织：用参考图谱做 label transfer（Azimuth），或把单细胞图谱反卷积到空间转录组上。
Mapping state back to tissue: label transfer with a reference atlas (Azimuth), or deconvolving the single-cell atlas onto spatial transcriptomics.

整条链路可以压缩成一张图：
The whole chain can be compressed into a single figure:


Code
steps <- data.frame(
  x = 1:6,
  label = c(
    "Tissue\n→ single cells", "Droplet\nbarcode + UMI", "FASTQ\nreads",
    "Count matrix\ncells × genes", "QC, clustering\nannotation", "Cell states\n→ next question"
  )
)

ggplot(steps, aes(x = x, y = 0)) +
  geom_rect(
    aes(xmin = x - 0.44, xmax = x + 0.44, ymin = -0.3, ymax = 0.3),
    fill = "#E8F1F8", colour = blog_pal[["blue"]], linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), size = 3, lineheight = 1) +
  geom_segment(
    data = data.frame(x = 1:5),
    aes(x = x + 0.44, xend = x + 0.56, y = 0, yend = 0),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.12, "cm"), type = "closed"),
    colour = blog_pal[["blue"]]
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0.4, 6.6), ylim = c(-0.5, 0.5)) +
  theme_void()








Figure 20: 从组织到细胞状态的完整链路。每一步的输出都是下一步的输入。 | The complete chain from tissue to cell state. The output of every step is the input of the next.

objectID: posts/2026-10-22 Single-cell sequencing/index.html#常见坑与检查清单-common-pitfalls-and-a-checklist
href: posts/2026-10-22 Single-cell sequencing/index.html#常见坑与检查清单-common-pitfalls-and-a-checklist
title: Single-cell sequencing: from a cell to a cell state
section: 15. 常见坑与检查清单 / Common Pitfalls and a Checklist
text:
15. 常见坑与检查清单 / Common Pitfalls and a Checklist
分析前
Before analysis

参考基因组版本、试剂盒版本、链方向是否一致？
Are the reference genome version, kit version, and strand direction consistent?
是否有生物学重复？批次是否平衡？
Are there biological replicates? Is the batch balanced?
空液滴阈值是否按样本检查过？
Has the empty-droplet threshold been checked per sample?

分析中
During analysis

是否做 doublet 检测？doublet 是否被当成新类型？
Is doublet detection performed? Have doublets been treated as a new type?
是否检查 ambient RNA？高丰度污染基因是否驱动了聚类？
Is ambient RNA checked? Do high-abundance contaminating genes drive the clustering?
过滤阈值是否过严？是否丢掉了低 RNA 含量的真实细胞？
Are the filtering thresholds too strict? Have real cells with low RNA content been lost?
HVG 数量、PC 数、Leiden 分辨率是否做过敏感性分析？
Have the HVG number, PC number, and Leiden resolution been tested in a sensitivity analysis?
整合是否过度？批次和生物学是否被混为一谈？
Is the integration excessive? Have batch and biology been conflated?

解释时
When interpreting

是否用 pseudobulk 做差异表达？
Is differential expression done with pseudobulk?
细胞比例变化是否按样本重复检验？
Are changes in cell proportions tested across sample replicates?
marker 是否独立验证？是否循环论证？
Are markers validated independently? Is the argument circular?
UMAP 距离/面积是否被当作生物学差异？
Are UMAP distances or areas treated as biological differences?
结论是否能被第二个数据集、蛋白或空间数据支持？
Can the conclusions be supported by a second dataset, protein, or spatial data?

objectID: posts/2026-10-22 Single-cell sequencing/index.html#术语表-glossary
href: posts/2026-10-22 Single-cell sequencing/index.html#术语表-glossary
title: Single-cell sequencing: from a cell to a cell state
section: 16. 术语表 / Glossary
text:
16. 术语表 / Glossary



术语
含义




Cell barcode
16 bp 细胞标签，标识一个液滴/细胞


UMI
分子标签，用于去除 PCR 重复


Whitelist
平台预设的合法条码列表


Empty droplet
不含细胞、只有背景 RNA 的液滴


Ambient RNA
空液滴中的游离 RNA，会污染真细胞


Doublet
两个细胞进入同一个液滴


Count matrix
基因 × 细胞的 UMI 计数矩阵


HVG
高变基因，用于降维


Pseudobulk
把同一细胞类型的细胞计数相加成样本级表达


Label transfer
把参考图谱的细胞类型标签映射到新数据


Pseudotime
按表达相似性推断的细胞顺序


RNA velocity
用剪接比例预测细胞状态变化方向



English







Term
Meaning




Cell barcode
a 16 bp cell tag that identifies a droplet or cell


UMI
a molecular tag used to remove PCR duplicates


Whitelist
the list of valid barcodes predefined by the platform


Empty droplet
a droplet with no cell and only background RNA


Ambient RNA
free RNA from empty droplets that contaminates real cells


Doublet
two cells entering the same droplet


Count matrix
a gene × cell UMI count matrix


HVG
highly variable genes, used for dimensionality reduction


Pseudobulk
summing counts of cells of the same type into sample-level expression


Label transfer
mapping cell-type labels from a reference atlas onto new data


Pseudotime
a cell ordering inferred from expression similarity


RNA velocity
predicting the direction of state change from splicing ratios

title: From Non-Life to Life: Philosophy, Self-Organization, Information, and the Emergence of Living Systems
text:
写作说明 / A Note on the Writing



本文由 AI（DeepSeek-Flash） 检索、整理并撰写，尚未经过人工逐条校对。文中的文献信息经过初步核对（部分附 DOI），但作者、年份、卷期仍可能存在错误；引用前请以 DOI 或出版方页面为准。
This article was retrieved, organised, and written by AI (DeepSeek-Flash) and has not yet been verified item by item by a human. The bibliographic information has been checked only preliminarily (some entries include a DOI), but authors, years, volumes, and issue numbers may still contain errors; before citing, please rely on the DOI or the publisher’s page.
文中所有图都是概念示意图，由本文 R 代码在渲染时生成，不是实验数据。凡属作者推论、类比或尚未被实验支持的主张，正文中都会用”推测”“假说”“目前的模型认为”等措辞显式标注；请把这类句子与有实验依据的陈述区分开。
All figures in this article are conceptual schematics generated at render time by the article’s own R code; they are not experimental data. Wherever a claim is an inference or analogy by the author, or is not yet supported by experiment, the text explicitly flags it with wording such as “speculation”, “hypothesis”, or “current models suggest”; please distinguish such sentences from statements that have experimental support.
本文不主张生命起源问题已经被解决。它的目标恰好相反：说清楚哪些转变已经被实验或模型支持，哪些仍是空白。
This article does not claim that the problem of the origin of life has been solved. Its aim is precisely the opposite: to make clear which transitions are already supported by experiment or by models, and which remain blank.
一块花岗岩、一支蜡烛的火焰、一杯在黄色与蓝色之间周期性振荡的 Belousov–Zhabotinsky 反应液，以及一个正在分裂的大肠杆菌——把这四样东西并排放在桌上，几乎所有人都能立刻指出”最后一个是活的”。但若被追问依据是什么，答案会立刻变得含糊：细菌会代谢，火焰也会消耗燃料；细菌会复制，反应液也能在时间上自我复制图案；细菌有边界，岩石也有边界；细菌会响应环境，火焰也会随气流改变形状。
A block of granite, the flame of a candle, a cup of Belousov–Zhabotinsky reaction liquid oscillating periodically between yellow and blue, and a dividing Escherichia coli cell—place these four things side by side on a table and almost anyone will immediately point to “the last one is alive.” Yet when pressed on what the basis for that judgement is, the answer at once becomes vague: bacteria metabolise, but a flame also consumes fuel; bacteria replicate, but the reaction liquid can also replicate a pattern in time; bacteria have a boundary, but so does a rock; bacteria respond to their environment, but a flame also changes shape with the airflow.
生命起源研究的困难，并不只是”我们还不知道那条化学反应路径”。更深的一层是：我们用来判断”这是生命”的标准本身，是一个哲学上未经澄清的混合体——一部分是热力学直觉（它维持自身远离平衡），一部分是信息直觉（它把信息传给下一代），一部分是目的论直觉（它为某种东西服务），一部分只是地球生物学的偶然特征（它有细胞膜、用 DNA、含碳）。
The difficulty of origin-of-life research is not merely that “we do not yet know the chemical reaction pathway.” A deeper layer is this: the very standard by which we judge “this is life” is itself a philosophically unclarified mixture—partly a thermodynamic intuition (it sustains itself far from equilibrium), partly an informational intuition (it transmits information to the next generation), partly a teleological intuition (it serves some purpose), and partly nothing more than contingent features of terrestrial biology (it has a cell membrane, uses DNA, contains carbon).
因此这篇文章不按学科分章（哲学、化学、热力学、计算机），而是沿着一条概念主线推进：一块物质要经过哪些组织方式的转变，才配被称为”活的”？ 这条主线可以画成一张粗糙的路线图：
This article is therefore not organised by discipline (philosophy, chemistry, thermodynamics, computer science) but advances along a single conceptual thread: through which transformations of organisation must a piece of matter pass before it deserves to be called “alive”? This thread can be drawn as a rough roadmap:
Code
stages <- data.frame(
  i = 1:7,
  label = c(
    "non-living matter",
    "reaction networks\nand energy flow",
    "self-organization:\nlocal order",
    "autocatalytic and\nconstraint closure",
    "bounded individual\n(protocell)",
    "heredity and\nselection",
    "open-ended life"
  )
)

ggplot(stages) +
  geom_rect(
    aes(xmin = 0.08, xmax = 0.92, ymin = i - 0.34, ymax = i + 0.34, fill = factor(i)),
    colour = "white", linewidth = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(0.5, i, label = label),
    colour = "white", fontface = "bold", size = 4.1, lineheight = 1.05
  ) +
  geom_text(aes(0.025, i, label = i), colour = "grey45", size = 3.2, hjust = 0) +
  annotate("segment", x = 0.04, xend = 0.04, y = 0.62, yend = 7.30,
           arrow = arrow(length = unit(2, "mm")), colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(pal[1:6], blog_pal[["grey"]]), guide = "none") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0.45, 7.55), clip = "off") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_blog() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(), legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(6, 6, 6, 6)
  )








Figure 1: 从物质到生命的概念路线图。每一级台阶都对应一种组织方式的改变，而不是某种新物质的出现。这个顺序是分析性的，不代表历史上必然按此顺序发生；真实过程可能重叠、并行、甚至跳跃。 | A conceptual roadmap from matter to life. Each step corresponds to a change in the mode of organisation, not to the appearance of a new kind of substance. This ordering is analytical; it does not imply that the historical process necessarily followed it, and the real process may have overlapped, run in parallel, or even jumped.
需要预先说明三种”证据等级”，因为后文会反复用到：
Three “grades of evidence” must be stated in advance, because they will recur repeatedly in what follows:
把这三者混为一谈，是生命起源讨论里最常见的错误——也是最容易产生”科学家已经破解生命起源”这类标题的原因。
Conflating these three is the most common error in discussions of the origin of life—and the most reliable way to produce headlines of the form “scientists have cracked the origin of life.”

text:
第一章　生命为什么是一个哲学难题？ / Chapter 1. Why Is Life a Philosophical Problem?

1.1 四种”像生命”的东西 / 1.1 Four Things That Look Like Life
先做一次思想实验。把岩石、火焰、化学振荡反应和细菌放在同一张桌子上，逐一检查它们共享哪些属性：
Begin with a thought experiment. Place a rock, a flame, a chemical oscillating reaction, and a bacterium on the same table, and examine one by one which properties they share:

火焰几乎满足了”远离平衡 + 自我维持”，却不满足”可遗传变异”。BZ 反应同时满足”自组织 + 时间周期性”，但没有信息传递。细菌则同时具备全部，而且这些属性彼此耦合：膜维持了浓度梯度，浓度梯度驱动代谢，代谢产物参与膜脂合成。
A flame satisfies “far from equilibrium + self-maintenance” almost completely, yet it does not satisfy “heritable variation.” The BZ reaction satisfies both “self-organisation + temporal periodicity,” yet it has no transmission of information. A bacterium possesses all of them at once, and these properties are coupled to one another: the membrane maintains a concentration gradient, the gradient drives metabolism, and the products of metabolism participate in the synthesis of membrane lipids.
这份表格的关键不是找到一条分界线，而是发现：“活着”不是一个二值属性，而是一组彼此依赖的能力。这直接导致了现代生命定义的三种典型策略。
The point of this table is not to find a dividing line but to notice that “being alive” is not a binary property but a set of mutually dependent capacities. This leads directly to the three typical strategies in modern definitions of life.


1.2 亚里士多德：形式、潜能与现实 / 1.2 Aristotle: Form, Potentiality, and Actuality
亚里士多德在《论灵魂》（De Anima）中给出的定义，至今仍是最有生命力的哲学框架之一：生命体是具有灵魂（psychē）的自然物体，而灵魂是”潜在地拥有生命的自然身体的形式（eidos）“。这里的”形式”不是外形，而是使质料成为”这一种东西”的组织原则。
In De Anima, Aristotle offers a definition that remains one of the most fertile philosophical frameworks available: a living thing is a natural body that possesses a soul (psychē), and the soul is “the form (eidos) of a natural body that potentially has life.” “Form” here does not mean outward shape but the organising principle that makes matter into “this kind of thing.”
更关键的是他区分了潜能（dynamis）与现实（energeia）。种子潜在地是一棵树；眼睛潜在地能看。生命不是某种附加在物质上的神秘成分，而是物质在特定组织下持续实现自身功能的方式。
More decisively, he distinguishes potentiality (dynamis) from actuality (energeia). A seed is potentially a tree; an eye is potentially able to see. Life is not some mysterious ingredient added to matter; it is the way matter, under a particular organisation, continuously realises its own functions.
这一框架的现代回声非常明显：后面会看到，自创生理论（autopoiesis）说的”系统持续生产自身组成部分”，Kauffman 说的”整体为部分而存在、部分为整体而存在”的康德式整体（Kantian whole），本质上都是把”形式”重新解释为组织的因果闭合。亚里士多德的问题意识——生命是实体还是过程——从未真正消失。
The modern echoes of this framework are unmistakable: as we shall see, the autopoietic claim that “the system continuously produces its own components,” and Kauffman’s Kantian whole, in which “the whole exists for the parts and the parts for the whole,” are at bottom reinterpretations of “form” as the causal closure of organisation. Aristotle’s underlying question—whether life is a substance or a process—has never really gone away.


1.3 机械论与活力论：一场没有真正结束的争论 / 1.3 Mechanism and Vitalism: An Argument That Never Really Ended
17 世纪以后，机械论把生物体比作钟表：心脏是泵，肺是风箱，肌肉是杠杆。笛卡尔甚至认为动物是自动机。与之相对的活力论（vitalism）主张，生命含有某种非物理的”生命力”（élan vital 的前身），无法用物理化学解释。
From the seventeenth century onward, mechanism likened organisms to clocks: the heart is a pump, the lungs are bellows, the muscles are levers. Descartes even held that animals are automata. Vitalism, by contrast, maintained that life contains some non-physical “vital force” (the forerunner of the élan vital) that cannot be explained by physics and chemistry.
20 世纪分子生物学基本判了活力论死刑：没有发现任何违反物理定律的”生命力”。但这场争论留下了一个没有被真正解决的问题：把生命完全还原为分子间相互作用，会不会丢掉某些真实的因果结构？
Twentieth-century molecular biology effectively pronounced a death sentence on vitalism: no “vital force” violating the laws of physics was ever found. Yet the debate left behind a problem that has not really been resolved: does reducing life entirely to interactions among molecules discard some genuine causal structure?
当代的”新机械论”（new mechanism）与系统生物学给出的折中方案是：不引入神秘力量，但承认组织层次本身具有因果效力。一个酶的性质由分子结构决定，但”这个反应发生在哪个区室、受哪个调控网络控制”这类问题，无法只在原子层面回答。
The compromise offered by contemporary “new mechanism” and systems biology is this: introduce no mysterious forces, but acknowledge that levels of organisation themselves possess causal efficacy. The properties of an enzyme are determined by its molecular structure, but questions such as “in which compartment does this reaction occur, and which regulatory network controls it” cannot be answered at the level of atoms alone.


1.4 康德：部分与整体的相互依赖 / 1.4 Kant: The Mutual Dependence of Parts and Whole
康德在《判断力批判》（1790）第 65 节给出了一个常被引用的表述：在有组织的自然产物中，每一部分都既是手段又是目的；部分只有在与整体的关系中才可能存在，而整体又通过部分而存在。
In §65 of the Critique of Judgement (1790), Kant gives a frequently cited formulation: in an organised product of nature, every part is at once means and end; a part can exist only in relation to the whole, and the whole exists through the parts.
他称这样的对象为”自然目的”（Naturzweck），并强调这是一个反思性判断的调节性原则，而不是构成性知识。换句话说：我们看待生物时不得不使用目的论语言，但这不证明自然界真有目的。
He calls such an object a “natural end” (Naturzweck) and stresses that this is a regulative principle of reflective judgement, not constitutive knowledge. In other words: in looking at organisms we cannot avoid teleological language, but that does not prove that nature actually has purposes.
康德的表述之所以重要，是因为它预见了现代”因果闭合”的思想：生命系统的特殊性不在于它由什么组成，而在于它的因果关系是循环的——产物反过来是原因。Kauffman 与 Roli 在 2025 年明确把自催化集合称为”康德式整体”，正是这一思路的当代版本。
Kant’s formulation matters because it anticipates the modern idea of “causal closure”: what is distinctive about living systems is not what they are made of but that their causality is circular—the product is in turn the cause. Kauffman and Roli’s explicit description of autocatalytic sets as “Kantian wholes” in 2025 is precisely a contemporary version of this line of thought.


1.5 柏格森与过程哲学：生命作为持续的创造 / 1.5 Bergson and Process Philosophy: Life as Continuous Creation
柏格森在《创造性进化》（1907）中反对把生命理解为机械装配，也反对把它理解为朝向某个固定目的的努力。他提出的”生命冲力”（élan vital）常被误读为神秘主义，但其真正的哲学要点是：演化是持续的创造性过程，不能被还原为对预先存在可能性的选择。
In Creative Evolution (1907), Bergson rejects the understanding of life as mechanical assembly, and equally rejects the understanding of it as a striving toward some fixed goal. His “vital impetus” (élan vital) is often misread as mysticism, but its real philosophical point is this: evolution is a continuous creative process that cannot be reduced to a selection among pre-existing possibilities.
这一直觉在当代有两个科学版本：
This intuition has two scientific versions today:

开放式演化（open-ended evolution）：系统不断产生新的可能性空间，而不是在固定空间里搜索。
Open-ended evolution: the system continually generates new spaces of possibility rather than searching within a fixed space.
个体化（individuation）：个体不是预先给定的单位，而是在过程中逐步形成的——这正是 Simondon 在 1958 年提出的核心问题，我们会在第七章回到它。
Individuation: the individual is not a unit given in advance but something gradually constituted in the course of a process—precisely the central problem raised by Simondon in 1958, to which we shall return in Chapter 7.



1.6 薛定谔的问题：生命靠什么对抗熵增？ / 1.6 Schrödinger’s Question: What Does Life Use to Resist the Growth of Entropy?
1944 年，薛定谔在《生命是什么？》中提出一个至今仍在被引用的问题：生命体为什么能维持高度有序，而不被热力学第二定律抹平？
In 1944, Schrödinger posed in What Is Life? a question that is still being cited: why can living things maintain a high degree of order without being flattened by the second law of thermodynamics?
他的回答是”以负熵为食”（feeding on negative entropy）：生命从环境中摄取有序性、向环境排放熵。这个表述在物理上并不严格（后来他自己也承认），但方向是对的——生命不是违反第二定律，而是通过加速环境的熵产生来维持自身的低熵。
His answer was “feeding on negative entropy”: life takes order from the environment and discharges entropy into it. The formulation is not physically rigorous (as he himself later conceded), but the direction is right—life does not violate the second law; it maintains its own low entropy by accelerating the production of entropy in its environment.
这一思路在第三章、第四章会被展开为耗散结构与非平衡热力学。这里先记住薛定谔真正贡献的两点：
This line of thought will be developed in Chapters 3 and 4 as dissipative structures and non-equilibrium thermodynamics. For now, two points that constitute Schrödinger’s real contribution should be kept in mind:

遗传信息必须存储在某种”非周期性晶体”（aperiodic crystal）中——这一预言直接指向 DNA；
Hereditary information must be stored in some kind of “aperiodic crystal”—a prediction that points directly to DNA;
生命的有序性需要一个物理学的解释，而不是一个活力论的解释。
The orderliness of life requires a physical explanation, not a vitalist one.



1.7 现代生命定义的三条路线 / 1.7 Three Routes in Modern Definitions of Life
当代文献中的生命定义大致可以归为三类，每一类都有明显的代价：
Definitions of life in the contemporary literature fall roughly into three classes, each with conspicuous costs:









路线
代表定义
核心判据
主要困难




代谢主义
生命是自我维持的化学反应网络
代谢、自我生产
病毒、休眠孢子被判为”非生命”

生命是能够复制并演化的信息载体
复制、变异、选择
无法处理不育的个体与群体选择

组织闭合、自主性

English

Metabolism-first

NASA 的”工作性定义”——生命是能够进行达尔文式演化的自我维持化学系统（a self-sustaining chemical system capable of Darwinian evolution）——本质上是复制主义与代谢主义的拼接。它非常有用，因为它同时要求”自我维持”和”可演化”；但它也有两个众所周知的盲点：
The NASA “working definition”—life is a self-sustaining chemical system capable of Darwinian evolution—is at bottom a splice of replicationism and metabolism. It is extremely useful, because it demands both “self-sustaining” and “evolvable”; but it also has two well-known blind spots:

它把”化学”写进了定义，从而在定义上排除了纯数字生命与可能的非化学生命；
It writes “chemical” into the definition, thereby ruling out purely digital life and possible non-chemical life by definition;
它没有说明”自我维持”需要达到什么程度。
It does not say to what degree “self-sustaining” must be achieved.



1.8 边界对象：病毒、朊粒、人工细胞、数字生命 / 1.8 Boundary Objects: Viruses, Prions, Artificial Cells, Digital Life
四个典型边界案例，足以说明为什么”清单式定义”总是不够：
Four typical boundary cases suffice to show why checklist definitions always fall short:

病毒：有基因组、能演化、有明确的复制—选择循环，但离开宿主没有自身代谢。按 NASA 定义，它处于灰色地带。
Viruses: they have a genome, can evolve, and exhibit a clear replication–selection cycle, but outside a host they have no metabolism of their own. Under the NASA definition they occupy a grey zone.
朊粒：只有蛋白质构象的传播，没有核酸，却能”遗传”并被选择（不同株系有不同表型）。它挑战了”遗传信息必须由核酸承载”的假设。
Prions: only a protein conformation propagates; there is no nucleic acid, yet the entity can be “inherited” and selected (different strains have different phenotypes). This challenges the assumption that hereditary information must be carried by nucleic acids.
人工细胞：可以封装酶、能合成膜脂、能生长甚至分裂，但大多不能自主复制基因组。它们证明”部分生命属性可以被分离出来单独实现”。
Artificial cells: they can encapsulate enzymes, synthesise membrane lipids, grow, and even divide, but most cannot autonomously replicate a genome. They demonstrate that “individual properties of life can be separated out and realised in isolation.”
数字生命：Tierra、Avida 中的自复制程序会变异、会被选择、会演化出寄生者；它们满足”演化”，却不满足”化学”。
Digital life: the self-replicating programs in Tierra and Avida mutate, are selected, and evolve parasites; they satisfy “evolution” but not “chemistry.”

这些案例共同提示：生命不是一个自然种类（natural kind），更像一个以原型为中心的家族相似概念——细菌是原型，病毒、朊粒、原始细胞、数字生物按各自与原型共享的属性多少，分布在不同的”生命性”梯度上。
Together these cases suggest that life is not a natural kind but rather a family-resemblance concept centred on a prototype—the bacterium is the prototype, and viruses, prions, protocells, and digital organisms are distributed along different gradients of “aliveness” according to how many properties they share with that prototype.


1.9 本章结论：从”是什么”转向”如何发生” / 1.9 Chapter Conclusion: From “What It Is” to “How It Happens”
本章的结论可以压缩成一句话：把生命理解为一个持续发生的过程，比把它理解为一个固定对象，更符合现有的证据与哲学传统。
The conclusion of this chapter can be compressed into a single sentence: understanding life as a process that continually happens accords better with the available evidence and with the philosophical tradition than understanding it as a fixed object.
这一转向有三个直接后果：
This shift has three direct consequences:

定义问题变成程度问题：不问”是不是生命”，而问”在多大程度上实现了哪些生命功能”。
The definitional question becomes a question of degree: we no longer ask “is it life?” but “to what extent, and which, life functions are realised?”
起源问题变成转变问题：不问”第一个生命出现在哪一年”，而问”哪几种组织方式的转变是必要的、哪些是可替代的”。
The origin question becomes a question of transitions: we no longer ask “in which year did the first life appear?” but “which transformations of organisation are necessary and which are replaceable?”
实验设计变成扰动问题：既然生命是过程，那么检验一个系统是否”活着”的最好方式，是扰动它、看它能否主动恢复——而不是静态地检查它有没有某个部件。
Experimental design becomes a question of perturbation: since life is a process, the best way to test whether a system is “alive” is to perturb it and see whether it can actively recover—rather than statically checking whether it possesses a particular component.


已知：没有任何一个定义能同时覆盖全部边界案例而不产生反例；NASA 定义是最常用的工作性折中。 未决：生命性是否可以被连续量化？如果可以被量化，序参量应该是什么？ 可验证方向：设计一组”扰动—恢复”实验，比较原始细胞、普通囊泡与活细胞在受到渗透、温度、稀释扰动后的恢复能力分布。


Known: no single definition covers all boundary cases without generating counterexamples; the NASA definition is the most commonly used working compromise. Open: can aliveness be quantified continuously? If it can, what should the order parameter be? Testable direction: design a set of “perturbation–recovery” experiments comparing the distribution of recovery capacity in protocells, ordinary vesicles, and living cells after osmotic, thermal, and dilution perturbations.

title: From Non-Life to Life: Philosophy, Self-Organization, Information, and the Emergence of Living Systems
section: 第二章　生命诞生之前的地球 / Chapter 2. The Earth Before Life
text:
第二章　生命诞生之前的地球 / Chapter 2. The Earth Before Life

2.1 时间尺度：46 亿年里的四个阶段 / 2.1 Timescale: Four Stages in 4.6 Billion Years
地球形成于约 45.4 亿年前（Ga）。与生命起源相关的时段通常被划分为：
The Earth formed about 4.54 billion years ago (Ga). The interval relevant to the origin of life is usually divided as follows:

冥古宙（Hadean，约 4.6–4.0 Ga）：岩浆海洋、强烈撞击、原始大气与海洋形成。
Hadean (about 4.6–4.0 Ga): magma oceans, intense impacts, and the formation of a primordial atmosphere and ocean.
太古宙早期（Eoarchean，约 4.0–3.6 Ga）：大陆核形成、最早的沉积岩、可能的生命痕迹。
Eoarchean (about 4.0–3.6 Ga): formation of continental nuclei, the earliest sedimentary rocks, and possible traces of life.
太古宙中晚期（约 3.6–2.5 Ga）：叠层石、微生物席、大氧化事件前的缺氧海洋。
Middle to late Archean (about 3.6–2.5 Ga): stromatolites, microbial mats, and an anoxic ocean before the Great Oxidation Event.
元古宙以后：真核化、多细胞化——这已经不属于生命起源，而属于生命的复杂化。
From the Proterozoic onward: eukaryogenesis and multicellularity—no longer part of the origin of life but part of its complexification.

关键点在于：生命起源的化学窗口，比”生命出现”的证据窗口要早得多，也更不确定。最早的疑似生命证据在 3.5–3.7 Ga，但化学上的”适宜窗口”可能要到 4.2–4.3 Ga 才打开。
The key point is this: the chemical window for the origin of life is much earlier, and much less certain, than the evidential window for “the appearance of life.” The earliest suspected evidence of life dates to 3.5–3.7 Ga, but the chemically “suitable window” may not have opened until 4.2–4.3 Ga.
2026 年的一项建模工作给出了一个具体数字：通过模拟冥古宙的热环境与撞击频率，研究者认为约 4.33 Ga 是 RNA 世界启动的”甜点窗口”（sweet spot），比 LUCA 的估计时间早约 1.3 亿年（Mojzsis et al. 2026）。这类结果依赖大量假设（撞击通量、海水 pH、温度、可用磷酸盐浓度），不能被当作年代测定，但它提供了一个可被后续地质证据检验的框架。
A modelling study published in 2026 offers a concrete number: by simulating the Hadean thermal environment and impact frequency, the researchers argue that about 4.33 Ga was the “sweet spot” for launching an RNA world, roughly 130 million years earlier than the estimated age of LUCA (Mojzsis et al. 2026). Such results depend on a large number of assumptions (impact flux, seawater pH, temperature, available phosphate concentration) and cannot be treated as a dating measurement, but they provide a framework that subsequent geological evidence can test.


2.2 环境的多样性：不是”一锅汤” / 2.2 The Diversity of Environments: Not “One Pot of Soup”
“原始汤”（primordial soup）是一个过于简化的意象。近二十年的研究更倾向于多个相连的微环境：
The “primordial soup” is an over-simplified image. Research over the past two decades has favoured multiple interconnected microenvironments:








环境
优势
主要困难




深海碱性热液喷口
持续 H₂、CO₂、金属硫化物催化、天然质子梯度
稀释严重；有机物浓度低；高温破坏 RNA


陆地温泉 / 火山池塘
干湿循环、温度循环、浓度高、紫外光可用
需要陆地与淡水；紫外与水解都是破坏因素


潮汐池 / 海滩
反复浓缩与稀释、矿物表面丰富
盐度波动剧烈；涨落不可控


矿物表面（黏土、黄铁矿、碳酸盐）
模板、催化、区室化、手性选择
表面化学复杂；产物难以释放


冰 / 冻融体系
冷冻浓缩、RNA 稳定性提高
反应速率低；能量来源有限



English








Environment
Advantage
Main difficulty




Deep-sea alkaline hydrothermal vents
Continuous H₂, CO₂, metal sulphide catalysis, natural proton gradient
Severe dilution; low organic concentration; high temperature destroys RNA


Terrestrial hot springs / volcanic ponds
Wet–dry cycles, temperature cycles, high concentration, available UV light
Requires land and fresh water; UV and hydrolysis are both destructive factors


Tidal pools / beaches
Repeated concentration and dilution, abundant mineral surfaces
Drastic salinity fluctuations; uncontrollable fluctuations


Mineral surfaces (clay, pyrite, carbonate)
Templates, catalysis, compartmentalisation, chiral selection
Complex surface chemistry; products are hard to release


Ice / freeze–thaw systems
Freeze concentration, increased RNA stability
Low reaction rates; limited energy sources



近年一个被反复强调的观点是：这些环境不是互斥的选项，而可能是串联的反应器。例如，热液喷口提供还原性小分子与金属催化，陆地池塘提供干湿循环驱动的聚合与浓缩，黏土表面提供模板与手性选择。生命可能不是在某一个”理想地点”诞生的，而是在一个环境梯度的网络中逐步组装起来的。
A view repeatedly emphasised in recent years is that these environments are not mutually exclusive options but may be reactors in series. Hydrothermal vents, for example, supply reducing small molecules and metal catalysis; terrestrial ponds supply wet–dry cycling that drives polymerisation and concentration; clay surfaces supply templates and chiral selection. Life may not have been born in some single “ideal location” but assembled step by step within a network of environmental gradients.


2.3 证据的类型与强弱 / 2.3 Types of Evidence and Their Strength
讨论早期生命证据时，必须区分四类材料，它们的可靠性差别很大：
When discussing evidence for early life, four classes of material must be distinguished; their reliability differs greatly:

形态学微体化石：如 3.5 Ga 的 Apex chert 丝状体。曾被广泛引用，后被质疑为矿物成因。
Morphological microfossils: for example, the filamentous structures in the 3.5 Ga Apex chert. Once widely cited, later challenged as mineral in origin.
叠层石与微生物席结构：3.4–3.5 Ga 的 Strelley Pool 碳酸盐岩中的叠层石，形态与成因仍有争论。
Stromatolites and microbial mat structures: the stromatolites in the 3.4–3.5 Ga Strelley Pool carbonates, whose morphology and origin remain disputed.
化学化石（biomarkers）：特定脂类的碳同位素与结构。曾被用于支持 2.7 Ga 的蓝细菌，后因污染问题受到严重质疑。
Chemical fossils (biomarkers): carbon isotopes and structures of specific lipids. Once used to support cyanobacteria at 2.7 Ga, later seriously questioned on grounds of contamination.
同位素分馏：如硫同位素、碳同位素的分馏模式。这类证据最稳健，但解释仍需谨慎。
Isotopic fractionation: for example, the fractionation patterns of sulfur and carbon isotopes. This class of evidence is the most robust, but its interpretation still requires caution.

一个诚实的总结是：3.5 Ga 之前没有任何被普遍接受的生命证据；3.7 Ga 的候选证据都存在争议；4.0 Ga 之前基本没有可靠证据。 这意味着生命起源的化学过程发生在”没有留下直接记录”的时期——这也是为什么理论模型与实验室模拟如此重要。
An honest summary is this: before 3.5 Ga there is no generally accepted evidence of life; all candidate evidence at 3.7 Ga is contested; before 4.0 Ga there is essentially no reliable evidence. This means that the chemistry of the origin of life took place in a period that “left no direct record”—which is precisely why theoretical models and laboratory simulations matter so much.


2.4 早期地球的化学清单 / 2.4 The Chemical Inventory of the Early Earth
无论具体地点如何，生命起源必须面对同一份”原料清单”：
Whatever the specific location, the origin of life must confront the same “inventory of raw materials”:

碳源：CO₂、CO、CH₄、HCN，以及陨石带来的有机物。
Carbon sources: CO₂, CO, CH₄, HCN, and organic matter delivered by meteorites.
氮源：N₂（难以活化）、NH₃、HCN、硝酸盐（需闪电或紫外固定）。
Nitrogen sources: N₂ (difficult to activate), NH₃, HCN, and nitrate (requiring fixation by lightning or ultraviolet light).
磷源：磷酸盐矿物（磷灰石溶解度低）、火山来源的磷化物、陨石中的磷化物。
Phosphorus sources: phosphate minerals (apatite has low solubility), volcanic phosphides, and phosphides in meteorites.
硫源：H₂S、金属硫化物、亚硫酸盐。
Sulfur sources: H₂S, metal sulfides, and sulfites.
金属：Fe、Ni、Zn、Mn、Mo、W——既是催化剂，也是电子传递体。
Metals: Fe, Ni, Zn, Mn, Mo, W—serving both as catalysts and as electron carriers.
能量：紫外辐射、宇宙射线、闪电、放射性衰变、热液梯度、氧化还原不平衡。
Energy: ultraviolet radiation, cosmic rays, lightning, radioactive decay, hydrothermal gradients, and redox disequilibria.

真正的瓶颈通常不是”有没有元素”，而是有没有把元素组装成可反应形式的路径，以及在稀释环境中如何维持浓度。
The real bottleneck is usually not “whether the elements are present” but whether there are pathways that assemble them into reactive forms, and how concentration can be maintained in a dilute environment.


2.5 本章结论 / 2.5 Chapter Conclusion

已知：地球在 4.4 Ga 之后逐渐具备液态水与相对稳定的表面环境；3.5 Ga 存在微生物席的较强（但非决定性）证据。 未决：生命起源的具体地点（深海、陆地温泉、冰、矿物表面）仍无共识；“甜点窗口”的估计依赖撞击通量模型。
可验证方向：用更精确的撞击年代学与古地磁/古气候约束，缩小 4.4–4.1 Ga 的环境参数范围；在模拟该窗口条件的连续流反应器中复现关键前生物反应。


Known: after 4.4 Ga the Earth gradually acquired liquid water and a relatively stable surface environment; at 3.5 Ga there is strong (though not decisive) evidence for microbial mats. Open: there is still no consensus on the specific site of the origin of life (deep sea, terrestrial hot springs, ice, mineral surfaces); estimates of the “sweet spot” window depend on impact-flux models.
Testable direction: use more precise impact chronology together with palaeomagnetic and palaeoclimatic constraints to narrow the range of environmental parameters between 4.4 and 4.1 Ga; reproduce key prebiotic reactions in continuous-flow reactors simulating the conditions of that window.

title: From Non-Life to Life: Philosophy, Self-Organization, Information, and the Emergence of Living Systems
section: 第三章　从简单化学到前生物化学 / Chapter 3. From Simple Chemistry to Prebiotic Chemistry
text:
第三章　从简单化学到前生物化学 / Chapter 3. From Simple Chemistry to Prebiotic Chemistry

3.1 米勒–尤里实验：意义与局限 / 3.1 The Miller–Urey Experiment: Significance and Limitations
1953 年，米勒在尤里的指导下，把 CH₄、NH₃、H₂ 和水蒸气密封在烧瓶中，通电火花，几周后得到氨基酸。这个实验的历史意义巨大：它第一次证明生命分子可以在非生物条件下自发产生，从而把活力论从”有机化学”的最后堡垒中赶了出去。
In 1953, working under Urey, Miller sealed CH₄, NH₃, H₂, and water vapour in a flask and passed electric sparks through the mixture; within weeks he obtained amino acids. The historical significance of the experiment is enormous: for the first time it showed that molecules of life can arise spontaneously under non-biological conditions, thereby driving vitalism out of its last stronghold, organic chemistry.
但它的局限同样明显：
Its limitations, however, are equally clear:

它假设了一个高度还原性的大气，而现代地球化学模型更倾向于中性或弱氧化性大气（CO₂、N₂、H₂O，含少量 H₂）。
It assumed a strongly reducing atmosphere, whereas modern geochemical models favour a neutral or mildly oxidising atmosphere (CO₂, N₂, H₂O, with a little H₂).
它产生的是消旋的、稀薄的、复杂的混合物，而不是可聚合的单体。
It produced a racemic, dilute, complex mixture rather than polymerisable monomers.
火花放电产生的能量通量，与早期地球的实际能量分布并不一致。
The energy flux delivered by spark discharge does not match the actual energy distribution of the early Earth.

后续的”再分析”工作（例如重新分析米勒保存的样品）确实发现了更多种类的氨基酸，但并没有解决上述结构性问题。米勒实验的真正遗产不是”生命可以被电火花制造”，而是前生物化学作为一个实验学科被建立了。
Subsequent “re-analysis” work (for example, re-analysis of Miller’s preserved samples) did reveal additional amino acids, but it did not resolve these structural problems. The real legacy of the Miller experiment is not that “life can be manufactured by an electric spark” but that prebiotic chemistry was established as an experimental discipline.


3.2 氰基硫化物路线：从”汤”到”网络” / 3.2 The Cyanosulfidic Route: From “Soup” to “Network”
过去二十年最具影响力的进展，是把前生物化学从”混合物的化学”转变为”网络的化学”。
The most influential development of the past two decades has been the transformation of prebiotic chemistry from “the chemistry of mixtures” into “the chemistry of networks.”
Sutherland 学派提出的氰基硫化物（cyanosulfidic）路线，以 HCN、H₂S、紫外光、铜/铁离子为核心，能够从同一套前体出发，分别合成：
The cyanosulfidic route advanced by the Sutherland group, centred on HCN, H₂S, ultraviolet light, and copper and iron ions, can start from a single set of precursors and separately synthesise:

核苷酸（RNA 的四种碱基）；
nucleotides (the four bases of RNA);
氨基酸；
amino acids;
脂质前体（甘油、脂肪酸）；
lipid precursors (glycerol, fatty acids);
以及某些辅因子。
and certain cofactors.

这条路线最有说服力的地方在于它把原本分散的合成路线统一到同一个化学体系里，而不是为每种分子单独设计一套”看似合理”的条件（Patel et al. 2015; Sutherland 2016）。
What is most persuasive about this route is that it unifies previously scattered synthetic pathways within a single chemical system, instead of designing a separate set of “plausible” conditions for each molecule (Patel et al. 2015; Sutherland 2016).
与此同时，Powner、Szostak 与 Sutherland 的经典工作解决了 RNA 前体合成中的一个死结：在早期地球条件下，核糖与碱基难以直接连接；而通过氨基噁唑（aminooxazole）+ 磷酸的路径，可以绕过这个障碍，得到活化的嘧啶核苷酸（Powner et al. 2009）。2019 年，Becker 等人进一步给出了嘧啶与嘌呤核苷酸的统一合成路线。
At the same time, classic work by Powner, Szostak, and Sutherland resolved a deadlock in the synthesis of RNA precursors: under early-Earth conditions, ribose and bases are difficult to join directly, but a pathway through aminooxazole + phosphate circumvents this obstacle and yields activated pyrimidine nucleotides (Powner et al. 2009). In 2019, Becker and colleagues further provided a unified synthetic route to pyrimidine and purine nucleotides.
这些工作共同改变了问题的提法：问题不再是”能不能合成核苷酸”，而是”这些核苷酸如何在稀释环境中聚合成足够长的 RNA，并在水解之前被保护起来”。
Together these studies changed the way the question is posed: the question is no longer “can nucleotides be synthesised?” but “how can these nucleotides polymerise into sufficiently long RNA in a dilute environment, and be protected before they hydrolyse?”


3.3 RNA 世界：强假设与弱版本 / 3.3 The RNA World: Strong Hypothesis and Weak Version
RNA 世界假说的核心主张是：在 DNA 与蛋白质分工之前，存在一个既存储信息又催化反应的 RNA 阶段。
The core claim of the RNA world hypothesis is that, before the division of labour between DNA and proteins, there existed an RNA stage that both stored information and catalysed reactions.
支持它的证据包括：
The evidence in its favour includes:

核糖体催化中心是 RNA（rRNA），蛋白质只是外围；
the catalytic centre of the ribosome is RNA (rRNA), with proteins only peripheral;
许多辅因子（ATP、NAD、FAD、CoA）含核苷酸结构，像是 RNA 世界的”化石”；
many cofactors (ATP, NAD, FAD, CoA) contain nucleotide structures, like “fossils” of the RNA world;
体外进化可以得到具有聚合酶活性的核酶（ribozyme）；
in vitro evolution can yield ribozymes with polymerase activity;
多种核酶可以催化代谢相关反应。
various ribozymes can catalyse metabolism-related reactions.

但”强版本”（一个自给自足的 RNA 细胞）面临三个硬约束：
But the “strong version”—a self-sufficient RNA cell—faces three hard constraints:

复制保真度：核酶的复制错误率决定了可维持的基因组长度上限（Eigen 阈值）。早期核酶的保真度是否足以维持自身？
Replication fidelity: the error rate of ribozyme copying sets an upper bound on the genome length that can be maintained (the Eigen threshold). Was the fidelity of early ribozymes sufficient to maintain themselves?
链分离：双链产物不解开，复制就会停止。
Strand separation: unless the double-stranded product is unwound, replication stops.
前生物可得性：RNA 在早期地球条件下容易水解，且单体活化形式难以稳定积累。
Prebiotic availability: RNA hydrolyses readily under early-Earth conditions, and activated forms of the monomers are difficult to accumulate stably.

2025 年，Holliger 团队在 Nature Chemistry 报告了一个重要进展：使用三核苷酸底物，配合 pH 与冻融循环，使聚合酶核酶实现了指数式的”开放式”RNA 复制（Attwater et al. 2025）。这项工作解决的是”链分离 + 底物活化”这一长期瓶颈，并展示了复制过程可以突破模板长度的限制。
In 2025, the Holliger group reported an important advance in Nature Chemistry: using trinucleotide substrates together with pH and freeze–thaw cycles, they enabled a polymerase ribozyme to achieve exponential, “open-ended” RNA replication (Attwater et al. 2025). The work addresses the long-standing bottleneck of “strand separation + substrate activation” and shows that the replication process can escape the limitation of template length.
但必须严格界定它说明了什么：它证明了一个经过体外进化的核酶系统可以在特定条件下指数复制，而不是证明早期地球上存在这样的系统。 核酶本身是人类设计的产物；三核苷酸底物的前生物来源、冻融循环的普遍性，都还是开放问题。
But what it shows must be defined strictly: it demonstrates that a ribozyme system evolved in vitro can replicate exponentially under specific conditions, not that such a system existed on the early Earth. The ribozyme itself is a human-designed product; the prebiotic origin of trinucleotide substrates and the ubiquity of freeze–thaw cycles both remain open questions.


3.4 代谢优先 vs 遗传优先 / 3.4 Metabolism-First versus Genetics-First
两条路线的分歧可以压缩为一句话：先有 metabolism，还是先有 genetics？
The disagreement between the two routes can be compressed into one sentence: metabolism first, or genetics first?

代谢优先（metabolism-first）：先出现一个自我维持的小分子反应网络（例如建立在硫酯、铁硫簇、CO₂ 固定之上的网络），遗传机制是后来”接管”这个网络的。代表：Wächtershäuser 的铁硫世界、Morowitz 的逆向三羧酸循环、Martin 与 Russell 的碱性热液喷口假说。
Metabolism-first: a self-sustaining network of small-molecule reactions appears first (for example, a network built on thioesters, iron–sulfur clusters, and CO₂ fixation), and genetic mechanisms later “take over” that network. Representatives: Wächtershäuser’s iron–sulfur world, Morowitz’s reverse Krebs cycle, and Martin and Russell’s alkaline hydrothermal vent hypothesis.
遗传优先（genetics-first）：先出现可复制的模板（RNA），代谢是后来由模板编码的酶建立的。代表：RNA 世界及其各种变体。
Genetics-first: a replicable template (RNA) appears first, and metabolism is later established by enzymes encoded by that template. Representatives: the RNA world and its various versions.

2020 年，Xavier、Hordijk、Kauffman、Steel 与 Martin 做了一个有分量的工作：他们在现存厌氧自养微生物的代谢网络中，系统搜索反身自催化且食物生成的网络（RAF），发现以 H₂ 和 CO₂ 为原料、含小分子催化剂的代谢网络中，可以找到生成乙酰辅酶 A、氨基酸与碱基的自维持核心；而如果没有有机催化剂，氨基酸与碱基本身无法生成代谢 RAF（Xavier et al. 2020）。
In 2020, Xavier, Hordijk, Kauffman, Steel, and Martin produced a substantial piece of work: searching systematically for reflexively autocatalytic and food-generated networks (RAF) within the metabolic networks of extant anaerobic autotrophs, they found that networks using H₂ and CO₂ as raw materials and containing small-molecule catalysts can contain a self-sustaining core that generates acetyl-CoA, amino acids, and bases; yet without organic catalysts, amino acids and bases cannot themselves generate a metabolic RAF (Xavier et al. 2020).
这个结果常被引用为”代谢优先”的支持证据，但它其实更微妙：它说明现代代谢中存在一个拓扑上自足的核，而这既不证明它历史上先出现，也不排除 RNA 后来嵌入其中。
This result is often cited as support for “metabolism-first,” but it is in fact more subtle: it shows that a topologically self-sufficient core exists within modern metabolism, which neither proves that it appeared first historically nor excludes RNA becoming embedded in it later.


3.5 脂质世界、肽优先与混合模型 / 3.5 The Lipid World, Peptide-First, and Hybrid Models
除了上述两条主线，还有几种重要的替代或补充模型：
Besides these two main lines, there are several important alternative or complementary models:

脂质世界（lipid world）：Segré、Lancet 等人主张，最早的”遗传”单位不是聚合物，而是脂质组合物——囊泡的脂质比例可以”遗传”给子代囊泡，并在选择压力下改变。这提供了一个不依赖模板复制的演化机制。
Lipid world: Segré, Lancet, and others argue that the earliest “hereditary” unit was not a polymer but a lipid composition—the lipid ratios of a vesicle can be “inherited” by daughter vesicles and altered under selection pressure. This supplies an evolutionary mechanism that does not depend on template replication.
肽优先（peptide-first）：短肽可以自组装成淀粉样纤维、具有催化活性、并能形成选择性边界。二酮哌嗪、非核糖体肽等路径可以在前生物条件下产生短肽。
Peptide-first: short peptides can self-assemble into amyloid fibres, possess catalytic activity, and form selective boundaries. Pathways involving diketopiperazines and non-ribosomal peptides can generate short peptides under prebiotic conditions.
混合模型：RNA–肽共进化。2024–2025 年，Carell 团队提出的场景是：含有氨基酸修饰的核苷（如 m⁶t⁶A）可以同时参与 RNA 与肽的合成，从而把两条路线在化学上”焊接”起来。
Hybrid models: RNA–peptide coevolution. In 2024–2025, the scenario proposed by the Carell group is that nucleosides bearing amino-acid modifications (such as m⁶t⁶A) can participate simultaneously in the synthesis of RNA and of peptides, thereby chemically “welding” the two routes together.
凝聚体模型：液–液相分离（LLPS）形成的无膜区室可以浓缩 RNA 与肽，降低对膜的需求。2025 年的一个模型显示，由活性聚合驱动的相分离液滴对外部燃料变化具有滞后（hysteresis）与稳健性（PNAS 2025），为”原始细胞在饥荒中存活”提供了机制。
Coacervate models: membraneless compartments formed by liquid–liquid phase separation (LLPS) can concentrate RNA and peptides, lowering the need for membranes. A 2025 model shows that phase-separated droplets driven by active polymerisation exhibit hysteresis and robustness with respect to changes in external fuel (PNAS 2025), offering a mechanism for “protocells surviving famine.”



3.6 非酶促聚合与模板复制 / 3.6 Non-Enzymatic Polymerisation and Template Copying
即便有了活化的核苷酸，聚合仍是瓶颈。近年的关键进展包括：
Even with activated nucleotides available, polymerisation remains a bottleneck. Key recent advances include:

甲基异腈（methyl isocyanide）化学：可以在水相中活化单核苷酸，实现模板导向的聚合，并显著改善 rA/rU 富序列的拷贝偏差（Duzdevich et al. 2024，预印本）。
Methyl isocyanide chemistry: it can activate mononucleotides in the aqueous phase, enabling template-directed polymerisation and markedly improving the copying bias for rA/rU-rich sequences (Duzdevich et al. 2024, preprint).
三核苷酸底物 + 冻融循环：绕开链分离问题，实现指数复制（Attwater et al. 2025）。
Trinucleotide substrates + freeze–thaw cycles: these circumvent the strand-separation problem and achieve exponential replication (Attwater et al. 2025).
矿物表面与干湿循环：黏土、碳酸盐、脂肪酸膜都可以在脱水时促进聚合，在复水时释放产物。
Mineral surfaces and wet–dry cycling: clays, carbonates, and fatty-acid membranes can all promote polymerisation on dehydration and release the products on rehydration.

这些工作共同支持一个结论：“聚合”不再是最难的步骤；“持续供给活化的单体，同时让产物不被水解”才是。
Together these studies support one conclusion: polymerisation is no longer the hardest step; “continuously supplying activated monomers while preventing the product from hydrolysing” is.


3.7 产生生命分子不等于产生生命 / 3.7 Producing Molecules of Life Is Not Producing Life
这是本章最重要的一句话，值得展开。
This is the most important sentence in this chapter, and it deserves elaboration.
从”能合成核苷酸、氨基酸、脂肪酸”到”有一个能自我维持、可演化、有边界的系统”，中间至少隔着四道鸿沟：
Between “being able to synthesise nucleotides, amino acids, and fatty acids” and “having a system that is self-sustaining, evolvable, and bounded” there lie at least four gaps:

浓度鸿沟：前生物合成给出的是稀溶液，而聚合需要高浓度与特定离子条件。
The concentration gap: prebiotic synthesis yields dilute solutions, whereas polymerisation requires high concentrations and specific ionic conditions.
纯化鸿沟：合成产物是复杂混合物，其中大量副产物会抑制聚合或破坏膜。
The purification gap: the products are complex mixtures in which numerous by-products inhibit polymerisation or disrupt membranes.
耦合鸿沟：即使分别得到了 RNA、肽、脂质，它们之间也未必能彼此支持——膜要允许核苷酸进入，酶要能在膜内工作，产物要能留在内部。
The coupling gap: even if RNA, peptides, and lipids are obtained separately, they need not support one another—the membrane must admit nucleotides, the enzymes must work inside the membrane, and the products must be retained within it.
遗传鸿沟：从”能复制”到”能遗传变异并被选择”，需要复制保真度、突变率与群体规模之间形成可行的平衡。
The heredity gap: moving from “able to replicate” to “able to vary heritably and be selected” requires a viable balance among replication fidelity, mutation rate, and population size.

因此，任何声称”合成了生命的构件”的工作，都只是完成了第一段路。下一章要讨论的，正是如何从”构件”跨到”系统”。
Any work that claims to have “synthesised the building blocks of life” has therefore completed only the first leg of the journey. The next chapter addresses precisely how the step from “building blocks” to “system” can be made.


3.8 本章结论 / 3.8 Chapter Conclusion

已知：核苷酸、氨基酸、脂质前体在多种模拟早期地球条件下可以被合成；模板导向的非酶促聚合与核酶复制都已在体外实现。 未决：这些反应能否在同一个环境中、以足够的浓度与纯度同时发生？RNA 的前生物稳定性是否足以支持复制？ 可验证方向：在连续流反应器中耦合”合成—浓缩—聚合”三个模块；用微流控测量单个囊泡内的聚合速率与产物长度分布，而不是只看总体平均值。


Known: nucleotides, amino acids, and lipid precursors can be synthesised under a variety of simulated early-Earth conditions; template-directed non-enzymatic polymerisation and ribozyme replication have both been achieved in vitro. Open: can these reactions occur simultaneously in the same environment, at sufficient concentration and purity? Is the prebiotic stability of RNA sufficient to support replication? Testable direction: couple the three modules “synthesis–concentration–polymerisation” in a continuous-flow reactor; use microfluidics to measure polymerisation rates and product length distributions inside individual vesicles, rather than looking only at population averages.
