section: 第十一章　我们应该怎样定义”生命发生了”？ / Chapter 11. How Should We Define “Life Has Occurred”?
text:
第十一章　我们应该怎样定义”生命发生了”？ / Chapter 11. How Should We Define “Life Has Occurred”?

11.1 从清单到维度 / 11.1 From Checklist to Dimensions
前面各章反复出现一个困境：任何”清单式定义”都会被边界案例击穿。可行的替代方案，是把生命性分解为若干可独立测量的维度：
A dilemma recurs throughout the preceding chapters: any “checklist definition” is punctured by boundary cases. A workable alternative is to decompose aliveness into a number of independently measurable dimensions:









维度
可操作判据
测量方法
备注




D1 物质与能量流
与环境交换物质，维持非平衡
代谢通量、热耗散
火焰也满足


D2 自我维持
去除外部扰动后恢复组织
扰动—恢复实验
区分结构与组织


D3 边界
存在选择性通透的界面
膜电位、渗透实验
凝聚体是弱边界


D4 信息存储
存在可被读取的亚稳态结构
序列/组成分析
需有解码机制


D5 复制
产生与自身相似的实体
代际追踪
需区分模板与非模板


D6 可遗传变异
子代差异可稳定传递
亲子相关性
遗传力


D7 选择
差异适应度导致频率变化
群体时间序列
需排除漂变


D8 自主性
系统自身设定行为规范
扰动下的目标维持
哲学争议大


D9 开放式创新
持续产生新组织层次
长期演化实验
最难测量



English









Dimension
Operational criterion
Measurement method
Note




D1 Matter and energy flow
Exchanges matter with the environment, maintains non-equilibrium
Metabolic flux, heat dissipation
Flames also satisfy this


D2 Self-maintenance
Restores organisation after external perturbation is removed
Perturbation–recovery experiments
Distinguishes structure from organisation


D3 Boundary
Presence of a selectively permeable interface
Membrane potential, osmotic experiments
Condensates are weak boundaries


D4 Information storage
Presence of a metastable structure that can be read
Sequence/composition analysis
Requires a decoding mechanism


D5 Replication
Produces entities similar to itself
Generation tracking
Must distinguish templated from non-templated


D6 Heritable variation
Offspring differences can be transmitted stably
Parent–offspring correlation
Heritability


D7 Selection
Differential fitness leads to frequency change
Population time series
Must rule out drift


D8 Autonomy
The system sets its own norms of behaviour
Goal maintenance under perturbation
Highly contested philosophically


D9 Open-ended innovation
Continuously generates new levels of organisation
Long-term evolution experiments
Hardest to measure





11.2 三种定义策略的比较 / 11.2 Comparing Three Definitional Strategies

属性清单式：列出必要属性，满足即算生命。优点是易操作；缺点是边界模糊，且不同清单互相矛盾。
Property checklists: list the necessary properties, and whatever satisfies them counts as life. The advantage is ease of use; the disadvantage is that the boundaries are fuzzy and different checklists contradict one another.
动力系统式：把生命定义为某种吸引子或状态空间结构（如”自我维持的远离平衡态”）。优点是数学清晰；缺点是把许多非生命系统也包含进来。
Dynamical-systems definitions: define life as a kind of attractor or structure in state space (for example, “a self-maintaining state far from equilibrium”). The advantage is mathematical clarity; the disadvantage is that many non-living systems are included.
因果组织式：把生命定义为约束闭合的因果结构（自创生、自主性）。优点是抓住了”关于自身”这一核心；缺点是难以量化。
Causal-organisation definitions: define life as a constraint-closed causal structure (autopoiesis, autonomy). The advantage is that it captures the core notion of “being about oneself”; the disadvantage is that it is hard to quantify.

本文倾向于第三种为主、第一种为辅：用因果组织给出”什么是生命”的定性回答，用属性清单给出”有多像生命”的定量回答。
This article favours the third as primary and the first as auxiliary: causal organisation gives the qualitative answer to “what life is,” while the property checklist gives the quantitative answer to “how much like life something is.”


11.3 一个渐进式评价框架（作者提议，非共识） / 11.3 A Graduated Assessment Framework (a Proposal, Not a Consensus)
下面这个框架是本文提出的操作性建议，不是学术界的共识。它的目的是让不同实验之间的结果可以比较。
The framework below is an operational proposal advanced by this article, not a consensus of the field. Its purpose is to make results from different experiments comparable.
评分规则：每个维度 0–3 分。
Scoring rule: each dimension is scored from 0 to 3.

0：完全缺失；
0: entirely absent;
1：被动出现，依赖外部维持；
1: present passively and dependent on external maintenance;
2：系统自身参与维持，但需要频繁干预；
2: the system participates in its own maintenance, but frequent intervention is required;
3：系统自主维持，且能抵抗中等扰动。
3: the system maintains itself autonomously and can resist moderate perturbations.

分级建议（仅为工作性阈值）：
Suggested bands (working thresholds only):








总分
类别
典型例子




0–5
非生命复杂系统
火焰、BZ 反应、晶体


6–10
前生命系统
自催化网络、脂质囊泡


11–16
原始生命候选
能生长分裂并复制的囊泡系统


17–21
生命
细菌（应有尽有）


22–27
开放式生命
具有开放式演化的系统（目前只有地球生物圈）



English








Total
Category
Typical example




0–5
Non-living complex systems
Flames, BZ reactions, crystals


6–10
Pre-life systems
Autocatalytic networks, lipid vesicles


11–16
Protocell candidates
Vesicle systems that can grow, divide, and replicate


17–21
Life
Bacteria (everything one could ask for)


22–27
Open-ended life
Systems with open-ended evolution (currently only the terrestrial biosphere)



使用这个框架时必须同时报告：
Use of this framework must be accompanied by reporting:

每个维度的测量方法与不确定度；
the measurement method and uncertainty for each dimension;
系统在去除研究者干预后的维持时间；
how long the system persists once researcher intervention is withdrawn;
观察到的代数与选择单位；
the observed number of generations and the unit of selection;
哪些维度是”设计进去的”，哪些是”涌现出来的”。
which dimensions were “designed in” and which “emerged.”

最后一点尤其重要。一个由研究者精心组装、每个部件都为特定功能设计的系统，即使得分很高，也不能说明”生命可以自发出现”——它说明的是”生命可以被工程化”。
The last point is especially important. A system painstakingly assembled by researchers, with every component designed for a specific function, does not show that “life can arise spontaneously” even if it scores highly—it shows that “life can be engineered.”


11.4 可证伪的预测 / 11.4 Falsifiable Predictions
一个好的框架应该产生可被推翻的预测。本文提出三条：
A good framework should generate predictions that can be overturned. This article offers three:

扰动恢复预测：在同等条件下，得分 ≥ 11 的系统在渗透压扰动后的恢复时间应显著短于得分 ≤ 10 的系统。
Perturbation-recovery prediction: under otherwise equal conditions, systems scoring ≥ 11 should recover significantly faster after osmotic perturbation than systems scoring ≤ 10.
代际稳定性预测：具备 D5 + D6 的系统，其子代分布应随代数收敛（而不是发散）。
Generational-stability prediction: in systems possessing D5 + D6, the distribution of progeny should converge (not diverge) with successive generations.
开放式创新预测：只有具备 D8 + D9 的系统，才能在长期培养中持续产生”新类型”，而不仅仅是参数漂移。
Open-ended innovation prediction: only systems possessing D8 + D9 should continue to produce “new types” in long-term culture, rather than merely drifting in parameter space.

如果这些预测在实验中失败，框架就需要修正——这正是它区别于纯哲学分类的地方。
If these predictions fail experimentally, the framework must be revised—and that is precisely what distinguishes it from a purely philosophical taxonomy.


11.5 本章结论 / 11.5 Chapter Conclusion

已知：属性清单、动力系统、因果组织三种定义各有优劣；目前没有公认的定量框架。 未决：维度之间是否独立？是否存在”必要组合”？ 可验证方向：用同一套扰动协议测试 5–10 种人工系统（囊泡、凝聚体、自催化网络、最小细胞），比较它们的恢复曲线。


Known: the checklist, dynamical-systems, and causal-organisation definitions each have strengths and weaknesses; there is no accepted quantitative framework. Open: are the dimensions independent of one another? Is there a “necessary combination”? Testable direction: test 5–10 artificial systems (vesicles, coacervates, autocatalytic networks, minimal cells) with the same perturbation protocol and compare their recovery curves.

section: 第十二章　生命的第二次起源 / Chapter 12. The Second Origin of Life
text:
第十二章　生命的第二次起源 / Chapter 12. The Second Origin of Life
第一次生命起源于地球化学。今天，人类开始尝试第二次——不是等待化学偶然，而是有意识地设计。
The first origin of life arose from geochemistry. Today humanity is attempting a second—not by waiting for chemical accident but by deliberate design.
这带来三个问题。
This raises three questions.

12.1 我们能在实验室里造出可演化的系统吗？ / 12.1 Can We Build Evolvable Systems in the Laboratory?
目前最接近的答案是：能造出部分，不能造出整体。
The most nearly correct answer at present is: we can build the parts, but not the whole.
复制、分裂、区室化、自催化、化学记忆都已分别实现；把它们耦合起来，并维持多代稳定性，仍是未完成的任务。最可能的突破口不是”再合成一个更复杂的分子”，而是工程化的耦合：把已知模块放进同一个物理系统，让它们彼此约束。
Replication, division, compartmentalisation, autocatalysis, and chemical memory have each been realised separately; coupling them together while maintaining multi-generational stability remains an unfinished task. The most likely breakthrough is not “synthesising yet another, more complex molecule” but engineered coupling: placing known modules in the same physical system and letting them constrain one another.


12.2 我们能在计算世界里造出数字生命吗？ / 12.2 Can We Build Digital Life in the Computational World?
如果”生命”要求物理层面的能量代谢与化学组织，那么答案可能是”不能”。如果”生命”只要求组织与演化，那么答案可能是”已经部分实现”。
If “life” requires energy metabolism and chemical organisation at the physical level, the answer may be “no.” If “life” requires only organisation and evolution, the answer may be “already partly achieved.”
关键不在于定义之争，而在于我们想用数字生命做什么：如果目标是研究演化的普遍规律，数字系统已经足够；如果目标是创造”真正活着的”实体，那么我们需要说明”活着”在计算基质上意味着什么。
The crux is not the dispute over definitions but what we want digital life for: if the goal is to study the general laws of evolution, digital systems already suffice; if the goal is to create entities that are “genuinely alive,” then we must specify what “alive” means on a computational substrate.


12.3 被创造的生命与自然生命有何不同？ / 12.3 How Does Created Life Differ from Natural Life?
这是三个问题中最哲学的。至少有三点差异：
This is the most philosophical of the three questions. There are at least three differences:

起源方式：自然生命没有设计者；被创造的生命有。这不影响它”是否活着”，但影响我们如何理解它的地位。
Mode of origin: natural life has no designer; created life does. This does not affect whether it is “alive,” but it affects how we understand its status.
目的性：自然生命的目的（如果有）是内生的、演化的；被创造的生命的目的可能部分由设计者设定。
Teleology: the purposes of natural life (if any) are endogenous and evolved; the purposes of created life may be partly set by its designer.
依赖性：被创造的生命依赖于维持它的技术系统；一旦技术系统消失，它也随之消失。这是一种”浅层自主性”。
Dependence: created life depends on the technological system that sustains it; once that system disappears, so does it. This is a kind of “shallow autonomy.”

这三点不构成”被创造的生命不是生命”的论证，但它们说明：创造生命并不等于理解生命。我们可能造出一个能自我维持、能演化的系统，却仍然不知道它是如何”成为”生命的。
These three points do not amount to an argument that “created life is not life,” but they show that creating life is not the same as understanding life. We might build a system that maintains itself and evolves, and still not know how it “became” alive.


12.4 回到开头 / 12.4 Returning to the Beginning
回到那块岩石、那团火焰、那杯振荡的反应液和那个细菌。
Return to the rock, the flame, the cup of oscillating reaction liquid, and the bacterium.
岩石没有组织；火焰有耗散结构但没有记忆；振荡反应有记忆但没有边界；细菌有全部，但它的”全部”是四十亿年演化的产物，而不是一次相变的瞬间结果。
The rock has no organisation; the flame has a dissipative structure but no memory; the oscillating reaction has memory but no boundary; the bacterium has everything—but its “everything” is the product of four billion years of evolution, not the instantaneous result of a single phase transition.
所以，本文的结论既不是”生命是偶然的”，也不是”生命是必然的”，而是：
The conclusion of this article is therefore neither “life is contingent” nor “life is necessary,” but rather:

生命是物质在特定组织条件下反复出现的一种可能性；这种可能性是否被实现，取决于历史的偶然；但它一旦被实现，就会自我放大、自我维持，并打开新的可能性空间。


Life is a possibility that matter repeatedly offers under particular conditions of organisation; whether that possibility is realised depends on historical contingency; but once realised, it amplifies itself, maintains itself, and opens new spaces of possibility.

这句话的前半部分属于科学，后半部分属于哲学。把两者分开，是我们能对这个问题保持诚实的方式。
The first half of this sentence belongs to science, the second to philosophy. Keeping the two apart is how we can remain honest about this question.

section: 附录 D　关键术语词典 / Appendix D. Glossary of Key Terms
text:
附录 D　关键术语词典 / Appendix D. Glossary of Key Terms







术语
解释




abiogenesis
非生物起源，指从非生命化学到生命的转变


agency
能动性，系统依据自身状态选择行动的能力


assembly index
组装指数，构造一个对象所需的最少递归步骤


autopoiesis
自创生，系统持续生产自身组成部分并维持边界


autocatalytic set
自催化集合，每个反应都被集合内部分子催化的反应网络


autonomy
自主性，系统自身维持其构成条件


autopoiesis vs autonomy
前者强调自我生产，后者强调自我立法


chemical closure
化学闭合，反应网络在物质上的自足


compositional genome
组成性基因组，以组分比例而非序列传递信息


constraint closure
约束闭合，结构条件在系统内部相互维持


dissipative structure
耗散结构，靠持续能量流维持的有序结构


emergence
涌现，整体具有部分所没有的性质


enactive
生成式，强调认知源于行动与耦合


entropy production
熵产生，不可逆过程产生的熵


error threshold
错误阈值，复制保真度允许的最大基因组长度


evolutionarily stable
演化稳定，不能被突变策略入侵


food set
食物集，可从环境免费获得的分子集合


functional information
功能信息，与适应性相关的信息量


hysteresis
滞后，系统状态依赖历史路径


individuation
个体化，个体在过程中形成


Kantian whole
康德式整体，部分为整体而存在、整体为部分而存在


LUCA
最后普遍共同祖先


metastable
亚稳态，暂时稳定但可被扰动改变


minimal cell
最小细胞，具备生长与分裂所需的最小基因集


homochirality
同手性，生物分子只使用一种手性的现象


major evolutionary transition
重大演化转变，如真核化、多细胞化、社会化


open-ended evolution
开放式演化，持续产生新可能性


protocell
原始细胞，具有边界与部分代谢功能的囊泡


quasispecies
准物种，突变—选择平衡下的序列云


RAF
反身自催化且食物生成的网络


ratchet
棘轮，不可逆的累积机制


replicator
复制子，能产生自身拷贝的实体


semantic information
语义信息，具有指称关系的信息


substrate independence
基质独立性，功能不依赖具体物质载体


teleonomy
目的性（演化赋予的），区别于 teleology


vesicle
囊泡，由脂质双层包围的区室



English







Term
Explanation




abiogenesis
Non-biological origin, referring to the transition from non-living chemistry to life


agency
The capacity of a system to choose actions based on its own state


assembly index
The minimal number of recursive steps required to construct an object


autopoiesis
Self-production: the system continuously produces its own components and maintains its boundary


autocatalytic set
A reaction network in which every reaction is catalysed by molecules within the set


autonomy
Self-governance: the system maintains its own constitutive conditions


autopoiesis vs autonomy
The former emphasises self-production, the latter self-legislation


chemical closure
The material self-sufficiency of a reaction network


compositional genome
A genome in which information is transmitted through component ratios rather than sequence


constraint closure
Structural conditions mutually maintain one another within the system


dissipative structure
An ordered structure maintained by a continuous flow of energy


emergence
The whole possesses properties absent from its parts


enactive
Emphasising that cognition arises from action and coupling


entropy production
The entropy generated by irreversible processes


error threshold
The maximum genome length permitted by replication fidelity


evolutionarily stable
Cannot be invaded by mutant strategies


food set
The set of molecules freely available from the environment


functional information
The amount of information associated with fitness


hysteresis
The state of a system depends on its historical path


individuation
The individual forms in the process


Kantian whole
Parts exist for the sake of the whole, and the whole for the sake of the parts


LUCA
Last Universal Common Ancestor


metastable
Temporarily stable but changeable by perturbation


minimal cell
A cell with the minimal gene set required for growth and division


homochirality
The phenomenon that biomolecules use only one handedness


major evolutionary transition
A major evolutionary transition, such as eukaryogenesis, multicellularity, or sociality


open-ended evolution
Continuously generating new possibilities


protocell
A vesicle with a boundary and some metabolic function


quasispecies
A cloud of sequences under mutation–selection balance


RAF
A network that is reflexively autocatalytic and food-generated


ratchet
An irreversible cumulative mechanism


replicator
An entity capable of producing copies of itself


semantic information
Information with a referential relation


substrate independence
Function does not depend on a specific material carrier


teleonomy
Evolutionarily conferred purpose, as distinct from teleology


vesicle
A compartment enclosed by a lipid bilayer

title: From Non-Life to Life: Philosophy, Self-Organization, Information, and the Emergence of Living Systems
section: 附录 E　开放问题清单 / Appendix E. List of Open Questions
text:
附录 E　开放问题清单 / Appendix E. List of Open Questions

前生物条件下，RNA 寡核苷酸能否在无酶情况下达到 100 nt 以上并保持功能？
Under prebiotic conditions, can RNA oligonucleotides reach more than 100 nt without enzymes while remaining functional?
膜脂合成与 RNA 复制能否在同一个囊泡内稳定耦合超过 20 代？
Can membrane lipid synthesis and RNA replication be stably coupled within a single vesicle for more than 20 generations?
自催化网络在真实化学中是否存在可测的一阶相变？
Does an autocatalytic network exhibit a measurable first-order phase transition in real chemistry?
约束闭合能否被操作化为一个可计算的量？
Can constraint closure be operationalised as a computable quantity?
编码系统（遗传密码）的起源是否可以在实验室中重演？
Can the origin of the coding system (the genetic code) be re-enacted in the laboratory?
前生物选择的最小机制是什么？它需要模板吗？
What is the minimal mechanism of prebiotic selection, and does it require a template?
手性一致性是在分子层面还是网络层面形成的？
Is chiral consistency established at the molecular level or at the level of the network?
早期地球的磷酸盐浓度是否足以支持聚合？
Was the phosphate concentration on the early Earth sufficient to support polymerisation?
生命起源是一次事件还是多次并行事件？
Was the origin of life a single event or several parallel events?
LUCA 的代谢是自养的还是异养的？
Was the metabolism of LUCA autotrophic or heterotrophic?
病毒在生命起源中的角色是”寄生者”还是”桥梁”？
In the origin of life, are viruses “parasites” or “bridges”?
数字系统能否实现真正的开放式演化？
Can digital systems achieve genuine open-ended evolution?
软件系统的”自主性”是因果闭合还是隐喻？
Is the “autonomy” of software systems causal closure or a metaphor?
生命性可以被单一定量指标刻画吗？
Can aliveness be captured by a single quantitative index?
组装理论的判据在其他行星样本上是否成立？
Does the criterion of assembly theory hold for samples from other planets?
非水溶剂中的生命是否可能？如何检验？
Is life possible in non-aqueous solvents, and how could it be tested?
生命起源的概率能否被定量估计？
Can the probability of the origin of life be estimated quantitatively?
人工创造的生命是否具有道德地位？
Does artificially created life have moral status?
合成细胞的最小基因组是否可以进一步缩减？
Can the minimal genome of a synthetic cell be reduced further?
我们如何区分”模拟生命”与”实现生命”？
How do we distinguish “simulating life” from “realising life”?

objectID: posts/2026-10-30 Encoding scRNA for Transformers/index.html#引言为什么表达数据需要编码-introduction-why-expression-data-need-encoding
href: posts/2026-10-30 Encoding scRNA for Transformers/index.html#引言为什么表达数据需要编码-introduction-why-expression-data-need-encoding
title: Encoding Single-Cell RNA Expression Data for Transformer Models
section: 1. 引言：为什么表达数据需要编码 / Introduction: why expression data need encoding
text:
1. 引言：为什么表达数据需要编码 / Introduction: why expression data need encoding
一个细胞的转录组是一个长度约两万、极其稀疏的非负向量。Transformer 不能直接吃这个向量：它的输入必须是长度有限的离散 token 序列，每个 token 对应一个 \(d\) 维向量。因此，“编码”要同时解决三件事：选哪些基因、怎么表示表达量、怎么表示基因身份。
A cell’s transcriptome is a sparse, non-negative vector of roughly twenty thousand entries. A Transformer cannot consume that vector directly: its input must be a finite sequence of discrete tokens, each mapped to a \(d\)-dimensional vector. Encoding therefore has to solve three problems at once: which genes to keep, how to represent the expression level, and how to represent gene identity.
这三件事并不独立。若只保留排序（rank），表达量的绝对大小就被丢弃；若做分箱（binning），箱宽决定了分辨率；若保留连续值，就要面对不同平台、不同测序深度带来的尺度差异。不同模型的选择，实际上是在”信息保留”与”可学习性”之间做不同的折中。
These choices are not independent. Keeping only ranks discards absolute magnitudes; binning makes resolution a hyperparameter; keeping continuous values forces the model to cope with platform- and depth-dependent scaling. Each model’s choice is a different trade-off between information preservation and learnability.

objectID: posts/2026-10-30 Encoding scRNA for Transformers/index.html#从计数矩阵到-token-from-counts-to-tokens
href: posts/2026-10-30 Encoding scRNA for Transformers/index.html#从计数矩阵到-token-from-counts-to-tokens
title: Encoding Single-Cell RNA Expression Data for Transformer Models
section: 2. 从计数矩阵到 token / From counts to tokens
text:
2. 从计数矩阵到 token / From counts to tokens

2.1 预处理链 / The preprocessing chain
几乎所有模型都先做同一套预处理：去除低质量细胞与低表达基因、按细胞总计数归一化（常见是每细胞 10,000 counts）、取 \(\log(1+x)\)、选出高变基因（HVG）。差别从这之后开始：是否保留零值、是否再把数值离散化、是否只保留前 \(L\) 个基因。
Nearly all models share the same preprocessing: filter low-quality cells and lowly expressed genes, normalize by total counts per cell (commonly to 10,000), apply \(\log(1+x)\), and select highly variable genes. The divergence starts afterwards: whether zeros are kept, whether values are further discretized, and whether only the top \(L\) genes are retained.


2.2 两个可分离的成分 / Two separable components
可以把任意模型的输入写成两个成分的组合：
\[
\mathbf{t}_i \;=\; \mathbf{e}^{\text{gene}}_{g_i} \;+\; \mathbf{e}^{\text{value}}(x_i) \;+\; \mathbf{p}_i
\]
其中 \(\mathbf{e}^{\text{gene}}_{g_i}\) 是基因身份的嵌入，\(\mathbf{e}^{\text{value}}(x_i)\) 是表达值的嵌入（可能是常数、离散 bin 的嵌入、或连续值投影），\(\mathbf{p}_i\) 是位置编码。Geneformer 令第二项为 0；scGPT 令它是 bin 嵌入；scFoundation 令它是连续投影；UCE 则把第二项换成”按表达量采样的权重”。
Any model’s input can be written as a combination of two components: \(\mathbf{e}^{\text{gene}}_{g_i}\) for gene identity, \(\mathbf{e}^{\text{value}}(x_i)\) for the expression level (constant, a bin embedding, or a continuous projection), and positional encoding \(\mathbf{p}_i\). Geneformer sets the second term to zero; scGPT uses bin embeddings; scFoundation uses a learned continuous projection; UCE replaces it with an expression-weighted sampling scheme.
这个分解很重要，因为后面所有比较都可以落在这三项上：基因身份是否可迁移、表达值分辨率有多高、序列长度有多长。
This decomposition matters because every comparison below reduces to three questions: how transferable the gene identity is, how fine the expression resolution is, and how long the sequence becomes.


2.3 统一的玩具数据 / A shared toy example
为了让四种方法可以直接对比，我们固定一个 10 基因的细胞：原始计数为
To compare the four schemes directly, we fix a single cell with ten genes; the raw counts are


Code
genes  <- paste0("G", 1:10)
counts <- c(0, 12, 3, 0, 45, 120, 7, 0, 21, 2)
lib    <- sum(counts)
norm   <- log1p(counts / lib * 1e4)

toy <- data.frame(
  gene   = genes,
  count  = counts,
  cpt10k = round(counts / lib * 1e4, 1),
  log1p  = round(norm, 3)
)
toy


   gene count cpt10k log1p
1    G1     0    0.0 0.000
2    G2    12  571.4 6.350
3    G3     3  142.9 4.969
4    G4     0    0.0 0.000
5    G5    45 2142.9 7.670
6    G6   120 5714.3 8.651
7    G7     7  333.3 5.812
8    G8     0    0.0 0.000
9    G9    21 1000.0 6.909
10  G10     2   95.2 4.567


这段数据故意包含三个零、一个极高表达（G6 = 120）和几个低表达（G3 = 3，G10 = 2）。零值检验”是否保留零”，高表达检验”是否压缩动态范围”，低表达检验”分箱后是否被并入第一个箱”。
The toy vector deliberately contains three zeros, one very high value (G6 = 120), and several low values (G3 = 3, G10 = 2). Zeros test how the scheme handles missingness, the high value tests dynamic-range compression, and the low values test whether binning merges them into the first bin.

objectID: posts/2026-10-30 Encoding scRNA for Transformers/index.html#排序编码geneformer-rank-based-encoding
href: posts/2026-10-30 Encoding scRNA for Transformers/index.html#排序编码geneformer-rank-based-encoding
title: Encoding Single-Cell RNA Expression Data for Transformer Models
section: 3. 排序编码：Geneformer / Rank-based encoding
text:
3. 排序编码：Geneformer / Rank-based encoding

3.1 计算过程 / The computation
Geneformer 的做法是：按细胞内表达量从高到低排序，去掉零表达基因，只保留前 \(L\) 个（V1 中 \(L = 2048\)），把每个基因的身份作为一个 token。表达量本身不进入嵌入，只决定顺序与是否入选。
Geneformer ranks genes within each cell from highest to lowest expression, drops zero-expression genes, keeps only the top \(L\) (with \(L = 2048\) in V1), and uses each gene’s identity as a token. The expression level itself never enters the embedding; it only determines the order and the cutoff.


Code
# pseudocode: rank-based encoding
x    <- normalize_counts(counts)          # x: [G]
keep <- which(x > 0)                      # drop zeros
ord  <- keep[order(x[keep], decreasing = TRUE)]
tokens <- gene_ids[ord][1:L]              # shape [L]
input  <- gene_embedding[tokens]          # [L, D] + positional encoding


张量维度：输入是 \([B, L]\) 的整数索引，嵌入后为 \([B, L, D]\)。注意这里没有表达值嵌入：\([B, L]\) 里只有基因 ID。
Tensor shapes: the input is an integer tensor \([B, L]\), embedded to \([B, L, D]\). Note that there is no value embedding; the \([B, L]\) tensor contains gene IDs only.


3.2 信息在哪里丢失 / Where information is lost

绝对丰度完全丢失：把所有非零值乘以 100，得到的输入完全相同。
Absolute abundance is lost: multiplying every non-zero value by 100 yields an identical input.
比值信息丢失：只要排序不变，G5 是 G3 的 15 倍还是 1.5 倍，模型看到的都一样。
Ratios are lost: as long as the ordering is unchanged, a 15-fold versus 1.5-fold difference is invisible.
截断：第 2049 名之后的基因被直接丢弃，低表达但关键的调控基因可能消失。
Truncation: genes below rank 2049 disappear, including potentially important lowly expressed regulators.
零值：不进入序列，因此”这个基因没表达”与”这个基因不在面板上”在输入上无法区分。
Zeros never enter the sequence, so “not expressed” and “not on the panel” are indistinguishable.



3.3 为什么这样做有效 / Why it works
排序编码对单调变换不变（monotone invariant），因此对平台差异、测序深度差异天然鲁棒；词表只由基因 ID 组成，规模可控；序列长度固定，便于批量训练。代价是模型无法学习”剂量—效应”，这对扰动预测是一个结构性限制。
Rank encoding is invariant to monotone transformations, hence naturally robust to platform and depth differences; the vocabulary contains only gene IDs and stays manageable; sequence length is fixed, which simplifies batching. The cost is that the model cannot learn dose–response relationships, a structural limitation for perturbation prediction.

objectID: posts/2026-10-30 Encoding scRNA for Transformers/index.html#分箱编码scgpt-binned-expression-encoding
href: posts/2026-10-30 Encoding scRNA for Transformers/index.html#分箱编码scgpt-binned-expression-encoding
title: Encoding Single-Cell RNA Expression Data for Transformer Models
section: 4. 分箱编码：scGPT / Binned expression encoding
text:
4. 分箱编码：scGPT / Binned expression encoding

4.1 计算过程 / The computation
scGPT 把连续表达值映射到固定数量的箱（默认 51 个），每个箱有独立的可学习嵌入；最终输入是基因嵌入 + 表达箱嵌入 + 位置嵌入三者之和。零值通常占用第 0 号箱，因此零值仍然是一个 token，只是携带”零”这个信息。
scGPT maps continuous expression values into a fixed number of bins (51 by default), each with its own learnable embedding; the input is the sum of gene embedding, value-bin embedding, and positional embedding. Zeros typically occupy bin 0, so a zero still produces a token that explicitly encodes “zero”.


Code
# pseudocode: binned encoding
x      <- normalize_counts(counts)                 # [G]
bins   <- cut(x, breaks = bin_edges, labels = FALSE)  # edges from training data
keep   <- hvg_mask                                 # or all genes
tok    <- gene_ids[keep]
val    <- bins[keep]                               # [L]
input  <- gene_emb[tok] + value_emb[val] + pos_emb(seq_along(tok))  # [L, D]




4.2 信息在哪里丢失 / Where information is lost

箱宽：边界通常由训练集的分位数或对数范围决定；两个相差 10% 的值可能落入同一箱。
Bin width: boundaries are usually set from training-set quantiles or log ranges; two values differing by 10% may share a bin.
长尾：极高表达被压到最后一个箱，箱内差异消失。
Long tail: very high values collapse into the last bin, erasing within-bin differences.
零值语义：零被当作一个普通类别，模型必须自己学会”零”与”低表达”的区别。
Zero semantics: zero becomes an ordinary category, and the model must learn the difference between “zero” and “low” by itself.
跨数据集：若新数据的动态范围超出训练边界，大量值会被压到首尾箱。
Cross-dataset: if a new dataset exceeds the training range, many values pile into the edge bins.



4.3 分箱的隐含假设 / The implicit assumption
分箱假设”表达量的差异在箱的尺度上才有意义”，也就是承认测量噪声大于箱宽。这在 log 空间里通常成立，但在低表达区（0、1、2 counts）不成立：那里箱宽可能小于泊松噪声。
Binning assumes that differences matter only at the bin scale, i.e., that measurement noise exceeds the bin width. That is usually true in log space but not at low counts (0, 1, 2), where bin width can be smaller than Poisson noise.

objectID: posts/2026-10-30 Encoding scRNA for Transformers/index.html#连续值编码scfoundation-与-scprint-continuous-value-encoding
href: posts/2026-10-30 Encoding scRNA for Transformers/index.html#连续值编码scfoundation-与-scprint-continuous-value-encoding
title: Encoding Single-Cell RNA Expression Data for Transformer Models
section: 5. 连续值编码：scFoundation 与 scPRINT / Continuous value encoding
text:
5. 连续值编码：scFoundation 与 scPRINT / Continuous value encoding

5.1 scFoundation：软离散化 / scFoundation: soft discretization
scFoundation 的编码器只接收非零且未被掩码的基因，这是它与前两种方法最大的结构差别：序列长度随细胞变化，而不是固定的 \(L\)。表达值先做测序深度感知的归一化，再通过”自动离散化”（auto-discretization）模块转成向量：把标量投影到 100 个可学习的桶上，取其加权和，得到连续而平滑的表示。
scFoundation’s encoder consumes only non-zero, non-masked genes, a structural difference from the previous two schemes: sequence length varies per cell instead of being a fixed \(L\). Values are first normalized in a read-depth-aware way, then passed through an auto-discretization module that projects the scalar onto 100 learnable buckets and takes a weighted sum, yielding a smooth, near-continuous representation.


Code
# pseudocode: continuous value encoding (scFoundation-style)
x     <- normalize_read_depth(counts)        # [G]
keep  <- which(x > 0 & !masked)              # variable length
v     <- x[keep] / scale                     # [n]
w     <- softmax(bucket_proj(v))             # [n, 100]
e_val <- w %*% bucket_emb                    # [n, D]
input <- gene_emb[gene_ids[keep]] + e_val    # [n, D]


它”连续”的地方在于桶的加权是软的、可微的；它仍然离散的地方在于只有 100 个基向量。严格说，这是一种学习得到的软分箱，而不是逐值独立的连续嵌入。
It is “continuous” in that bucket weights are soft and differentiable, but still discrete in having only 100 basis vectors. Strictly speaking, this is a learned soft binning, not a per-value continuous embedding.


5.2 scPRINT：连续投影 + 生物学先验 / scPRINT: continuous projection with biological priors
scPRINT 走的是另一条路：基因嵌入由蛋白质语言模型（ESM2）初始化，表达值经归一化后由一个可学习的连续投影映射为向量，再与基因嵌入相加；解码端使用零膨胀负二项（ZINB）式的似然来重建计数。这样做的结果是：表达值不被量化成箱，而是保留在连续空间中。
scPRINT takes a different route: gene embeddings are initialized from a protein language model (ESM2), normalized expression values are mapped by a learnable continuous projection, and the two are summed; the decoder reconstructs counts with a zero-inflated negative-binomial-style likelihood. Expression values therefore stay in a continuous space rather than being quantized.
需要注意：不同版本的实现细节（归一化方式、是否加入批次 token、是否使用染色体位置编码）可能不同，阅读时应以对应版本的代码为准。
Note that implementation details (normalization, batch tokens, whether chromosomal position encodings are used) differ across versions; always check the code for the version you use.


5.3 连续编码的代价 / The cost of continuity
连续值保留了剂量信息，但也把尺度问题直接交给了模型：不同平台、不同化学试剂、不同测序深度会产生系统性偏移。若训练数据足够大且多样，模型可以学到这些偏移；若目标数据集与训练分布差异较大，连续值反而会成为分布外（OOD）风险的来源。
Continuous values preserve dose information but hand the scaling problem to the model: platforms, chemistries, and depths introduce systematic shifts. With enough diverse training data the model can learn them; on a target dataset far from the training distribution, continuous values become a source of out-of-distribution risk.

objectID: posts/2026-10-30 Encoding scRNA for Transformers/index.html#基因身份与生物学先验-gene-identity-and-biological-priors
href: posts/2026-10-30 Encoding scRNA for Transformers/index.html#基因身份与生物学先验-gene-identity-and-biological-priors
title: Encoding Single-Cell RNA Expression Data for Transformer Models
section: 6. 基因身份与生物学先验 / Gene identity and biological priors
text:
6. 基因身份与生物学先验 / Gene identity and biological priors

6.1 基因词表的三种来源 / Three sources of gene identity

可学习词表：每个基因 ID 对应一个自由向量（Geneformer、scGPT）。灵活，但只能表示训练中出现过的基因。
Learnable vocabulary: one free vector per gene ID (Geneformer, scGPT). Flexible, but limited to genes seen in training.
基因共表达先验：用 gene2vec 之类的共表达嵌入初始化（scBERT）。在数据稀少时提供归纳偏置。
Co-expression priors: initialization from gene2vec-style embeddings (scBERT), providing inductive bias when data are scarce.
蛋白质语言模型：用 ESM2 的蛋白序列嵌入作为基因向量（UCE、scPRINT）。跨物种可用，且新基因只要知道序列就能编码。
Protein language models: ESM2 sequence embeddings as gene vectors (UCE, scPRINT). Species-agnostic, and a new gene can be encoded as long as its sequence is known.



6.2 为什么这决定了”零样本”能力 / Why this determines zero-shot behaviour
如果一个模型只有可学习词表，遇到训练集里没有的基因（新组装、非模式物种、罕见 isoform），它只能退化为 <unk>。而基于蛋白序列的编码没有这个问题——这也是 UCE 能跨八个物种工作的关键原因之一。基因身份的可迁移性，往往比表达值的分辨率更能决定跨数据集表现。
If a model relies solely on a learnable vocabulary, genes absent from training (new assemblies, non-model species, rare isoforms) degrade to <unk>. Sequence-based encodings do not have this problem, which is a key reason UCE works across eight species. Transferability of gene identity often matters more for cross-dataset performance than the resolution of expression values.

title: Encoding Single-Cell RNA Expression Data for Transformer Models
section: 7. 横向比较 / Comparative analysis
text:
7. 横向比较 / Comparative analysis

7.1 玩具数据上的四种编码 / Four encodings on the toy vector


Code
enc <- data.frame(
  gene  = genes,
  count = counts,
  log1p = round(norm, 3)
)
enc$rank <- ifelse(norm > 0, rank(-norm, ties.method = "first"), NA)
enc$bin  <- ifelse(norm > 0,
                   pmin(findInterval(norm, seq(0, max(norm), length.out = 52)), 51),
                   0)
enc$scfound <- ifelse(norm > 0, round(norm / max(norm), 3), NA)
enc$weight  <- round(norm / sum(norm), 3)

knitr::kable(
  enc,
  col.names = c("gene", "count", "log1p", "rank (Geneformer)",
                "bin (scGPT)", "value (scFoundation)", "weight (UCE)"),

Code

plot_df <- bind_rows(
  data.frame(gene = enc$gene, method = "Rank\n(Geneformer)",
             score = ifelse(is.na(enc$rank), NA, 1 - (enc$rank - 1) / max_rank),
             label = ifelse(is.na(enc$rank), "—", as.character(enc$rank))),
  data.frame(gene = enc$gene, method = "Binned\n(scGPT)",
             score = enc$bin / 51,
             label = as.character(enc$bin)),
  data.frame(gene = enc$gene, method = "Soft-binned\n(scFoundation)",
             score = enc$scfound,
             label = ifelse(is.na(enc$scfound), "—", sprintf("%.2f", enc$scfound))),
  data.frame(gene = enc$gene, method = "Weighted\n(UCE)",
             score = enc$weight / max(enc$weight),
             label = ifelse(enc$weight == 0, "0", sprintf("%.2f", enc$weight)))
) %>%
  mutate(
    gene = factor(gene, levels = rev(enc$gene)),
    method = factor(method, levels = c("Rank\n(Geneformer)", "Binned\n(scGPT)",
                                       "Soft-binned\n(scFoundation)", "Weighted\n(UCE)"))
  )

ggplot(plot_df, aes(method, gene, fill = score)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), size = 2.7, colour = "grey20") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#F2F6F9", high = blog_pal[["blue"]],
                      na.value = "grey88", guide = "none") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL,
       title = "Same cell, four input representations",
       subtitle = "grey = no token; numbers = value seen by the model") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, lineheight = 0.9))








Figure 1: 同一组 10 个基因在四种编码下的输入表示。颜色表示编码后数值的相对大小，灰色表示该基因在该方案中不产生 token，数字为实际进入模型的离散值或连续值。







7.2 维度与计算成本 / Dimensions and cost
设批大小为 \(B\)、序列长度为 \(L\)、隐藏维度为 \(D\)。自注意力的计算与显存都随 \(L^2\) 增长：
\[
\text{cost}_{\text{attn}} \;\propto\; B \cdot L^2 \cdot D
\]
With batch size \(B\), sequence length \(L\), and hidden dimension \(D\), both compute and memory of self-attention grow as \(L^2\):


Code
L <- seq(128, 8192, length.out = 300)
ggplot(data.frame(L = L, cost = (L / 128)^2), aes(L, cost)) +
  geom_line(colour = blog_pal[["blue"]], linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(512, 2048), linetype = "dashed",
             colour = blog_pal[["vermillion"]], linewidth = 0.4) +
  annotate("text", x = 512, y = 5200, label = "512", size = 3,
           colour = blog_pal[["vermillion"]], hjust = -0.2) +
  annotate("text", x = 2048, y = 5900, label = "2048 (Geneformer)",
           size = 3, colour = blog_pal[["vermillion"]], hjust = -0.05) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 2000, 4000, 6000, 8000),
                     limits = c(0, 8300)) +
  labs(x = "sequence length L (genes per cell)", y = expression("relative attention cost"~(L/128)^2),
       title = "Why sequence length dominates",
       subtitle = "quadratic scaling in self-attention")








Figure 2: 自注意力成本随序列长度的二次增长（解析曲线，未含常数因子）。Geneformer 固定 2,048；稀疏编码的有效长度随细胞非零基因数变化；分箱方案的长度等于保留的基因数。





因此，“保留所有基因”在计算上并不可行；“只保留前 2048 个”用截断换取固定成本；“只编码非零基因”用变长序列换取稀疏性；“按表达量采样固定数量基因”（UCE）则把长度变成超参数。四种策略的差别，本质上是如何花 token 预算。
Keeping all genes is therefore computationally infeasible; keeping the top 2,048 trades truncation for fixed cost; encoding only non-zero genes trades variable length for sparsity; sampling a fixed number of genes by expression (UCE) turns length into a hyperparameter. The four strategies differ mainly in how they spend the token budget.

7.4 一个必须强调的方法论警告 / A necessary methodological caveat
不同模型在 benchmark 上的差异，不能直接归因于编码方式。架构、参数量、训练语料、预训练目标（MLM、自回归、对比学习）、下游微调策略都会混入。已有的系统评测显示，在基因扰动预测任务上，一些基础模型并未稳定超过简单的线性基线（Ahlmann-Eltze et al., 2025），这说明”模型更大、编码更复杂”并不自动等于”预测更准”。
Differences in benchmark performance cannot be attributed to the encoding scheme alone. Architecture, parameter count, training corpus, pretraining objective (MLM, autoregressive, contrastive), and fine-tuning strategy all confound the comparison. Systematic evaluations show that, for genetic perturbation prediction, some foundation models do not reliably beat simple linear baselines (Ahlmann-Eltze et al., 2025), which means “bigger model, fancier encoding” does not automatically imply “better prediction”.

href: posts/2026-10-30 Encoding scRNA for Transformers/index.html#开放问题-open-questions
title: Encoding Single-Cell RNA Expression Data for Transformer Models
section: 8. 开放问题 / Open questions
text:
8. 开放问题 / Open questions

单调不变性是否是优点？ 排序编码对平台差异鲁棒，但它是否也在结构上阻止了剂量—效应学习？
Is monotone invariance a virtue? Rank encoding is robust to platform shifts, but does it structurally prevent learning dose–response?
零的语义：把零当作一个 token、直接丢弃、还是用零膨胀似然建模，哪一种最有利于扰动预测？
Semantics of zero: token, drop, or zero-inflated likelihood — which best serves perturbation prediction?
跨物种与跨平台：蛋白序列初始化的基因嵌入是否真的优于可学习词表？现有证据多来自聚类任务，缺少扰动任务的对照。
Cross-species and cross-platform: are protein-sequence-initialized gene embeddings really better than learnable vocabularies? Most evidence comes from clustering, not perturbation.
多组学：ATAC、蛋白、空间信息如何与表达值编码对齐？简单相加是否足够？
Multi-omics: how should ATAC, protein, and spatial modalities be aligned with expression encoding? Is summation enough?
token 预算：在固定算力下，是”更多基因 × 更低分辨率”更好，还是”更少基因 × 更高分辨率”更好？
Token budget: at fixed compute, is “more genes × lower resolution” better than “fewer genes × higher resolution”?

href: posts/2026-10-30 Encoding scRNA for Transformers/index.html#对虚拟细胞模型的实用建议-practical-recommendations
title: Encoding Single-Cell RNA Expression Data for Transformer Models
section: 9. 对虚拟细胞模型的实用建议 / Practical recommendations
text:
9. 对虚拟细胞模型的实用建议 / Practical recommendations

保留数值通道：即使主编码用 rank，也建议额外提供一个低维连续值通道（例如前 2,048 个基因的表达分位数），用于剂量相关任务。
Keep a value channel: even with rank as the main encoding, add a low-dimensional continuous channel (e.g., expression quantiles of the top genes) for dose-sensitive tasks.
显式建模零：不要把零与缺失混为一谈；至少提供 expressed / not expressed 的掩码。
Model zeros explicitly: do not conflate zero with missing; provide at least an expressed/not-expressed mask.
基因身份与物种解耦：优先使用序列或同源映射，避免 <unk> 在跨物种时吞掉信息。
Decouple gene identity from species: prefer sequence or orthology mappings so that <unk> does not swallow information cross-species.
报告编码消融：任何声称”编码更好”的工作，都应固定架构、数据与训练目标，只改变编码。
Report encoding ablations: any claim that an encoding is better should hold architecture, data, and objective fixed and vary only the encoding.
控制 token 预算：在比较不同编码时，应让总 token 数（或总算力）匹配，否则比较的是成本而非编码。
Match the token budget: when comparing encodings, match total tokens (or compute); otherwise you compare cost, not encoding.

objectID: posts/2026-10-30 Encoding scRNA for Transformers/index.html#值得测试的四个技术问题-four-testable-questions
href: posts/2026-10-30 Encoding scRNA for Transformers/index.html#值得测试的四个技术问题-four-testable-questions
title: Encoding Single-Cell RNA Expression Data for Transformer Models
section: 10. 值得测试的四个技术问题 / Four testable questions
text:
10. 值得测试的四个技术问题 / Four testable questions

单调变换消融：在同一模型上，把输入从 rank 改为”rank + 表达值分位数”，在扰动预测任务上是否提升？若提升，说明剂量信息确实被 rank 编码丢弃了。
Monotone-transform ablation: with the same model, replace rank input by “rank + expression quantile” and test perturbation prediction. Any gain indicates that dose information is indeed lost under rank encoding.
箱数扫描：固定架构与数据，把 bin 数从 11、51、201 扫到连续值，画出”分辨率—性能”曲线，观察是否存在平台期。
Bin sweep: with architecture and data fixed, sweep bin counts (11, 51, 201, continuous) and plot resolution versus performance to see whether a plateau exists.
零处理消融：在 scGPT 式架构上比较”bin-0 token”与”直接丢弃零”两种策略，评估对零膨胀基因（如低表达转录因子）的影响。
Zero-handling ablation: in a scGPT-style architecture, compare bin-0 tokens against dropping zeros, focusing on zero-inflated genes such as lowly expressed transcription factors.
长度—分辨率权衡：在固定算力下比较”4,096 个基因 × rank”与”1,024 个基因 × 连续值”，检验在跨数据集迁移上哪一个更稳。
Length–resolution trade-off: at fixed compute, compare “4,096 genes × rank” with “1,024 genes × continuous values” on cross-dataset transfer.

text:
写作说明 / Note



本文由 AI（DeepSeek-Flash） 检索、整理并撰写，尚未经过人工逐条校对。文中所有数字、曲线与图像都由随文 R 代码现场计算生成，随机过程统一设定了种子，因此结果可复现；模拟里用到的参数是教学用的简化值，不应当作真实物种的定量结论。生命起源与进化生物学中仍有大量争议，凡涉及争议处，文中会直接说明”这是模型假设”而不是”这是事实”。
This article was researched and written by an AI system (DeepSeek-Flash) and has not been proofread line by line by a human. Every number, curve and figure is computed by the R code in this post with fixed seeds, so the results reproduce; the parameter values in the simulations are teaching simplifications, not quantitative claims about real species. Several questions in origin-of-life research and evolutionary biology remain contested, and wherever that is the case the text says “this is a model assumption” rather than “this is a fact”.

objectID: posts/2026-11-02 Is Evolution a Search Algorithm How Life Explores Nearly Infinite Possibilities/index.html#把进化写成一道搜索题-writing-evolution-as-a-search-problem
href: posts/2026-11-02 Is Evolution a Search Algorithm How Life Explores Nearly Infinite Possibilities/index.html#把进化写成一道搜索题-writing-evolution-as-a-search-problem
title: Is Evolution a Search Algorithm? How Life Explores Nearly Infinite Possibilities
section: 1. 把进化写成一道搜索题 / Writing evolution as a search problem
text:
1. 把进化写成一道搜索题 / Writing evolution as a search problem
先做一个思想实验。假设你是一个从未见过地球生命的外星工程师，有人递给你一份 4.6 Mb 的大肠杆菌基因组，告诉你：这串字符是在四十亿年里、由一堆没有大脑的化学反应”找”出来的，而且它能在 37 °C 的肉汤里自我复制。你大概会问两个问题：它是怎么找到这串字符的？以及，它为什么没有找到更好的？
To start, run a thought experiment. You are an alien engineer who has never seen life on Earth, and someone hands you a 4.6 Mb E. coli genome: this string was “found” over four billion years by a pile of brainless chemistry, and it can copy itself in broth at 37 °C. You would probably ask two questions: how did it find that string, and why did it not find something better?
任何搜索问题都可以写成三元组 \((\mathcal{X}, f, \mathcal{A})\)：搜索空间 \(\mathcal{X}\)（候选解的集合）、目标函数 \(f: \mathcal{X} \to \mathbb{R}\)、以及搜索算法 \(\mathcal{A}\)（在每一步决定看哪里）。梯度下降里 \(\mathcal{X} = \mathbb{R}^d\)，\(f\) 光滑可微，\(\mathcal{A}\) 用 \(\nabla f\) 决定方向；进化里 \(\mathcal{X}\) 是所有可能的基因组，\(f\) 是适应度，\(\mathcal{A}\) 是”变异 + 遗传 + 选择 + 漂变”这一整套机制。
Every search problem can be written as a triple \((\mathcal{X}, f, \mathcal{A})\): a search space \(\mathcal{X}\) (the set of candidate solutions), an objective \(f: \mathcal{X} \to \mathbb{R}\), and an algorithm \(\mathcal{A}\) that decides where to look next. In gradient descent, \(\mathcal{X} = \mathbb{R}^d\), \(f\) is smooth and differentiable, and \(\mathcal{A}\) uses \(\nabla f\) to pick a direction. In evolution, \(\mathcal{X}\) is the set of all possible genomes, \(f\) is fitness, and \(\mathcal{A}\) is the whole machinery of mutation, inheritance, selection and drift.
这个类比一旦写下来，立刻就能看出进化的几个”异常”之处。第一，它拿不到梯度：生物不能对适应度求导，只能真的生下来、活下来或者死掉，用生死来采样 \(f\)。第二，它同时在很多点上搜索：一个种群不是一个点，而是成千上万个点并行地试探。第三，它的目标函数不是固定的：捕食者、寄生者、气候和同类都在动，\(f\) 本身随时间变化，而且生物会改造环境、反过来改变 \(f\)——这就是生态位构建（niche construction）。
Once the analogy is written down, several oddities of evolution become visible immediately. First, it has no gradient: an organism cannot differentiate fitness, it can only be born, survive or die, sampling \(f\) with its life. Second, it searches many points at once: a population is not a point but thousands of points probing in parallel. Third, the objective is not fixed: predators, parasites, climate and conspecifics all move, so \(f\) changes in time, and organisms modify their environment and thereby change \(f\) itself — niche construction.
所以这篇长文的路线是：先把三个组成部分逐个拆开（第 2–3 章讲空间和景观，第 4–6 章讲算法里的随机性与结构性），再讨论进化的”元能力”（第 7–8 章的可进化性与开放式进化），最后把这些零件重新装进一个统一的数学框架，和梯度下降、贝叶斯推断、强化学习逐项对照（第 9 章）。结束时你应当能自己判断：进化究竟是不是一种搜索算法，如果是，它和我们已经熟悉的那些算法差在哪里。
So the route of this long post is: take the three components apart one at a time (chapters 2–3 for the space and the landscape, chapters 4–6 for the stochastic and structural parts of the algorithm), then discuss evolution’s “meta-abilities” (evolvability and open-endedness in chapters 7–8), and finally reassemble the parts into one mathematical framework and compare it term by term with gradient descent, Bayesian inference and reinforcement learning (chapter 9). By the end you should be able to decide for yourself whether evolution is a search algorithm, and if so, where exactly it differs from the ones we already know.

objectID: posts/2026-11-02 Is Evolution a Search Algorithm How Life Explores Nearly Infinite Possibilities/index.html#搜索空间为什么绝大多数序列从未被探索-the-size-of-the-space
href: posts/2026-11-02 Is Evolution a Search Algorithm How Life Explores Nearly Infinite Possibilities/index.html#搜索空间为什么绝大多数序列从未被探索-the-size-of-the-space
title: Is Evolution a Search Algorithm? How Life Explores Nearly Infinite Possibilities
section: 2. 搜索空间：为什么绝大多数序列从未被探索 / The size of the space
text:
2. 搜索空间：为什么绝大多数序列从未被探索 / The size of the space
先算一个数。长度为 \(L\) 的 DNA 序列，可能的种类是 \(4^L\)；长度 20 的短序列就有 \(4^{20} \approx 1.1 \times 10^{12}\) 种，长度 100 的蛋白质编码区是 \(4^{100} \approx 1.6 \times 10^{60}\) 种，而一条 100 个氨基酸的蛋白质是 \(20^{100} \approx 10^{130}\) 种。作为对比，可观测宇宙的原子数大约是 \(10^{80}\)。
Start with arithmetic. A DNA sequence of length \(L\) has \(4^L\) possible variants; a mere 20-mer already has \(4^{20} \approx 1.1 \times 10^{12}\) variants, a 100-bp coding region has \(4^{100} \approx 1.6 \times 10^{60}\), and a 100-amino-acid protein has \(20^{100} \approx 10^{130}\). For comparison, the observable universe contains about \(10^{80}\) atoms.


Code
len_grid <- exp(seq(log(4), log(200), length.out = 160))
space_df <- bind_rows(
  tibble(len = len_grid, alphabet = "DNA (4 letters)", n = 4^len_grid),
  tibble(len = len_grid, alphabet = "Protein (20 letters)", n = 20^len_grid)
)

p_space_a <- ggplot(space_df, aes(len, n, colour = alphabet)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(10^40, 10^80), linetype = c("22", "13"),
             colour = blog_pal[["grey"]], linewidth = 0.35) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = unname(blog_pal[c("blue", "vermillion")])) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10(breaks = 10^seq(0, 300, by = 60),
                labels = function(x) paste0("1e", round(log10(x))),
                limits = c(1, 1e300)) +
  labs(x = "sequence length L", y = "possible sequences", colour = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

explored <- tibble(len = len_grid, fraction = 10^40 / 4^len_grid)
p_space_b <- ggplot(explored, aes(len, fraction)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9, colour = blog_pal[["green"]]) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10(label = label_log()) +
  annotate("point", x = 66, y = 10^40 / 4^66, colour = blog_pal[["vermillion"]], size = 1.8) +
  annotate("text", x = 70, y = 10^(-6), label = "L = 66: one part in 1e-8",
           size = 2.5, hjust = 0, colour = blog_pal[["vermillion"]]) +
  labs(x = "sequence length L", y = "fraction explored")

p_space_a / p_space_b








Figure 1: 搜索空间的量级。左：DNA（4 字母）与蛋白质（20 字母）序列空间随长度指数增长；两条水平线分别是可观测宇宙的原子数（约 10^80）与生物圈有史以来尝试过的突变总量（粗略量级 10^40）。右：已被探索的比例随长度迅速跌破任何可想象的阈值。 | The scale of the search space. Left: sequence space grows exponentially with length for DNA (4 letters) and proteins (20 letters); the two horizontal lines mark the number of atoms in the observable universe (about 10^80) and a rough order-of-magnitude estimate of every mutation the biosphere has ever tried (10^40). Right: the fraction explored falls below any imaginable threshold as length grows.





图中右侧那条曲线值得盯着看几秒。即使把生物圈四十亿年里做过的每一次复制、每一个突变都算上，长度超过 66 的序列空间里被探索过的比例也已经是 \(10^{-8}\) 以下；对一条蛋白质来说，这个比例小到写不出有意义的指数。生命不是在穷举，它是在一个几乎全空的空间里做极稀疏的采样。
It is worth staring at the right-hand curve for a few seconds. Even counting every replication and every mutation the biosphere has performed in four billion years, the fraction of sequence space explored beyond length 66 is already below \(10^{-8}\); for a protein the fraction is too small to write a meaningful exponent. Life is not enumerating. It is sampling extremely sparsely in a space that is almost entirely empty.
这件事决定了后面所有讨论的基调。既然不可能穷举，“找到好解”就只能依靠两件事：搜索算法能不能把采样集中到有希望的区域，以及这个空间的结构是否允许”局部有用的改动”逐步累积。前者是算法问题，后者是景观问题。而这两者恰好是同一枚硬币的两面——所谓适应度景观，就是把 \(f\) 的值铺在空间上形成的形状。
This sets the tone for everything that follows. Since enumeration is impossible, “finding a good solution” can only rely on two things: whether the search algorithm concentrates its samples in promising regions, and whether the structure of the space allows locally useful changes to accumulate. The first is a question about algorithms, the second about landscapes. They are two sides of one coin — a fitness landscape is just the shape you get by laying the values of \(f\) over the space.

title: Is Evolution a Search Algorithm? How Life Explores Nearly Infinite Possibilities
section: 3. 适应度景观：进化是在爬山吗 / Fitness landscapes: is evolution hill climbing?
text:
3. 适应度景观：进化是在爬山吗 / Fitness landscapes: is evolution hill climbing?
“适应度景观”这个概念由 Sewall Wright 在 1932 年提出，本意是一个比喻：把基因型放在平面上，适应度画成高度，于是进化就是景观上的一条路径。这个比喻极其成功，也极其危险，因为它暗示景观是固定不变的、二维的、可以用眼睛看懂的。真实情况是：维度等于基因数，景观随环境变化，而且生物自己也在改地形。
The idea of a fitness landscape was introduced by Sewall Wright in 1932 as a metaphor: lay genotypes on a plane, plot fitness as height, and evolution becomes a path across the landscape. The metaphor is extremely successful and extremely dangerous, because it suggests that the landscape is fixed, two-dimensional and graspable by eye. In reality the dimension equals the number of genes, the landscape changes with the environment, and organisms reshape the terrain themselves.
尽管有这些限制，二维景观仍然是理解”为什么会卡住”的最好玩具。考虑下面这个有两个峰的地形：
Despite these caveats, a two-dimensional landscape is still the best toy for understanding why search gets stuck. Consider the two-peaked terrain below:


Code
land_fun <- function(a, b) {
  1.60 * exp(-((a - 1.0)^2 + (b - 1.0)^2) / 1.5) +
  1.00 * exp(-((a + 1.5)^2 + (b + 1.3)^2) / 1.2) +
  0.30 * exp(-((a + 0.1)^2 + (b - 2.2)^2) / 0.7)
}

gx <- seq(-3, 3, length.out = 70)
land_mat <- outer(gx, gx, land_fun)
facet_z <- (land_mat[-1, -1] + land_mat[-1, -ncol(land_mat)] +
            land_mat[-nrow(land_mat), -1] + land_mat[-nrow(land_mat), -ncol(land_mat)]) / 4
col_mat <- matrix(colorRampPalette(blog_gradient)(120)[cut(facet_z, 120)],
                  nrow = nrow(facet_z))

par(bg = "transparent", mar = c(0.1, 0.1, 0.4, 0.1), family = "sans")
persp(gx, gx, land_mat, theta = 38, phi = 24, col = col_mat, border = NA,
      shade = 0.35, ticktype = "simple", cex.axis = 0.55, cex.lab = 0.75,
      xlab = "trait 1", ylab = "trait 2", zlab = "fitness")








Figure 2: 一个教学用的适应度景观：两个高度不同的峰，外加一个很小的肩部。真实景观的维度等于基因数，这里压到二维只为了能画出来。 | A teaching landscape: two peaks of unequal height plus a small shoulder. A real landscape has as many dimensions as genes; it is squashed to two here only so that it can be drawn.





如果把一个种群放在这个地形上，让它只做一件事——找到更高的邻居就搬过去——它会走到哪个峰？答案是：取决于它从哪里出发。下图画了三条这样的”爬山轨迹”，起点只差一点点，终点却是两个完全不同的峰。
If you drop a population on this terrain and let it do one thing only — move to a higher neighbour whenever one exists — which peak does it reach? The answer depends on where it starts. The figure below draws three such hill-climbing paths whose starting points differ only slightly but whose endpoints are two completely different peaks.


Code
hill_climb <- function(start, fun, step = 0.03, max_it = 900) {
  pts <- matrix(start, ncol = 2)
  cur <- start
  for (i in seq_len(max_it)) {
    cand <- cbind(cur[1] + c(-1, 0, 1, -1, 1, -1, 0, 1) * step,
                  cur[2] + c(-1, -1, -1, 0, 0, 1, 1, 1) * step)
    vals <- fun(cand[, 1], cand[, 2])
    best <- which.max(vals)
    if (vals[best] <= fun(cur[1], cur[2]) + 1e-10) break
    cur <- cand[best, ]
    pts <- rbind(pts, cur)
  }
  as_tibble(pts) |> setNames(c("x", "y")) |> mutate(step = seq_len(n()))
}

starts <- list(c(-2.6, 2.4), c(-0.4, 2.2), c(0.3, -2.4))
walks <- lapply(seq_along(starts), function(i) {
  hill_climb(starts[[i]], land_fun) |> mutate(path = paste("start", i))
}) |> bind_rows()

grid_df <- expand.grid(x = gx, y = gx) |> mutate(z = land_fun(x, y))

ggplot() +
  geom_raster(data = grid_df, aes(x, y, fill = z), alpha = 0.55) +
  geom_contour(data = grid_df, aes(x, y, z = z), colour = "white",
               linewidth = 0.28, bins = 12) +
  geom_path(data = walks, aes(x, y, colour = path), linewidth = 0.8,
            arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.12, "cm"), type = "closed")) +
  geom_point(data = walks |> group_by(path) |> slice(1), aes(x, y, colour = path),
             shape = 1, size = 2.4, stroke = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = blog_gradient) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = unname(blog_pal[c("vermillion", "blue", "green")])) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(x = "trait 1", y = "trait 2", fill = "fitness", colour = NULL)








Figure 3: 同一景观上的三条爬山轨迹。起点只差 0.2 个坐标单位，两条落在较高的峰，一条落在较低的峰——这就是路径依赖（path dependence）。灰线是等高线，等高线越密说明坡越陡。 | Three hill-climbing paths on the same landscape. The starting points differ by 0.2 units, yet two paths end on the higher peak and one on the lower peak: path dependence. Grey lines are contours; denser contours mean steeper slopes.





这就是”局部最优”的含义：一个点，它的所有邻居都比它差，但它不是全局最好。对梯度下降来说这是致命的——一阶方法没有任何机制知道山那边还有更高的山。进化同样常常卡住，但它是被卡住之后还能不能出来的问题，而这一点取决于种群大小、景观崎岖程度和有没有别的随机性。
This is what “local optimum” means: a point whose every neighbour is worse, yet which is not the global best. For gradient descent this is fatal — a first-order method has no mechanism for knowing that a taller mountain lies beyond. Evolution also gets stuck, but the real question is whether it can escape, and that depends on population size, ruggedness and the other sources of randomness available.
要让”崎岖”从形容词变成可计算的量，最常用的工具是 Stuart Kauffman 在 1989 年提出的 NK 模型。规则很简单：\(N\) 个基因座，每个基因座对适应度的贡献取决于它自己和另外 \(K\) 个基因座，总适应度是 \(N\) 个贡献的平均：
To turn “rugged” from an adjective into a computable quantity, the standard tool is the NK model of Stuart Kauffman (1989). The rule is simple: there are \(N\) loci, and the contribution of each locus depends on itself plus \(K\) other loci; total fitness is the mean of the \(N\) contributions:
\[
f(\mathbf{g}) = \frac{1}{N}\sum_{i=1}^{N} f_i\left(g_i, g_{i_1}, \dots, g_{i_K}\right).
\]
\(K = 0\) 时每个基因独立贡献，景观是光滑的单峰；\(K = N-1\) 时每个基因和所有其他基因互作，景观完全随机化，布满局部最优。\(K\) 从 0 走到 \(N-1\)，就是从”可预测”走到”不可预测”的一条连续路径。
When \(K = 0\) each locus contributes independently, so the landscape is smooth and single-peaked; when \(K = N-1\) every locus interacts with every other, the landscape is fully randomized and studded with local optima. Moving \(K\) from 0 to \(N-1\) is a continuous road from predictable to unpredictable.


Code
nk_slice <- function(N, K, steps = 260, seed = 1) {
  set.seed(seed)
  model <- make_nk(N, K, seed)
  g <- sample(c(0, 1), N, replace = TRUE)
  out <- numeric(steps)
  out[1] <- nk_fit(model, matrix(g, nrow = 1))
  for (s in 2:steps) {
    i <- sample.int(N, 1)
    g[i] <- 1 - g[i]
    out[s] <- nk_fit(model, matrix(g, nrow = 1))
  }
  tibble(step = seq_len(steps), fitness = out, K = paste0("K = ", K))
}

slices <- lapply(c(0, 2, 6, 11), function(k) nk_slice(20, k, seed = 7)) |> bind_rows() |>
  mutate(K = factor(K, levels = paste0("K = ", c(0, 2, 6, 11))))

ggplot(slices, aes(step, fitness)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.45, colour = blog_pal[["blue"]]) +
  facet_wrap(~ K, nrow = 1) +
  labs(x = "step along a random genotype walk", y = "fitness")








Figure 4: NK 模型的崎岖程度随 K 增长。四张图都是沿同一条随机游走路径（每次翻转一个基因座）采样的适应度剖面，N = 20。K = 0 时单步最多只能改变 1/20，剖面是一条被夹在窄带里的细碎行走；K = 11 时单步就能让适应度跳变 0.2 以上，剖面已经没有任何可读结构。 | Ruggedness grows with K in the NK model. Each panel samples fitness along one random walk through genotype space (one locus flipped per step) with N = 20. At K = 0 a single step can change fitness by at most 1/20, so the profile is a fine walk inside a narrow band; at K = 11 one step can move fitness by more than 0.2 and no readable structure remains.







Code
nk_stats <- function(N, K, n_start = 300, seed = 11) {
  set.seed(seed)
  model <- make_nk(N, K, seed)
  mods <- replicate(n_start, paste(adaptive_walk(model, sample(c(0, 1), N, TRUE))$geno,
                                   collapse = ""))
  list(K = K, optima = length(unique(mods)))
}

k_grid <- c(0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 10, 11)
opt_tbl <- lapply(k_grid, function(k) nk_stats(20, k)) |>
  lapply(as.data.frame) |> bind_rows() |> as_tibble()

ggplot(opt_tbl, aes(factor(K), optima)) +
  geom_col(fill = blog_pal[["green"]], width = 0.62) +
  geom_text(aes(label = optima), vjust = -0.45, size = 2.6,
            colour = blog_pal[["grey"]]) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(x = "K (number of epistatic partners)", y = "distinct local optima\n(out of 300 walks)")








Figure 5: 局部最优的数目随 K 爆炸。每个 K 值从 300 个随机起点各爬一次山，统计落点中互不相同的局部最优数（N = 20，300 次重复的箱线）。K = 0 时全空间只有一个最优，K = 11 时数百个起点落在几十个不同的峰上。 | The number of local optima explodes with K. For each K, 300 random starts climb to a local optimum and distinct endpoints are counted (N = 20; boxes over 300 replicates). At K = 0 the whole space has one optimum; at K = 11 hundreds of starts land on dozens of different peaks.







Code
walk_len <- function(N, K, n_start = 200, seed = 21) {
  set.seed(seed)
  model <- make_nk(N, K, seed)
  lens <- replicate(n_start, length(adaptive_walk(model, sample(c(0, 1), N, TRUE))$path) - 1)
  tibble(K = K, steps = lens)
}

walk_tbl <- lapply(k_grid, function(k) walk_len(20, k)) |> bind_rows()

ggplot(walk_tbl, aes(factor(K), steps)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.55, outlier.size = 0.5, outlier.colour = blog_pal[["grey"]],
               fill = blog_pal[["sky"]], alpha = 0.55, linewidth = 0.35) +
  labs(x = "K (number of epistatic partners)", y = "accepted steps per adaptive walk")








Figure 6: 爬山能走多远也随 K 变化。K 越大，单步改进的空间越小，轮次越短，而且一开始的适应度更低——在崎岖景观上，进化更容易被「锁死」在小台阶上。 | How far hill climbing gets also depends on K. Larger K means fewer improving steps, shorter walks and lower starting fitness: on rugged landscapes evolution is easily locked onto small ledges.





这些图给出一个不太舒服的结论：在崎岖景观上，爬山的效率随 \(K\) 迅速下降，落点越来越随机。Kauffman 用这个模型说明，复杂生物之所以”能进化”，一部分原因是它们把 \(K\) 控制在了可承受的范围——通过模块化、冗余和稳健性，把一张布满尖刺的景观改造成若干张光滑的小景观。这个想法会在第 7 章重新出现。
These figures give an uncomfortable conclusion: on rugged landscapes the efficiency of hill climbing drops quickly with \(K\), and the endpoints become increasingly arbitrary. Kauffman used the model to argue that complex organisms remain “evolvable” partly because they keep \(K\) within a workable range — through modularity, redundancy and robustness, turning one spiky landscape into several smooth small ones. That idea returns in chapter 7.

title: Is Evolution a Search Algorithm? How Life Explores Nearly Infinite Possibilities
section: 4. 随机与方向：选择、漂变、突变偏向 / Randomness and direction
text:
4. 随机与方向：选择、漂变、突变偏向 / Randomness and direction
很多人对进化的印象是”自然选择让生物越来越好”。这句话在单句层面没错，但它省略了另外两个同等重要的力量：遗传漂变（drift）和突变偏向（mutation bias）。把三者分开看清楚，是理解”进化是不是优化算法”的关键一步。
The popular picture of evolution is “natural selection makes organisms better and better”. That sentence is not wrong, but it leaves out two equally important forces: genetic drift and mutation bias. Separating the three is a key step towards answering whether evolution is an optimization algorithm.
漂变是采样的必然结果。即使所有个体适应度相同，下一代的等位基因频率也不会精确等于这一代，因为繁殖是有限次抽样。群体越小，抽样噪声越大。下面这个模拟把”完全中性”（\(s = 0\)）的情形画出来：三条曲线唯一的区别是群体大小。
Drift is the inevitable consequence of sampling. Even if every individual has identical fitness, allele frequencies in the next generation are not exactly those of this generation, because reproduction is a finite sample. The smaller the population, the larger the sampling noise. The simulation below draws the purely neutral case (\(s = 0\)); the only thing that differs between the three panels is population size.


Code
wf_neutral <- function(N, p0 = 0.5, gens = 300, reps = 40, seed = 3) {
  set.seed(seed)
  out <- matrix(NA_real_, gens, reps)
  for (r in seq_len(reps)) {
    p <- p0
    out[1, r] <- p
    for (t in 2:gens) {
      p <- rbinom(1, 2 * N, p) / (2 * N)
      out[t, r] <- p
      if (p %in% c(0, 1)) { out[t:gens, r] <- p; break }
    }
  }
  as_tibble(out) |>
    mutate(gen = seq_len(gens)) |>
    pivot_longer(-gen, names_to = "rep", values_to = "freq") |>
    mutate(N = paste0("N = ", N))
}

bind_rows(wf_neutral(10), wf_neutral(100), wf_neutral(1000)) |>
  ggplot(aes(gen, freq, group = rep)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.55, colour = blog_pal[["blue"]]) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(0, 1), linewidth = 0.25, colour = blog_pal[["grey"]]) +
  facet_wrap(~ N, nrow = 1) +
  labs(x = "generation", y = "allele frequency")








Figure 7: 中性漂变。群体越小，等位基因频率的随机游走越快，固定（频率到 0 或 1）越早发生。N = 10 时几十代就固定，N = 1000 时几百代仍在中间徘徊。 | Neutral drift. Smaller populations wander faster and fix (hit frequency 0 or 1) sooner. At N = 10 fixation takes a few dozen generations; at N = 1000 the frequency is still hovering near the middle after hundreds.





选择则是有方向的。Kimura 在 1962 年用扩散近似给出了一个漂亮的结果：一个初始频率为 \(1/(2N)\) 的新突变，在恒定选择系数 \(s\) 下最终固定的概率，在 \(|s| \ll 1\) 时近似为
Selection, by contrast, has direction. Kimura’s 1962 diffusion approximation gives a neat result: a new mutation starting at frequency \(1/(2N)\) with a constant selection coefficient \(s\) fixes with probability, for \(|s| \ll 1\),
\[
p_{\text{fix}}(s, N) \approx \frac{2s}{1 - e^{-2Ns}} ,
\]
它的精确形式是 \((1-e^{-2s})/(1-e^{-2Ns})\)，两者在 \(|s| \ll 1\) 时一致。当 \(s \to 0\) 时上式退化为 \(1/N\)，也就是纯漂变的中性预期。这个公式最有用的一点，是它把”选择”和”漂变”的相对强度压缩成一个无量纲数 \(Ns\)：\(|Ns| \ll 1\) 时突变近似中性，\(Ns \gg 1\) 时选择主导。
whose exact form is \((1-e^{-2s})/(1-e^{-2Ns})\), and the two agree for \(|s| \ll 1\). As \(s \to 0\) it reduces to \(1/N\), the neutral expectation under pure drift. The most useful feature of this formula is that it compresses the relative strength of selection and drift into one dimensionless number, \(Ns\): when \(|Ns| \ll 1\) the mutation is effectively neutral, when \(Ns \gg 1\) selection dominates.


Code
p_fix <- function(s, N) {
  out <- ifelse(abs(s) < 1e-9, 1 / N, (2 * s) / (1 - exp(-2 * N * s)))
  pmin(pmax(out, 0), 1)
}

s_grid <- seq(-0.02, 0.06, length.out = 260)
fix_df <- bind_rows(lapply(c(10, 100, 1000), function(n) {
  tibble(s = s_grid, p = p_fix(s_grid, n), N = paste0("N = ", n), Ns = s_grid * n)
}))

p_fix_a <- ggplot(fix_df, aes(s, p, colour = N)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.75) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 1 / as.numeric(sub("N = ", "", N)), colour = N),
             linetype = "22", linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = unname(blog_pal[c("blue", "green", "vermillion")])) +
  labs(x = "selection coefficient s", y = "fixation probability", colour = NULL)

p_fix_b <- ggplot(fix_df, aes(Ns, p, colour = N)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.75) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "13", linewidth = 0.3,
             colour = blog_pal[["grey"]]) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = unname(blog_pal[c("blue", "green", "vermillion")])) +
  labs(x = "N x s", y = "fixation probability", colour = NULL)

p_fix_a | p_fix_b








Figure 8: 左：固定概率随选择系数变化，三条线的群体大小不同（虚线是中性预期 1/N）。右：把横轴换成 N·s 之后，三条曲线几乎重合——决定命运的不是 s 本身，而是 s 与群体大小的乘积。 | Left: fixation probability against the selection coefficient for three population sizes (dashed line is the neutral expectation 1/N). Right: with N·s on the horizontal axis the three curves nearly collapse — fate is decided by the product of s and population size, not by s alone.





这张图的右半边值得记住：\(|Ns| \approx 1\) 是一条分界线，线的左边漂变说了算，线的右边选择说了算。自然界的巨大差异（有效群体大小可以差六个数量级）意味着同一套突变在有的物种里是”看不见的噪声”，在另一些物种里却是”决定性的优势”。
Remember the right-hand panel: \(|Ns| \approx 1\) is a boundary — drift rules to its left, selection to its right. The enormous range of effective population sizes in nature (six orders of magnitude and more) means the same mutation can be invisible noise in one species and a decisive advantage in another.
突变偏向是第三个力量：突变并不是均匀地出现在所有位点上，转位、CpG 脱氨、串联重复的滑移都有各自的偏好。在弱选择（\(|Ns|\) 小）的区域，偏向会直接决定进化方向；在强选择区域，它只提供一个偏置的”提议分布”。
Mutation bias is the third force: mutations are not uniform across sites — transitions, CpG deamination and slippage in tandem repeats each have their own preferences. Where selection is weak (\(|Ns|\) small) the bias can set the direction of evolution outright; where selection is strong it only biases the proposal distribution.
把三者写进一个等式，最优雅的形式是 Price 方程。对任一性状 \(z\)，下一代均值的变化可以分解为
The most elegant way to put all three into one equation is the Price equation. For any trait \(z\), the change in the mean across one generation decomposes as
\[
\Delta \bar z = \frac{\operatorname{Cov}(w, z)}{\bar w} + \frac{\mathbb{E}[w \, \Delta z]}{\bar w},
\]
第一项是”选择”——性状与适应度的协方差，第二项是”传递”——个体在繁殖过程中性状自身的改变（突变、重组、环境诱导）。漂变不在这一项里，因为 Price 方程是对期望的描述；要把它放进来，需要把 \(\operatorname{Cov}\) 换成有限样本的估计，于是协方差里多出一个采样误差项。这个细节很重要：漂变不是一种”力”，而是有限样本下选择估计的误差。
The first term is selection — the covariance between trait and fitness; the second is transmission — changes of the trait within individuals during reproduction (mutation, recombination, environment-induced change). Drift is not in this formula because Price’s equation describes an expectation; to include it one replaces the covariance with a finite-sample estimate, and the covariance then acquires a sampling-error term. The detail matters: drift is not a force, it is the error of a finite-sample estimate of selection.

objectID: posts/2026-11-02 Is Evolution a Search Algorithm How Life Explores Nearly Infinite Possibilities/index.html#穿越低谷为什么进化没有被局部最优困死-crossing-valleys
href: posts/2026-11-02 Is Evolution a Search Algorithm How Life Explores Nearly Infinite Possibilities/index.html#穿越低谷为什么进化没有被局部最优困死-crossing-valleys
title: Is Evolution a Search Algorithm? How Life Explores Nearly Infinite Possibilities
section: 5. 穿越低谷：为什么进化没有被局部最优困死 / Crossing valleys
text:
5. 穿越低谷：为什么进化没有被局部最优困死 / Crossing valleys
回到第 3 章的问题：如果景观有多个峰，进化怎么从一个峰走到另一个？有三种已知机制，它们在数学上都很清楚。
Back to the question from chapter 3: with several peaks, how does evolution get from one to another? Three mechanisms are known, and all are mathematically clear.
第一种是漂变。 把群体缩到足够小，让 \(|Ns| \lesssim 1\)，这时向下的坡和向上的坡在动力学上没有区别，种群可以像醉汉一样走过低谷。代价是它也会随机地走错方向，所以漂变是一把双刃剑。
The first is drift. Shrink the population until \(|Ns| \lesssim 1\); then downhill and uphill steps are dynamically indistinguishable, and the population can wander across a valley like a drunkard. The price is that it also wanders the wrong way, so drift cuts both ways.


Code
L_val <- 20
w_val <- 0.90 + 0.10 * cos(2 * pi * (0:L_val) / L_val)
mu_val <- 0.05
up_val <- mu_val * (L_val - (0:L_val)) / L_val
down_val <- mu_val * (0:L_val) / L_val

sim_chain <- function(N, w, up, down, gens, init = 1, seed = 5) {
  set.seed(seed)
  L <- length(w) - 1
  M <- matrix(0, L + 1, L + 1)
  for (k in 0:L) {
    stay <- 1 - up[k + 1] - down[k + 1]
    M[k + 1, k + 1] <- max(stay, 0)
    if (k < L) M[k + 1, k + 2] <- up[k + 1]
    if (k > 0) M[k + 1, k] <- down[k + 1]
  }
  n <- numeric(L + 1); n[init] <- N
  mk <- mf <- numeric(gens)
  for (t in seq_len(gens)) {
    mk[t] <- sum(n * (0:L)) / N
    mf[t] <- sum(n * w) / N
    p <- n * w / sum(n * w)
    q <- as.vector(p %*% M)
    q <- pmax(q, 0); q <- q / sum(q)
    n <- as.vector(rmultinom(1, N, q))
  }
  tibble(gen = seq_len(gens), mean_k = mk, mean_fitness = mf)
}

valley <- bind_rows(
  lapply(c(20, 5000), function(n) {
    bind_rows(lapply(1:6, function(r) sim_chain(n, w_val, up_val, down_val, 4000, seed = r))) |>
      group_by(gen) |> summarise(mean_k = mean(mean_k), mean_fitness = mean(mean_fitness),
                                 .groups = "drop") |>
      mutate(N = paste0("N = ", n))
  })
)

ggplot(valley, aes(gen, mean_k, colour = N)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = unname(blog_pal[c("vermillion", "blue")])) +
  labs(x = "generation", y = "mean number of accumulated mutations", colour = NULL)








Figure 9: 小群体可以穿过适应度低谷，大群体不能。地形是 0 到 20 个突变步上的双峰景观（两端适应度 1.0，中点 0.9，每步选择系数约 0.015）。N = 20 时种群在两峰之间来回游荡，平均累计突变数长到 9 附近；N = 5000 时被钉在出发峰脚下，只带着一点突变负荷（约 2.6）——它拿不到对面那个同样高的峰。 | Small populations cross fitness valleys, large ones cannot. The terrain is a two-peaked landscape over 0–20 mutational steps (fitness 1.0 at both ends, 0.9 in the middle, about 0.015 of selection per step). At N = 20 the population wanders between the two peaks, with the mean number of accumulated mutations rising to about 9; at N = 5000 it stays at the foot of the starting peak with a small mutation load (about 2.6) and never reaches the equally high peak on the other side.





第二种是中性路径。 如果从峰 A 到峰 B 之间存在一条所有点适应度都不下降的路径，那么这条路径在最优化意义上就是”平的”，选择不会阻止种群沿它前进。这类路径是否存在，完全取决于基因型—表型映射的结构，第 6 章会专门处理。
The second is a neutral path. If there is a route from peak A to peak B along which fitness never decreases, that route is flat in the optimisation sense and selection will not block movement along it. Whether such routes exist depends entirely on the structure of the genotype–phenotype map, which is the subject of chapter 6.
第三种是重组。 有性繁殖把两个不同个体上的有利突变拼到一起，这在数学上等价于在搜索过程中加入了”多点跳跃”算子。它让种群能够绕过中间的低谷，但也带来代价：重组会打破有利的组合（recombination load），而且两个相距很远的解拼在一起常常是垃圾。
The third is recombination. Sex combines favourable mutations carried by two different individuals, which is mathematically a multi-point jump operator in the search. It lets a population bypass intermediate valleys, but it also breaks up favourable combinations (recombination load), and stitching together two distant solutions often produces garbage.
还有一个反方向的边界条件：突变率不能无限提高。Eigen 的准物种模型给出了一个硬上限。设一条长度为 \(L\) 的”主序列”适应度为 \(\sigma\)，其他所有序列适应度为 1，每个位点每代以概率 \(\mu\) 突变，那么主序列的复制准确率是 \(Q = (1-\mu)^L\)，当 \(\sigma Q < 1\) 时，选择再也”抓不住”主序列，种群退化成均匀分布的突变云。
There is also a boundary condition in the opposite direction: mutation rates cannot rise indefinitely. Eigen’s quasispecies model gives a hard ceiling. Take a “master sequence” of length \(L\) with fitness \(\sigma\), all other sequences having fitness 1, and a per-site mutation probability \(\mu\). The master’s replication accuracy is \(Q = (1-\mu)^L\), and once \(\sigma Q < 1\) selection can no longer hold on to the master: the population collapses into a uniform cloud of mutants.
\[
\mu^{*} = 1 - \sigma^{-1/L}
\]


Code
L_q <- 30
sigma_q <- 5
mu_grid <- seq(0.0, 0.10, by = 0.004)

quasispecies <- function(mu, N = 1000, gens = 400, seed = 9) {
  set.seed(seed)
  pop <- matrix(0L, N, L_q)
  w <- numeric(gens)
  for (g in seq_len(gens)) {
    d <- rowSums(pop)
    fit <- ifelse(d == 0, sigma_q, 1)
    idx <- sample.int(N, N, TRUE, prob = fit)
    pop <- pop[idx, , drop = FALSE]
    mut <- matrix(runif(N * L_q) < mu, N, L_q)
    pop[mut] <- 1L - pop[mut]
    w[g] <- mean(fit)
  }
  mean(tail(w, 100))
}

q_tbl <- tibble(mu = mu_grid, mean_fitness = vapply(mu_grid, quasispecies, numeric(1)))
mu_star <- 1 - sigma_q^(-1 / L_q)

ggplot(q_tbl, aes(mu, mean_fitness)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, colour = blog_pal[["purple"]]) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = mu_star, linetype = "22", linewidth = 0.4,
             colour = blog_pal[["grey"]]) +
  annotate("text", x = mu_star + 0.002, y = 4.2,
           label = sprintf("mu* = %.3f", mu_star), hjust = 0, size = 2.8,
           colour = blog_pal[["grey"]]) +
  labs(x = "per-site mutation rate mu", y = "equilibrium mean fitness")








Figure 10: 错误阈值。主序列适应度 σ = 5，序列长度 L = 30，模拟群体 N = 1000，每代对每个位点以概率 μ 做一次突变。μ 增大时平均适应度下降，但真正的事件发生在 μ* ≈ 0.052：越过它以后主序列彻底丢失，曲线平在 1 上。这是相变，不是渐变。 | The error threshold. Master fitness σ = 5, sequence length L = 30, simulated population N = 1000, with each site mutating with probability μ per generation. Mean fitness falls as μ grows, but the real event is at μ* ≈ 0.052: beyond it the master sequence is lost completely and the curve goes flat at 1. This is a phase transition, not a gradual decline.





这个结果的意义在于：进化不是”变异越多越好”。太少，搜索会在局部最优里停住；太多，选择信息被突变噪声淹没。中间存在一个最优区间，而且这个区间的宽度取决于基因组长度和适应度差异——这一点在第 8 章讨论开放式进化时会再次用到。
The point is that evolution is not “more variation is better”. Too little and the search stalls in a local optimum; too much and mutational noise drowns the signal of selection. An optimum sits in between, and the width of that window depends on genome length and fitness differences — a fact that returns in chapter 8 on open-endedness.

title: Is Evolution a Search Algorithm? How Life Explores Nearly Infinite Possibilities
section: 6. 中性网络：在看不见的维度上行走 / Neutral networks: walking in invisible dimensions
text:
6. 中性网络：在看不见的维度上行走 / Neutral networks: walking in invisible dimensions
第 2 章说空间大得不可想象。但”空间大”和”难以搜索”并不是同一件事：如果大量不同的序列折叠成同一个功能，那么这个空间里就存在大片的”高原”，在高原上可以自由行走而不损失适应度。这就是基因型—表型映射的冗余（redundancy），而高原上连通的区域就叫中性网络。
Chapter 2 said the space is unimaginably large. But “large” and “hard to search” are not the same thing: if many different sequences fold into the same function, the space contains large plateaus along which one can move freely without losing fitness. That is redundancy in the genotype–phenotype map, and the connected regions of such plateaus are called neutral networks.


Code
L_n <- 9
geno_n <- expand.grid(rep(list(0:1), L_n)) |> as.matrix()
pheno_n <- apply(geno_n, 1, function(g) {
  bits <- vapply(1:3, function(j) as.integer(sum(g[c(j, j + 3, j + 6)]) >= 2), integer(1))
  bits[1] * 4 + bits[2] * 2 + bits[3]
})

edge_list <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(L_n), function(i) {
  flipped <- geno_n
  flipped[, i] <- 1 - flipped[, i]
  key <- apply(flipped, 1, paste, collapse = "")
  cbind(seq_len(nrow(geno_n)), match(key, apply(geno_n, 1, paste, collapse = "")))
}))
edge_list <- edge_list[pheno_n[edge_list[, 1]] == pheno_n[edge_list[, 2]], ]

g_net <- graph_from_data_frame(
  data.frame(from = edge_list[, 1], to = edge_list[, 2]),
  directed = FALSE,
  vertices = data.frame(name = seq_len(nrow(geno_n)))
)
g_net <- delete_vertices(g_net, which(degree(g_net) == 0))
V(g_net)$pheno <- factor(pheno_n[as.integer(V(g_net)$name)])
set.seed(4)
lay <- layout_with_fr(g_net, niter = 500)

net_df <- tibble(x = lay[, 1], y = lay[, 2], pheno = V(g_net)$pheno)
el_id <- as_edgelist(g_net, names = FALSE)
net_seg <- tibble(
  x = lay[el_id[, 1], 1], y = lay[el_id[, 1], 2],
  xend = lay[el_id[, 2], 1], yend = lay[el_id[, 2], 2]
)

ggplot() +
  geom_segment(data = net_seg, aes(x, y, xend = xend, yend = yend),
               linewidth = 0.12, colour = blog_pal[["grey"]], alpha = 0.35) +
  geom_point(data = net_df, aes(x, y, colour = pheno), size = 0.85) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = colorRampPalette(pal)(16)) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(colour = "phenotype", x = NULL, y = NULL)








Figure 11: 一个玩具基因型网络。9 位二元基因型（512 个），表型由三组「多数票」决定：第 j 个表型位是基因位 {j, j+3, j+6} 中占多数的那个值。每个表型恰好对应 64 个基因型。每个点是一个基因型，连线连接只差一个突变且表型相同的邻居，颜色表示表型。同一颜色的点大多连成一片——这正是中性网络。 | A toy genotype network. Nine-bit genotypes (512 of them); the phenotype is three majority votes over the triples {j, j+3, j+6}, so each phenotype owns exactly 64 genotypes. Each dot is a genotype, edges join Hamming-1 neighbours with the same phenotype, and colour marks the phenotype. Dots of one colour mostly form a single connected region — that is a neutral network.





这张图里藏着两个重要事实。第一，中性网络是连通的：一个表型对应的 64 个基因型可以通过单步突变互相走到，不需要穿越适应度低谷。第二，不同表型的网络在空间里是交织的：颜色块彼此相邻，说明从任何一个网络出发，只要走一步就越过了表型边界。
Two important facts are hidden in this picture. First, neutral networks are connected: the 64 genotypes of one phenotype can be reached from each other by single mutations, without crossing a fitness valley. Second, networks of different phenotypes are interwoven: the colour patches touch each other, so from any network a single step crosses a phenotype boundary.


Code
walk_neutral <- function(start_pheno = 1, steps = 6000, seed = 6) {
  set.seed(seed)
  key <- apply(geno_n, 1, paste, collapse = "")
  cur <- which(pheno_n == start_pheno)[1]
  seen_g <- cur
  seen_p <- integer(0)
  trace_g <- integer(steps); trace_p <- integer(steps)
  for (s in seq_len(steps)) {
    i <- sample.int(L_n, 1)
    nxt <- geno_n[cur, ]; nxt[i] <- 1 - nxt[i]
    idx <- match(paste(nxt, collapse = ""), key)
    if (pheno_n[idx] == start_pheno) cur <- idx
    neigh <- vapply(seq_len(L_n), function(i) {
      v <- geno_n[cur, ]; v[i] <- 1 - v[i]
      pheno_n[match(paste(v, collapse = ""), key)]
    }, numeric(1))
    seen_p <- union(seen_p, neigh)
    seen_g <- union(seen_g, cur)
    trace_g[s] <- length(seen_g)
    trace_p[s] <- length(seen_p)
  }
  tibble(step = seq_len(steps), genotypes = trace_g, phenotypes = trace_p)
}

nw <- walk_neutral()
nw_long <- nw |>
  pivot_longer(-step, names_to = "measure", values_to = "n") |>
  mutate(measure = recode(measure, genotypes = "distinct genotypes visited",
                          phenotypes = "phenotypes one step away"))

ggplot(nw_long, aes(step, n, colour = measure)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = unname(blog_pal[c("blue", "orange")])) +
  labs(x = "step on the neutral network", y = "cumulative count", colour = NULL)








Figure 12: 在中性网络上散步。随机走 6000 步，只接受保持表型不变的单步突变：大约 1000 步就把这个表型对应的 64 个基因型全部走遍。橙色是当前邻域里一步可达的其他表型数量，稳定在 4 个左右——中性网络提供的是「免费走动」，不是「无限创新」；创新必须越过边界才能拿到。 | Walking on a neutral network. Six thousand steps, accepting only single mutations that keep the phenotype unchanged: after about a thousand steps all 64 genotypes of this phenotype have been visited. Orange is the number of other phenotypes reachable in one step from the current neighbourhood, steady at about four — a neutral network gives free movement, not free innovation; innovation has to cross a boundary.





这两条线合起来就是”可进化性”的几何来源：中性网络（platform）提供稳健性，让种群在没有选择压力的情况下保持功能；而网络边界上的邻居数量几乎是常数（这里约 4 个），意味着创新的入口永远在一步之外，只是需要付出一点适应度代价才能跨过去。稳健性和新颖性不是两种能力，而是同一个结构的两个刻度。
Together the two lines give the geometric source of evolvability: the neutral network (platform) provides robustness, letting a population keep its function without selection pressure, while the number of neighbours just across the boundary is nearly constant (about four here), meaning that the doorway to innovation is always one step away — you just have to pay a small fitness cost to walk through it. Robustness and novelty are not two abilities but two readings of one structure.
